title: دستیار فروش هوش مصنوعی برای دایرکت اینستاگرام، تلگرام، ایتا و بله
segment: کسب‌وکار کوچک و متوسط ایرانی، بازار، کلینیک و آژانس B2B
engine: موتور ۱: گفتگوی فارسی و بازیابی ترکیبی (RAG)

bmc.title: بخش‌های مشتری
bmc.text: خریدار هدف: فروشندگان تجارت اجتماعی (کسب‌وکار کوچک و متوسط ایرانی، بازار، کلینیک و آژانس B2B). جایگزین یا کاهش‌دهنده: مدیر اجرایی/ادمین مستقیم (۱۸ تا ۲۷ میلیون تومان در ماه). پایه فعال حسابرسی‌شده در ماه ۱۲: ۱۶۹ حساب پرداخت‌کننده (۶۷ پایه، ۷۷ رشد، ۲۵ حرفه‌ای/سازمانی/بسته)، کالیبره‌شده با مقیاس بخش نرم‌افزار ابری ایران (لاتکا) و ریزش ماهانه ۸٫۵٪.

bmc.title: ارزش پیشنهادی
bmc.text: جایگزین «مدیر اجرایی/ادمین مستقیم (۱۸ تا ۲۷ میلیون تومان در ماه)» با کمتر از ۱۵٪ هزینه دستی/جریمه می‌شود. موتور داده: ۵۰ هزار رشته گفتگوی فروش غیررسمی فارسی در دایرکت؛ با میزبانی ۱۰۰٪ داخل ایران روی دیتاسنترهای شبکه ملی اطلاعات، تا وبهوک‌های داخلی (بله/ایتا/وب محلی) در قطعی‌های اینترنت بین‌المللی فعال بمانند.

bmc.title: کانال‌ها و کمیسیون‌ها
bmc.text: ورود به بازار عمدتاً از طریق APIهای تجاری ربات کاموا، پادرو، بله و ایتا به‌همراه ۰٫۶۰ نفر کارشناس فروش سازمانی. مدل: کمیسیون ۱۴٪ شرکا/بازارگاه بر ۶۵٪ از درآمد (۴۵٬۶۷۶٬۸۳۳ تومان در ماه در بهای تمام‌شده) برای انگیزه‌دهی به نمایندگان ERP، آژانس‌ها و فروشگاه‌های اپ.

bmc.title: روابط با مشتری
bmc.text: راه‌اندازی ترکیبی خودخدمت + تلفنی/رباتی. لینک‌های تمدید خودکار پیامکی کاوه‌نگار؛ ۱٫۱۰ نفر متخصص پشتیبانی برای موارد نیازمند دخالت انسان و پیگیری صورت‌حساب صیاد/شپارک.

bmc.title: جریان‌های درآمد (حسابرسی‌شده)
bmc.text: صورتحساب ماهانه به تومان (ماهانه + به‌ازای هر گفتگو): پایه ۱٬۷۷۵٬۰۰۰ تومان/ماه | رشد ۲٬۷۶۰٬۰۰۰ | حرفه‌ای/سازمانی ۵٬۴۰۰٬۰۰۰ + بسته‌های مصرف (۳۵۰٬۰۰۰ تومان/ماه میانگین). MRR ناخالص صورتحساب‌شده: ۵۲۵٬۵۹۵٬۰۰۰ تومان/ماه؛ MRR خالص وصول‌شده پس از ۴٫۵٪ ذخیره مطالبات مشکوک/تأخیر چک: ۵۰۱٬۹۴۳٬۲۲۵ تومان/ماه.

bmc.title: منابع کلیدی
bmc.text: GPU داخلی: ۰٫۳۸ گره RTX 6000 Ada 48GB شامل ۲۵٪ بافر پیک (۵۷٬۰۰۰٬۰۰۰ تومان/ماه) + سرورهای CPU/DB داخلی شبکه ملی اطلاعات (۲۰٬۴۰۰٬۰۰۰ تومان/ماه). پشته فنی: Qwen3-14B/32B کوانتیزه (AWQ، مجوز Apache 2.0) با vLLM + امبدینگ فارسی BGE-M3 + پایگاه برداری Qdrant روی CPU. مجموعه داده: ۵۰ هزار رشته گفتگوی فروش غیررسمی فارسی در دایرکت.

bmc.title: فعالیت‌های کلیدی
bmc.text: حفظ دقت LoRA روی ۵۰ هزار رشته گفتگوی فروش غیررسمی فارسی در دایرکت؛ زنده نگه‌داشتن اتصال‌های APIهای تجاری ربات کاموا، پادرو، بله و ایتا در برابر تغییرات مسیریابی شبکه ملی اطلاعات/BGP؛ اجرای سخت‌گیرانه صورت‌حساب ماهانه و شاخص‌بندی فصلی CPI/ارز برای جلوگیری از فرسایش حاشیه ریالی توسط تورم.

bmc.title: شرکای کلیدی
bmc.text: شرکای توزیع و API: APIهای تجاری ربات کاموا، پادرو، بله و ایتا. زیرساخت: سینداد/افرانت (GPU/شبکه ملی اطلاعات)، زرین‌پال/پی‌پینگ (درگاه شپارک) و معاونت علمی و فناوری (معافیت مالیاتی دانش‌بنیان نوع ۱/۲).

bmc.title: ساختار هزینه (حسابرسی‌شده)
bmc.text: هزینه کامل مستقل: ۴۰۷٬۱۶۱٬۷۵۹ تومان/ماه؛ EBITDA مستقل: ۱۱۸٬۴۳۳٬۲۴۱ تومان/ماه (۲۲٫۵٪). هزینه سبد موتور مشترک (تقسیم توسعه/دفتر بین ۳ ابزار هم‌خانواده): ۳۳۰٬۴۲۱٬۷۵۹ تومان/ماه؛ EBITDA سبد: ۱۹۵٬۱۷۳٬۲۴۱ تومان/ماه (۳۷٫۱٪).

hosting_note: میزبانی محلی: استنتاج و داده روی گره‌های GPU داخلی و شبکه ملی اطلاعات می‌ماند. بدون پشتیبان API ابری.
channel_note: کانال کسب‌وکار کوچک: خریدار مغازه، فروشنده خرد، مطب، وکیل مستقل، آژانس کوچک، فریلنسر یا کشاورز است که خودش پول می‌دهد.

driver: ۵۰ هزار رشته گفتگوی فروش غیررسمی فارسی در دایرکت
dataset: 50k colloquial Persian DM sales threads
stack: Qwen3-14B/32B کوانتیزه (AWQ، مجوز Apache 2.0) با vLLM + امبدینگ فارسی BGE-M3 + پایگاه برداری Qdrant روی CPU
infrastructure: Sindad/Afranet (GPU/NIN), Zarinpal/PayPing (Shaparak gateway), and Vice-Presidency for Science & Technology (Danesh-Bonyan Type 1/2 tax exemption)
dist_partners: Kamva, Podro, Bale & Eitaa commercial bot APIs
support_scope: human-in-the-loop edge cases and SAYAD/Shaparak billing follow-ups

verdict_blocks.x: Verdict: the unit economics work (gross margin about 77–81% after GPU and gateway), but the business is fixed-cost heavy, so it only breaks even at about 205 paying customers. In the base case that happens in month 14, with peak cash need of about 2.7 billion toman (about $10,100). Tags: [S] sourced, [D] derived from tagged inputs (recomputed by code), [A] assumption.

r: (a) Instagram and messenger-based sellers with 20–300 DMs a day (clothing, cosmetics, handmade, food) — core. (b) Small online shops with a Divar, Torob or own-site presence that also take orders by DM. (c) Clinics, salons and course sellers that sell by appointment through DM. Not targeted at first: large brands (they build in-house) and sellers under about 10 DMs a day (the saving is too small).

Replies in Persian within seconds, 24 hours a day: price, stock, size, shipping and payment-link answers, with hand-off to the owner for anything it is unsure about. Pro plan (1,000 conversations a month) replaces about 30 hours of manual chatting a month [D: 1,000 × 60% usage × 3 min, 3 min is an A]; at the 1405 minimum wage loaded with 23% employer insurance (about 143,000 toman an hour [D]) that is about 4.29M toman of labour against a 2.49M toman price. Reference point: Divar charges 49,000 toman per ad for its own assistant [S, per research notes].

Instagram professional-account DM (Meta API access for Iranian developers is unverified, see section 6); Rubika, Bale and Eitaa bots (domestic, reachable during whitelisted internet); website chat widget. Acquisition: Instagram ads and creators in the seller niche, seller Telegram/Instagram communities, referral credit (one free month per referral [A]), agency resellers.

Self-serve onboarding in under 30 minutes (connect account, upload price list, test chat). One human customer-success person per 300 customers [A]. Weekly conversation report to the owner. Monthly plan billed in toman, indexed to the exchange rate (see risks).

Monthly subscriptions: Starter 490,000 toman (200 conversations), Pro 2,490,000 (1,000), Business 14,900,000 (5,000) [A, anchored to the labour saving above]. Planned mix 65% / 31% / 4% [A] gives ARPU 1,686,400 toman a month (about $6.36) [D]. Free tier: 15 conversations for 3 months of trial [A].

Domestic GPU inference node (RTX 6000 Ada 48 GB, Sindad plan 150M toman a month [S]); an open-weight 8–9B model tuned on Persian sales dialogues; a Persian product-catalogue retrieval layer; 2 engineers and 1 customer-success hire.
Model quality work in Persian (the largest risk); channel connectors; catalogue ingestion; seller onboarding; keeping messenger APIs and prices up to date.

Domestic GPU/cloud host (Sindad or equivalent); payment gateway (Zarinpal and similar, worst-case 1% fee [S, sources conflict: 0.05%–1%]); seller-community admins and agencies as resellers; bot platforms of Bale and Eitaa.

Fixed: team 159.9M toman a month, GPU node 150M, other infrastructure 10M, accounting 8M, marketing 15M = 342.9M toman a month at full run rate (about $1,293) [D]; one-time setup 150M [A]. Variable: gateway 1% of revenue; extra customer-success hire per 300 customers; extra GPU node whenever the load passes one node's capacity.
[S] open-market rate, 17 Oct 2026; it was about 203,100 on 24 Aug, so +30.6% in under two months [D]
[D] (2 engineers at 50M + 1 customer-success at 30M gross) × 1.23 employer insurance; the gross salaries are [A], the 23% is [S]
[S] Sindad GPU inference plan, listed 14 Sep 2026; the same plan was about $739 at the August rate, so it is rial-priced and its dollar cost falls as the rial falls
[D] 2,658.57 tokens a second [S, A6000 vLLM benchmark, Llama-3.1-8B, 100 concurrent] × 0.8 (Ada vs A6000 and Persian token overhead, [A]) × 30% average utilisation [A]
[D] at 60% quota use [A], after GPU and 1% gateway

revenue.x: Break-even is about 205 paying customers [D: 342.9M ÷ (1,686,400 × 0.99)] with one GPU node and no extra hire. The three scenarios below ramp customers linearly from month 4 to the month-12 figure, then to the month-24 figure. Launch costs (150M setup) fall in month 1.

Customer counts are [A]. For scale, 500 customers would be a small share of the sellers I could find counts for, but those counts conflict (400K active stores vs 1.7M businesses, dates unclear), so the base case is a hypothesis to test with a paid pilot, not a market-sized forecast. In the base case cumulative cash is still −817M toman at month 24, so payback comes after month 24.

sensitivities.x: The model fixes the customer path, so churn does not change these rows; it only changes lifetime value. At 8% monthly churn [A], lifetime revenue per customer is about 20.9M toman [D: 1,686,400 × 0.99 ÷ 0.08]. Modelled acquisition cost is only marketing plus half a customer-success salary, about 0.6–1.9M toman per new customer [D], which leaves out founder sales time, so treat the LTV-to-CAC ratio as an upper bound and measure real CAC in the pilot.

risks.x: Rial drift: the dollar rate rose 14.7% in the first 17 days of October and 30.6% since August [D]. Toman prices need monthly indexing; the GPU cost moves with it, but salaries and ad costs may lag or lead.
Persian quality of an 8–9B model may be too weak for selling; a larger model would need about 2–4 times the GPU cost [A], close to the “GPU price doubles” row.
Whitelisted internet and shutdowns: customers on Instagram lose service during shutdowns, which hits usage-based value.
Competitors (Novin Hub, Artin Bot and similar) exist; their prices were not verified.

unverified.x: Competitor subscription prices for Instagram DM bots in Iran.
Whether Iranian developers can obtain Meta's Advanced Access and Business Verification for the Instagram messaging API; if not, the Instagram channel needs a different route and the segment shrinks.
Bale and Eitaa bot API terms and fees.
The current price of a plain CPU server (not needed for the GPU-based costs above).
Zarinpal's exact fee (sources say 0.05%, 0.5% and 1%; the model uses 1%) and VAT (10% or 12%; the plan prices are shown before VAT).
Real tokens per conversation and Persian throughput: both need a one-week benchmark on the actual node before any commitment.
Check run: all [D] figures above were recomputed by running the cost and revenue model in code on 22 Oct 2026.

bmc.text: GPU داخلی: ۰٫۲۹ گره RTX 6000 Ada 48GB شامل ۲۵٪ بافر پیک (۴۳٬۵۰۰٬۰۰۰ تومان/ماه) + سرورهای CPU/DB داخلی شبکه ملی اطلاعات (۱۷٬۴۰۰٬۰۰۰ تومان/ماه). پشته فنی: Qwen3-14B / DeepSeek-V3 Distill کوانتیزه با آداپتورهای LoRA لحن برند فارسی. مجموعه داده: ساختار محصول ۱۰۰ هزار رتبه برتر دیجی‌کالا و ترب.

bmc.title: فعالیت‌های کلیدی
bmc.text: حفظ دقت LoRA روی ساختار محصول ۱۰۰ هزار رتبه برتر دیجی‌کالا و ترب؛ زنده نگه‌داشتن اتصال‌های پنل فروشندگان دیجی‌کالا، API باسلام و ووکامرس در برابر تغییرات مسیریابی شبکه ملی اطلاعات/BGP؛ اجرای سخت‌گیرانه صورت‌حساب ماهانه و شاخص‌بندی فصلی CPI/ارز برای جلوگیری از فرسایش حاشیه ریالی توسط تورم.

bmc.title: شرکای کلیدی
bmc.text: شرکای توزیع و API: پنل فروشندگان دیجی‌کالا، API باسلام و ووکامرس. زیرساخت: سینداد/افرانت (GPU/شبکه ملی اطلاعات)، زرین‌پال/پی‌پینگ (درگاه شپارک) و معاونت علمی و فناوری (معافیت مالیاتی دانش‌بنیان نوع ۱/۲).

bmc.title: ساختار هزینه (حسابرسی‌شده)
bmc.text: هزینه کامل مستقل: ۳۶۷٬۰۴۲٬۱۵۸ تومان/ماه؛ EBITDA مستقل: ۲۶۱٬۷۶۷٬۸۴۲ تومان/ماه (۴۱٫۶٪). هزینه سبد موتور مشترک (تقسیم توسعه/دفتر بین ۳ ابزار هم‌خانواده): ۳۰۲٬۵۷۲٬۱۵۸ تومان/ماه؛ EBITDA سبد: ۳۲۶٬۲۳۷٬۸۴۲ تومان/ماه (۵۱٫۹٪).

hosting_note: میزبانی ترکیبی: استنتاج پیش‌فرض روی GPU داخلی و شبکه ملی اطلاعات است؛ ChatGPT، Claude یا Gemini فقط برای سرریز تولید متن یا تصویر استودیویی استفاده می‌شوند. داده مالیات، مودیان، پزشکی، حقوقی و احراز هویت هرگز از میزبانی داخلی خارج نمی‌شود.

infrastructure: Sindad/Afranet (GPU/NIN), Zarinpal/PayPing (Shaparak gateway), and Vice-Presidency for Science & Technology (Danesh-Bonyan Type 1/2 tax exemption)

support_scope: human-in-the-loop edge cases and SAYAD/Shaparak billing follow-ups

verdict_blocks.x: Verdict: GPU cost is negligible (about 154 toman per listing), so the business is decided by fixed cost and by whether sellers will pay when free chatbots exist. It breaks even at about 194 paying customers; in the base case that is month 15, with peak cash need of about 2.8 billion toman (about $10,700). The market size and competitor prices could not be verified (section 6), so the customer counts are hypotheses. Tags: [S] sourced, [D] derived and recomputed by code, [A] assumption.

r: (a) Marketplace sellers with 50–2,000 SKUs who list products themselves on Digikala, Basalam or Torob-linked shops — core. (b) Importers and wholesalers adding new catalogue lines every month. (c) Small agencies and freelancers who write listings for several shops (resellers). Not targeted: the largest brands (own content teams) and sellers with under about 20 listings (too little volume to pay a subscription).

Turns a product name, attributes and a photo into a Persian title, description, bullet features, keywords and meta text in the format each marketplace expects, in seconds, in bulk from a spreadsheet. Writing one listing by hand at 20 minutes [A] costs about 47,700 toman of labour at the 1405 minimum wage loaded with 23% employer insurance (143,023 toman an hour [D]); our price is 3,950–5,900 toman per listing, 8–12% of that [D].

Web app with CSV/Excel upload and copy-out per marketplace; WooCommerce and similar plugin; marketplace seller communities and Instagram/Telegram groups; SEO content on Persian search terms; agency partnerships. Direct publishing into Digikala or Basalam panels depends on their APIs and is not assumed.

Self-serve with a brand-voice and category-template setup; one customer-success person per 300 customers [A]; quality guarantee (free regeneration, human-edited samples for the first batch); monthly credits that roll over for one month [A].

Monthly credit packs: Starter 590,000 toman (100 listings), Growth 2,490,000 (500), Pro 7,900,000 (2,000) [A, anchored to the labour cost above]. Mix 60% / 32% / 8% [A] gives ARPU 1,782,800 toman a month (about $6.72) [D]. Free trial: 5 listings.
Persian-tuned 8–9B model on a domestic GPU node (Sindad plan, 150M toman a month [S]); per-category templates and SEO keyword data; 2 engineers and 1 customer-success/editor hire.
Persian quality and factual-accuracy checks (no invented specifications); marketplace format rules and category templates; bulk-processing pipeline; seller onboarding and content marketing.
Domestic GPU/cloud host; payment gateway (Zarinpal and similar, 1% worst case [S, sources conflict]); seller-community admins, agencies and plugin marketplaces as resellers.

Same fixed base as service #1: team 159.9M toman a month, GPU node 150M, other infrastructure 10M, accounting 8M, marketing 15M = 342.9M a month (about $1,293) [D]; one-time setup 150M [A]. Variable: 1% gateway fee and an extra customer-success hire per 300 customers.
[D] (2 engineers at 50M + 1 customer-success/editor at 30M gross, salaries [A]) × 1.23 employer insurance [S]
[S] Sindad GPU inference plan, listed 14 Sep 2026
[A] 800 input (attributes, template) + 900 output (title, description, bullets, keywords)
[D] 70% use [A] of the 100 / 500 / 2,000 quotas, weighted by plan mix

cost_model.x: One GPU node covers up to about 3,460 customers at this usage [D: 972,849 ÷ (266 + 15 trial)], so the node never scales in the 24 months modelled; cost is nearly all people.

revenue.x: Break-even is about 194 paying customers [D: 342.9M ÷ (1,782,800 × 0.99)]. Customers ramp linearly from month 4 to the month-12 figure, then to the month-24 figure; 150M setup falls in month 1.

Customer counts are [A]. The only sourced market figure is Digikala's report for fiscal year 1401 (March 2022 to March 2023), which lists 308,000 sellers and 9.7 million SKUs [S]; it is over three years old. Base-case month-24 customers would be about 0.15% of that seller count [D], but a current count for Digikala and Basalam was not found. Base-case cumulative cash is still −664M toman at month 24 [D].

sensitivities.x: Here a doubled GPU price hurts less than in service #1 because the node serves far more units. Churn is not in the cash rows (the customer path is fixed). At 12% monthly churn [A, higher than #1 because sellers may write a catalogue once and leave], lifetime revenue per customer is about 14.7M toman [D: 1,782,800 × 0.99 ÷ 0.12]. Marketing cost per customer was not modelled separately here; measure it in a pilot.

risks.x: Free substitutes: sellers with a VPN can use ChatGPT, Gemini or Claude directly; our case rests on bulk upload, marketplace formats, Persian SEO and no-VPN access, which must be proven in a pilot.

Marketplace-built tools: Digikala has launched AI shopping features for buyers (the "Dia" assistant); it may add listing-writing tools for sellers, which would remove the need for this service for Digikala sellers. I found no evidence either way for seller-side tools.
Persian quality and factual errors: a wrong specification in a listing can cause returns or penalties; human review costs would raise the editor headcount.
Rial drift: toman prices need monthly indexing (the dollar rate rose 30.6% from 24 Aug to 17 Oct [D]).
Low price per listing (8–12% of the labour cost) leaves room to raise prices if quality is proven.

unverified.x: Current seller counts on Digikala, Basalam and Torob-linked shops; only older figures were found (Digikala 308,000 sellers in FY1401 [S]; Basalam figures in search results are from about 2020, 48,000 sellers, and are not used).
Competitor prices for Persian listing-writing tools, and freelance rates per listing: most Iranian sites block automated reading, so only titles were seen.
Whether any marketplace allows direct publishing by API.
Real tokens per listing and Persian output quality on the actual node.
Zarinpal fee and VAT, as in #1.
Check run: all [D] figures above were recomputed by running the model in code on 22 Oct 2026.

title: پاک‌سازی عکس محصول و تولید پس‌زمینه استودیویی
segment: کسب‌وکار کوچک و متوسط ایرانی، بازار، کلینیک و آژانس B2B
engine: موتور ۵B: بینایی استودیویی مولد، بازطراحی و تایپوگرافی فارسی

bmc.title: بخش‌های مشتری
bmc.text: خریدار هدف: فروشگاه‌های آنلاین (کسب‌وکار کوچک و متوسط ایرانی، بازار، کلینیک و آژانس B2B). جایگزین یا کاهش‌دهنده: عکاسی استودیویی (۱۵۰ تا ۴۰۰ هزار تومان به‌ازای هر عکس). پایه فعال حسابرسی‌شده در ماه ۱۲: ۱۸۸ حساب پرداخت‌کننده (۷۹ پایه، ۹۱ رشد، ۱۸ حرفه‌ای/سازمانی/بسته)، کالیبره‌شده با مقیاس بخش نرم‌افزار ابری ایران (لاتکا) و ریزش ماهانه ۱۰٫۰٪.

bmc.title: ارزش پیشنهادی
bmc.text: جایگزین «عکاسی استودیویی (۱۵۰ تا ۴۰۰ هزار تومان به‌ازای هر عکس)» با کمتر از ۱۵٪ هزینه دستی/جریمه می‌شود. موتور داده: مدل کوانتیزه SDXL/Flux و حذف پس‌زمینه با RMBG-2.0؛ با میزبانی ۱۰۰٪ داخل ایران روی دیتاسنترهای شبکه ملی اطلاعات، تا وبهوک‌های داخلی (بله/ایتا/وب محلی) در قطعی‌های اینترنت بین‌المللی فعال بمانند.

bmc.title: کانال‌ها و کمیسیون‌ها
bmc.text: ورود به بازار عمدتاً از طریق قواعد استودیوی فروشندگان دیجی‌کالا و فروشگاه‌های اینستاگرام به‌همراه ۰٫۵۰ نفر کارشناس فروش سازمانی. مدل: کمیسیون ۱۲٪ شرکا/بازارگاه بر ۶۵٪ از درآمد (۴۳٬۲۸۱٬۲۹۷ تومان در ماه در بهای تمام‌شده) برای انگیزه‌دهی به نمایندگان ERP، آژانس‌ها و فروشگاه‌های اپ.

bmc.title: روابط با مشتری
bmc.text: راه‌اندازی ترکیبی خودخدمت + تلفنی/رباتی. لینک‌های تمدید خودکار پیامکی کاوه‌نگار؛ ۱٫۱۴ نفر متخصص پشتیبانی برای موارد نیازمند دخالت انسان و پیگیری صورت‌حساب صیاد/شپارک.

gtm: قواعد استودیوی فروشندگان دیجی‌کالا و فروشگاه‌های اینستاگرام
driver: مدل کوانتیزه SDXL/Flux و حذف پس‌زمینه با RMBG-2.0
dataset: SDXL/Flux quantized + RMBG-2.0 background removal
stack: Flux.1-Schnell / SDXL کوانتیزه + ControlNet + RMBG-2.0 + رندر برنامه‌نویسی‌شده تایپوگرافی راست‌به‌چپ وزیرمتن/ایران‌سنس
infrastructure: Sindad/Afranet (GPU/NIN), Zarinpal/PayPing (Shaparak gateway), and Vice-Presidency for Science & Technology (Danesh-Bonyan Type 1/2 tax exemption)
dist_partners: Digikala Seller studio rules, Instagram shops
support_scope: human-in-the-loop edge cases and SAYAD/Shaparak billing follow-ups

verdict_blocks.x: Verdict: GPU cost is small (about 598 toman per image, gross margin 87–91%), but the business is fixed-cost heavy and breaks even at about 229 paying customers. In the base case that is month 17, with peak cash need of about 3,381M toman (about $12,700) and +227M toman a month at month 24; the conservative case does not break even within 24 months. Two points change the plan: the popular BRIA RMBG-2.0 cut-out model is licensed non-commercial [S], so the model must be BiRefNet (MIT) or a licensed alternative; and the generative studio-background step must keep the product's shape and label unchanged, which small open image models do not guarantee, so a human check is part of the plan. No Iranian seller count or Iranian competitor price could be verified, so all customer counts are hypotheses [A]. Tags: [S] sourced, [D] derived and recomputed by code, [A] assumption.

r: (a) Instagram, Basalam and Digikala sellers who photograph products on a phone and need white or lifestyle backgrounds — core. (b) Small online shops with 50–2,000 SKUs refreshing catalogues. (c) Photo-editing freelancers and small studios who would resell the tool. Not targeted at first: brands with their own studios and photographers, and sellers with fewer than about 20 products.

Upload a phone photo and get a clean cut-out on white, or a studio or lifestyle background, in seconds and in bulk, at the marketplace image size. One cut-out edited by hand at 5 minutes [A] costs about 11,919 toman of labour at the 1405 minimum wage loaded with 23% employer insurance (143,023 toman an hour [D]); our price is 3,450–4,900 toman per image, 29–41% of that [D]. Foreign reference: remove.bg lists $9 a month for 40 credits (about 2.39M toman, about 59,700 toman per credit [D]) [S, costbench, verified 7 Oct 2026]; it cannot be paid with Iranian cards.

Web app with drag-and-drop and ZIP/CSV bulk upload; Telegram-alternative bots (Bale, Eitaa) for micro-sellers; plugin for WooCommerce-type shops; seller communities and Instagram creators; photography and ad agencies as resellers.

Self-serve with free trial of 10 images; before-and-after samples on the customer's own product; free re-run when the output changes the product; one customer-success person per 300 customers [A]; monthly credits that roll over one month [A].

Image packs per month: Starter 490,000 toman (100 images), Growth 1,990,000 (500), Pro 6,900,000 (2,000) [A, anchored to the labour saving above]. Mix 55% / 37% / 8% [A] gives ARPU 1,557,800 toman a month (about $5.87) [D].

Domestic GPU node (RTX 6000 Ada 48 GB, Sindad plan 150M toman a month [S]); BiRefNet cut-out model (MIT licence [S, Hugging Face model page]); a Stable-Diffusion-class background model whose licence must be checked before launch; Persian web app; 2 engineers and 1 customer-success/QA hire.

Cut-out quality on hair, glass, jewellery and transparent packaging; marketplace size and background templates; keeping the product unchanged in generated scenes; bulk pipeline and storage; seller onboarding.
Domestic GPU/cloud host; payment gateway (Zarinpal and similar, worst-case 1% fee [S, sources conflict: 0.05%–1%]); photography studios and agencies as resellers; marketplace seller communities.

Fixed: team 159.9M toman a month, GPU node 150M, storage and bandwidth 15M, accounting 8M, marketing 20M = 352.9M toman a month (about $1,330) [D]; one-time setup 150M [A]. Variable: 1% gateway fee, an extra customer-success hire per 300 customers, an extra GPU node when load passes one node's capacity.
[D] (2 engineers at 50M + 1 customer-success/QA at 30M gross, salaries [A]) × 1.23 employer insurance [S]
[S] Sindad GPU inference plan, listed 14 Sep 2026

[A] mix of 70% cut-outs at 1 s and 30% studio scenes at 8 s. The 8 s is 3.5 s (midpoint of the 3–4 s per SDXL 1024×1024 image, 20 steps, on RTX 6000 Ada [S, Jarvislabs GPU guide]) × 1.5 for 30 steps and masking × 1.5 for two candidates and retries. The 1 s cut-out time is an assumption: the BiRefNet page gives no speed figure
[A] same as #1; image jobs are bursty
[D] 70% use [A] of the 100 / 500 / 2,000 quotas, weighted by plan mix

cost_model.x: One GPU node covers about 865 customers at this usage [D: 250,839 ÷ (280 + 10 trial images)], so a second node is needed only in the optimistic case near month 24.

revenue.x: Break-even is about 229 paying customers [D: 352.9M ÷ (1,557,800 × 0.99)]. Customers ramp linearly from month 4 to the month-12 figure, then to the month-24 figure; the 150M setup falls in month 1.

Customer counts are [A]. No sourced count of Iranian online sellers who need product photos was found. The only sourced seller figure is Digikala's FY1401 (March 2022 to March 2023) report of 308,000 sellers [S]; base-case month-24 customers would be about 0.13% of it [D], but that count is over three years old and many of those sellers already use studios or phones. Base-case cumulative cash is still −2,461M toman at month 24 [D], so payback comes after month 24.

sensitivities.x: Churn is not in the cash rows (the customer path is fixed). At 10% monthly churn [A, between #1 and #2: shops need photos in bursts] lifetime revenue per customer is about 15.4M toman [D: 1,557,800 × 0.99 ÷ 0.10]. Marketing per customer was not modelled separately; measure it in a pilot.

risks.x: Licence: BRIA RMBG-2.0 is CC BY-NC 4.0, so commercial use needs a commercial agreement with BRIA [S, Hugging Face model page]; BiRefNet is MIT [S] and is the planned model. The licence of whichever generative background model is used must be read before launch.
Product fidelity: a generated background that alters the product, colour or logo causes returns and disputes; this needs human sampling and may add editor headcount.

Free and foreign substitutes: phone-based editors and VPN-accessible tools (remove.bg, Canva-type tools) are available to sellers with a VPN; the case rests on bulk processing, marketplace sizes, Persian support and toman payment.
Marketplace-built tools: Digikala or Basalam could add photo clean-up to their seller panels; I found no evidence either way.
Rial drift: toman prices need monthly indexing (the dollar rate rose 30.6% from 24 Aug to 17 Oct 2026 [D]); the GPU plan is rial-priced.
Throughput is an assumption: a real benchmark of the chosen pipeline on the rented node could move the GPU cost per image by a factor of two or more, which the GPU-doubles row covers.

unverified.x: The number of Iranian online shops and marketplace sellers that need product photos; the enamad and e-commerce statistics pages I found were blocked from automated reading or lacked figures.

Prices of Iranian product-photography studios per photo and of Iranian background-removal tools: the pages found were blocked from automated reading, so the 5-minute labour figure is an assumption and no Iranian competitor price is quoted.
Whether remove.bg's credit equals one image (the page does not say).
Real GPU seconds per cut-out with BiRefNet and per studio scene on the actual node, and the licence of the chosen generative model.
Zarinpal fee and VAT, as in #1.
Check run: all [D] figures above were recomputed by running the model in code on 23 Oct 2026.

title: عامل پیگیری CRM: پیش‌نویس پیگیری، زمان‌بندی تماس و امتیازدهی سرنخ
buyer: کسب‌وکارهای کوچک و متوسط دارای تیم فروش
segment: کسب‌وکار کوچک و متوسط ایرانی، بازار، کلینیک و آژانس B2B
engine: موتور ۶: عامل‌های گردش‌کار چندپلتفرمی و خودکارساز انطباق

bmc.title: بخش‌های مشتری
bmc.text: خریدار هدف: کسب‌وکارهای کوچک و متوسط دارای تیم فروش (کسب‌وکار کوچک و متوسط ایرانی، بازار، کلینیک و آژانس B2B). جایگزین یا کاهش‌دهنده: هماهنگ‌کننده فروش تازه‌کار (۲۰ میلیون تومان در ماه). پایه فعال حسابرسی‌شده در ماه ۱۲: ۱۸۸ حساب پرداخت‌کننده (۹۶ پایه، ۶۷ رشد، ۲۵ حرفه‌ای/سازمانی/بسته)، کالیبره‌شده با مقیاس بخش نرم‌افزار ابری ایران (لاتکا) و ریزش ماهانه ۶٫۸٪.

bmc.title: ارزش پیشنهادی
bmc.text: جایگزین «هماهنگ‌کننده فروش تازه‌کار (۲۰ میلیون تومان در ماه)» با کمتر از ۱۵٪ هزینه دستی/جریمه می‌شود. موتور داده: گزارش‌های تماس و پیگیری فروش B2B فارسی؛ با میزبانی ۱۰۰٪ داخل ایران روی دیتاسنترهای شبکه ملی اطلاعات، تا وبهوک‌های داخلی (بله/ایتا/وب محلی) در قطعی‌های اینترنت بین‌المللی فعال بمانند.

bmc.title: کانال‌ها و کمیسیون‌ها
bmc.text: ورود به بازار عمدتاً از طریق وبهوک‌های دیدار CRM، پیام‌گستر و سرو CRM به‌همراه ۰٫۶۵ نفر کارشناس فروش سازمانی. مدل: کمیسیون ۱۸٪ شرکا/بازارگاه بر ۶۵٪ از درآمد (۶۵٬۷۶۱٬۶۳۴ تومان در ماه در بهای تمام‌شده) برای انگیزه‌دهی به نمایندگان ERP، آژانس‌ها و فروشگاه‌های اپ.

bmc.title: روابط با مشتری
bmc.text: راه‌اندازی ترکیبی خودخدمت + تلفنی/رباتی. لینک‌های تمدید خودکار پیامکی کاوه‌نگار؛ ۱٫۲۴ نفر متخصص پشتیبانی برای موارد نیازمند دخالت انسان و پیگیری صورت‌حساب صیاد/شپارک.

bmc.title: جریان‌های درآمد (حسابرسی‌شده)
bmc.text: صورتحساب ماهانه به تومان (به‌ازای هر کاربر): پایه ۱٬۵۵۰٬۰۰۰ تومان/ماه | رشد ۳٬۰۹۰٬۰۰۰ | حرفه‌ای/سازمانی ۶٬۰۰۰٬۰۰۰ + بسته‌های مصرف (۴۴۰٬۰۰۰ تومان/ماه میانگین). MRR ناخالص صورتحساب‌شده: ۵۸۸٬۵۵۰٬۰۰۰ تومان/ماه؛ MRR خالص وصول‌شده پس از ۴٫۵٪ ذخیره مطالبات مشکوک/تأخیر چک: ۵۶۲٬۰۶۵٬۲۵۰ تومان/ماه.

bmc.title: منابع کلیدی
bmc.text: GPU داخلی: ۰٫۳۵ گره RTX 6000 Ada 48GB شامل ۲۵٪ بافر پیک (۵۲٬۵۰۰٬۰۰۰ تومان/ماه) + سرورهای CPU/DB داخلی شبکه ملی اطلاعات (۲۲٬۹۰۰٬۰۰۰ تومان/ماه). پشته فنی: عامل فراخوانی تابع Qwen3-14B + صف Temporal/Celery + رله وبهوک داخلی (بله/ایتا/مودیان/ERP). مجموعه داده: گزارش‌های تماس و پیگیری فروش B2B فارسی.

bmc.title: فعالیت‌های کلیدی
bmc.text: حفظ دقت LoRA روی گزارش‌های تماس و پیگیری فروش B2B فارسی؛ زنده نگه‌داشتن اتصال‌های وبهوک‌های دیدار CRM، پیام‌گستر و سرو CRM در برابر تغییرات مسیریابی شبکه ملی اطلاعات/BGP؛ اجرای سخت‌گیرانه صورت‌حساب ماهانه و شاخص‌بندی فصلی CPI/ارز برای جلوگیری از فرسایش حاشیه ریالی توسط تورم.

bmc.title: شرکای کلیدی
bmc.text: شرکای توزیع و API: وبهوک‌های دیدار CRM، پیام‌گستر و سرو CRM. زیرساخت: سینداد/افرانت (GPU/شبکه ملی اطلاعات)، زرین‌پال/پی‌پینگ (درگاه شپارک) و معاونت علمی و فناوری (معافیت مالیاتی دانش‌بنیان نوع ۱/۲).

bmc.title: ساختار هزینه (حسابرسی‌شده)
bmc.text: هزینه کامل مستقل: ۴۴۹٬۶۳۶٬۸۶۴ تومان/ماه؛ EBITDA مستقل: ۱۳۸٬۹۱۳٬۱۳۶ تومان/ماه (۲۳٫۶٪). هزینه سبد موتور مشترک (تقسیم توسعه/دفتر بین ۳ ابزار هم‌خانواده): ۳۶۷٬۱۹۶٬۸۶۴ تومان/ماه؛ EBITDA سبد: ۲۲۱٬۳۵۳٬۱۳۶ تومان/ماه (۳۷٫۶٪).

verdict_blocks.x: Verdict: the unit economics are strong (GPU about 54,400 toman per seat-month, gross margin 91–92%), but this is a B2B product with a sales hire and a larger team, so fixed cost is 457.5M toman a month and break-even needs about 75 paying companies. The base case (30 companies at month 12, 100 at month 24) breaks even only in month 21, with peak cash need of about 5,427M toman (about $20,500) and +112M toman a month at month 24; the conservative case never breaks even and a doubled GPU price, 30% lower prices or 50% fewer customers each push break-even past month 24. The market is contested by established Iranian CRMs that are adding AI themselves (Didar, per search-result headlines), and no CRM price list or seat count could be verified, so customer counts are hypotheses [A]. Lead scoring on a small company's own data is weak statistically; the realistic product is follow-up drafting and reminders, which small open Persian models can do at acceptable quality only after testing. Tags: [S] sourced, [D] derived and recomputed by code, [A] assumption.

r: (a) Small and mid-size companies with 3–30 salespeople selling by phone and messenger (building products, B2B distributors, training and services firms, real-estate and car dealers) — core. (b) Agencies and clinics with appointment follow-ups. (c) Companies already on a CRM that want an add-on layer. Not targeted: large enterprises with in-house IT, and one-person sellers (service #1 covers them).

After each call or chat, the agent writes the Persian follow-up message, proposes the next call time, reminds the rep, and ranks leads by recency and engagement. A rep spending 20 hours a month on follow-up admin [A] costs about 2.86M toman of loaded labour at the 1405 minimum wage with 23% employer insurance (143,023 toman an hour [D]); our price is 663,000–830,000 toman per seat, 23–29% of that [D]. Foreign reference: CRM tools list $12 to over $200 per user per month, Salesforce at $25 [S, Capterra pricing report, 2024 update]; $12 is about 3.18M toman at 265,295 [D] and is not payable with Iranian cards.

Web app plus integrations with Iranian CRMs and Google Sheets-type exports; Rubika/Bale/Eitaa and SMS reminders for reps; direct B2B outreach by one sales hire; sales-training and business-community partners; referrals from companies' accountants and IT contractors.

Assisted onboarding in the first week (import contacts, set tone and scripts); monthly usage review; one customer-success person per 60 companies [A]; per-company admin controls and an audit log of every message the agent drafted.

Monthly plans by company size: Team 2,490,000 toman (3 seats), Growth 7,900,000 (10 seats), Business 19,900,000 (30 seats) [A, anchored to the labour saving above]. Mix 55% / 35% / 10% [A] gives ARPU 6,124,500 toman a month (about $23.09) and 8.2 seats per company [D]. 14-day free trial.

Domestic GPU node (RTX 6000 Ada 48 GB, Sindad plan 150M toman a month [S]); Persian follow-up and call-summary prompts tuned on real sales conversations; CRM connectors; 3 engineers, 1 sales hire, 1 customer-success hire.
Connector maintenance for Iranian CRMs; message quality in Persian business register; privacy controls on customer contact data; B2B sales and onboarding; measuring lead-to-sale lift for customers.

Iranian CRM vendors and ERP resellers (integration channel and also potential competitors); domestic GPU/cloud host; SMS provider for reminders (fees not modelled, see section 6); payment gateway (Zarinpal and similar, worst-case 1% fee [S, sources conflict: 0.05%–1%]).

Fixed: team 264.5M toman a month, GPU node 150M, infrastructure 10M, accounting 8M, marketing 25M = 457.5M toman a month (about $1,724) [D]; one-time setup 200M [A]. Variable: 1% gateway fee, an extra customer-success hire per 60 companies, an extra GPU node when load passes one node's capacity.
[D] (3 engineers at 50M + 1 sales at 35M + 1 customer-success at 30M gross, salaries [A]) × 1.23 employer insurance [S]
[S] Sindad GPU inference plan, listed 14 Sep 2026
[A] 200 AI actions (follow-up drafts, call summaries, lead notes) × 3,000 tokens (2,500 input with customer history, 500 output); text workload, so the same throughput proxy as #1 applies
[D] 2,658.57 [S, A6000 vLLM benchmark, Llama-3.1-8B, 100 concurrent] × 0.8 × 30% utilisation [A]
[D] plan mix weighted by 3 / 10 / 30 seats, all seats active [A]

cost_model.x: One node covers about 286 companies at this usage [D: 2,756 ÷ (8.2 + 1.5 trial seat-months)], so no second node is needed in any scenario.

revenue.x: Break-even is about 75 paying companies [D: 457.5M ÷ (6,124,500 × 0.99)]. Customers ramp linearly from month 4 to the month-12 figure, then to the month-24 figure; the 200M setup falls in month 1.

Customer counts are [A]. The only comparable is Didar CRM, which per the research notes behind this document reports about 3,000 active customers after starting in 2019; base-case month-24 customers would be 3.3% of that [D]. Search-result headlines also say Didar's CEO states that 91% of Iranian businesses do not use a CRM and that Didar raised 90 billion toman [S, headlines only; the zoomit pages are blocked from automated reading and I did not see dates]. Base-case cumulative cash is still −5,191M toman at month 24 [D], so payback comes after month 24.

sensitivities.x: Churn is not in the cash rows (the customer path is fixed). At 5% monthly churn [A, B2B subscriptions are stickier than seller tools] lifetime revenue per company is about 121.3M toman [D: 6,124,500 × 0.99 ÷ 0.05]. That lifetime value is large relative to the 25M monthly marketing budget, so the plan rests on whether the sales hire can close about 5 new companies a month on average at the base-case pace [D: 100 companies over 21 months, before churn]; this was not tested.

risks.x: Incumbents: established Iranian CRMs can add the same drafting and scoring features; a search-result headline says Didar's CEO is aiming for an AI-centred product [S, headline only]. Their prices were not verified.

Data sensitivity: the agent reads customer phone numbers and conversations; a domestic-hosting requirement or customer reluctance to share call notes would slow sales. I could not verify any specific rule.
Lead scoring value: with a few hundred leads per company, a model learns little; scoring may be limited to rule-based recency and engagement signals, reducing the value claim.
Rial drift: the dollar rate rose 30.6% from 24 Aug to 17 Oct 2026 [D]; prices need monthly indexing while salaries may lag.
Sales cycle: B2B pilots can take 2–3 months [A], pushing real break-even later than the linear ramp assumes.

How many Iranian companies have 3–30 salespeople; no sourced count was found.

verdict_blocks.x: Verdict: GPU cost is negligible (about 136 toman per copy pack, gross margin 97%), so the result is decided by fixed cost and by how many agencies and shops will pay a subscription for something free chatbots also do. It breaks even at about 174 paying customers; in the base case that is month 16, with peak cash need of about 3,110M toman (about $11,700) and +308M toman a month at month 24. The conservative case does not break even in 24 months, and with 50% fewer customers the base case only just reaches break-even at month 24. The market size, SMS and ad-placement rules for Iran, and competitor prices could not be verified (section 6), so customer counts are hypotheses [A]. Telegram is a filtered platform in Iran and its ad market depends on VPN use, which I did not size. Tags: [S] sourced, [D] derived and recomputed by code, [A] assumption.

r: (a) Small digital-marketing agencies and freelancers writing for several shops — core. (b) Online shops and clinics that send their own SMS and Telegram/Bale/Eitaa channel posts. (c) SMS panel and ad-network resellers that want to bundle copywriting. Not targeted: large agencies with senior copywriters and brands with fixed brand guidelines (they need review workflows first).

From a product, offer and audience the tool produces a pack of five SMS variants within the length limit, three channel posts and two native-ad headlines in Persian, in seconds, with a Persian-calendar occasion calendar. A copywriter spending 30 minutes per pack [A] costs about 71,500 toman of labour at the 1405 minimum wage loaded with 23% employer insurance (143,023 toman an hour [D]); our price is 3,950–5,900 toman per pack, 5.5–8.3% of that [D]. Foreign reference: Jasper lists $59 per user per month, about 15.65M toman at 265,295 [D] [S, costbench, last verified 1 Jul 2026]; it is not payable with Iranian cards.

Web app and Telegram-alternative bots (Bale, Eitaa, Rubika); integration with SMS panels; Persian marketing communities and Instagram; agency partnerships; content marketing on occasion calendars (Nowruz, Yalda, Black Friday-type sales).
Self-serve with brand-voice saved profiles; 5 free packs on signup; A/B test tracker that records which variant the customer used; one customer-success person per 300 customers [A].

Monthly credit packs: Starter 590,000 toman (100 packs), Studio 2,490,000 (500), Agency 7,900,000 (2,000) [A, anchored to the labour cost above]. Mix 55% / 35% / 10% [A] gives ARPU 1,986,000 toman a month (about $7.49) [D].

Fixed: team 159.9M toman a month, GPU node 150M, infrastructure 10M, accounting 8M, marketing 15M = 342.9M toman a month (about $1,293) [D]; one-time setup 150M [A]. Variable: 1% gateway fee and an extra customer-success hire per 300 customers; no per-pack cost other than GPU.

revenue.x: Break-even is about 174 paying customers [D: 342.9M ÷ (1,986,000 × 0.99)]. Customers ramp linearly from month 4 to the month-12 figure, then to the month-24 figure; the 150M setup falls in month 1.

risks.x: Free substitutes: any user with a VPN can ask ChatGPT, Gemini or Claude for the same copy; the case rests on Persian tone, character-limit and occasion templates, no-VPN access and toman payment.
Competition from SMS panels: providers that already hold advertisers' accounts could add copywriting as a free feature, which would remove the stand-alone price.

title: پایش قیمت رقبا با پیشنهاد تغییر قیمت
segment: کسب‌وکار کوچک و متوسط ایرانی، بازار، کلینیک و آژانس B2B
engine: موتور ۴: شاخص‌بندی تورم، قیمت‌گذاری و پیش‌بینی تقاضا

bmc.title: بخش‌های مشتری
bmc.text: خریدار هدف: فروشندگان بازارگاه (کسب‌وکار کوچک و متوسط ایرانی، بازار، کلینیک و آژانس B2B). جایگزین یا کاهش‌دهنده: بررسی دستی قیمت‌ها (۱۵ میلیون تومان در ماه هزینه کارکنان). پایه فعال حسابرسی‌شده در ماه ۱۲: ۱۸۴ حساب پرداخت‌کننده (۷۴ پایه، ۹۱ رشد، ۱۹ حرفه‌ای/سازمانی/بسته)، کالیبره‌شده با مقیاس بخش نرم‌افزار ابری ایران (لاتکا) و ریزش ماهانه ۶٫۵٪.

bmc.title: ارزش پیشنهادی
bmc.text: جایگزین «بررسی دستی قیمت‌ها (۱۵ میلیون تومان در ماه هزینه کارکنان)» با کمتر از ۱۵٪ هزینه دستی/جریمه می‌شود. موتور داده: قواعد کشش قیمتی لحظه‌ای کالا و بای‌باکس؛ با میزبانی ۱۰۰٪ داخل ایران روی دیتاسنترهای شبکه ملی اطلاعات، تا وبهوک‌های داخلی (بله/ایتا/وب محلی) در قطعی‌های اینترنت بین‌المللی فعال بمانند.

bmc.title: کانال‌ها و کمیسیون‌ها
bmc.text: ورود به بازار عمدتاً از طریق APIهای فروشندگان ترب، ایمالز و دیجی‌کالا به‌همراه پروکسی به‌همراه ۰٫۶۰ نفر کارشناس فروش سازمانی. مدل: کمیسیون ۱۵٪ شرکا/بازارگاه بر ۶۵٪ از درآمد (۵۷٬۵۸۱٬۷۰۱ تومان در ماه در بهای تمام‌شده) برای انگیزه‌دهی به نمایندگان ERP، آژانس‌ها و فروشگاه‌های اپ.

bmc.title: روابط با مشتری
bmc.text: راه‌اندازی ترکیبی خودخدمت + تلفنی/رباتی. لینک‌های تمدید خودکار پیامکی کاوه‌نگار؛ ۱٫۰۸ نفر متخصص پشتیبانی برای موارد نیازمند دخالت انسان و پیگیری صورت‌حساب صیاد/شپارک.

bmc.title: جریان‌های درآمد (حسابرسی‌شده)
bmc.text: صورتحساب ماهانه به تومان (ماهانه بر اساس تعداد کالا): پایه ۱٬۴۰۰٬۰۰۰ تومان/ماه | رشد ۳٬۳۱۰٬۰۰۰ | حرفه‌ای/سازمانی ۶٬۴۰۰٬۰۰۰ + بسته‌های مصرف (۵۰۰٬۰۰۰ تومان/ماه میانگین). MRR ناخالص صورتحساب‌شده: ۶۱۸٬۴۱۰٬۰۰۰ تومان/ماه؛ MRR خالص وصول‌شده پس از ۴٫۵٪ ذخیره مطالبات مشکوک/تأخیر چک: ۵۹۰٬۵۸۱٬۵۵۰ تومان/ماه.

bmc.title: منابع کلیدی
bmc.text: GPU داخلی: ۰٫۲۳ گره RTX 6000 Ada 48GB شامل ۲۵٪ بافر پیک (۳۴٬۵۰۰٬۰۰۰ تومان/ماه) + سرورهای CPU/DB داخلی شبکه ملی اطلاعات (۲۵٬۹۰۰٬۰۰۰ تومان/ماه). پشته فنی: LightGBM / Prophet با فصلیت جلالی + حل‌کننده قید OR-Tools + توضیح‌دهنده Qwen3-8B روی CPU/GPU مشترک. مجموعه داده: قواعد کشش قیمتی لحظه‌ای کالا و بای‌باکس.

bmc.title: فعالیت‌های کلیدی
bmc.text: حفظ دقت LoRA روی قواعد کشش قیمتی لحظه‌ای کالا و بای‌باکس؛ زنده نگه‌داشتن اتصال‌های APIهای فروشندگان ترب، ایمالز و دیجی‌کالا به‌همراه پروکسی در برابر تغییرات مسیریابی شبکه ملی اطلاعات/BGP؛ اجرای سخت‌گیرانه صورت‌حساب ماهانه و شاخص‌بندی فصلی CPI/ارز برای جلوگیری از فرسایش حاشیه ریالی توسط تورم.

bmc.title: شرکای کلیدی
bmc.text: شرکای توزیع و API: APIهای فروشندگان ترب، ایمالز و دیجی‌کالا به‌همراه پروکسی. زیرساخت: سینداد/افرانت (GPU/شبکه ملی اطلاعات)، زرین‌پال/پی‌پینگ (درگاه شپارک) و معاونت علمی و فناوری (معافیت مالیاتی دانش‌بنیان نوع ۱/۲).

bmc.title: ساختار هزینه (حسابرسی‌شده)
bmc.text: هزینه کامل مستقل: ۴۰۷٬۲۴۰٬۶۳۴ تومان/ماه؛ EBITDA مستقل: ۲۱۱٬۱۶۹٬۳۶۶ تومان/ماه (۳۴٫۱٪). هزینه سبد موتور مشترک (تقسیم توسعه/دفتر بین ۳ ابزار هم‌خانواده): ۳۳۰٬۷۱۰٬۶۳۴ تومان/ماه؛ EBITDA سبد: ۲۸۷٬۶۹۹٬۳۶۶ تومان/ماه (۴۶٫۵٪).

verdict_blocks.x: Verdict: this is mostly a data-collection product, not a GPU product: the variable cost is scraping servers (about 214 toman per SKU-month, gross margin 90–96%), and buying the data from a third-party scraper instead would cost about 66,850 toman per SKU-month [D] and destroy the margin, so the company must run its own collectors. It breaks even at about 211 paying sellers; in the base case that is month 17, with peak cash need of about 2,292M toman (about $8,600) and +127M toman a month at month 24, a thin margin. The conservative case and the 50%-fewer-customers case never break even, and a 30% price cut leaves break-even at month 24 with +5M profit. The service depends on marketplaces tolerating automated price collection, which I could not confirm (the Torob scraper listing says Torob's search API only answers from inside Iran [S]); the AI part (matching products across shops, explaining suggestions) is a small share of the work. Customer counts are hypotheses [A]. Tags: [S] sourced, [D] derived and recomputed by code, [A] assumption.

r: (a) Marketplace sellers with 50–3,000 SKUs on Digikala, Basalam or their own sites who lose sales to a cheaper competitor — core. (b) Wholesalers and importers of electronics, mobile accessories and small appliances where prices move daily with the exchange rate. (c) Repricing agencies. Not targeted: sellers with under about 50 SKUs and brands that set one fixed price.

Tracks competitor prices for each SKU four times a day, alerts when a competitor undercuts, and suggests a price that respects the seller's cost and minimum margin. A seller checking each SKU by hand for 1 minute a week [A] spends about 4 minutes per SKU-month, about 9,535 toman of labour at the 1405 minimum wage loaded with 23% employer insurance (143,023 toman an hour [D]); our price is 1,967–5,800 toman per SKU-month, 21–61% of that [D]. Foreign reference: Prisync lists $99 a month for up to 100 products (URL-based Professional plan), about 26.3M toman at 265,295 or about 262,600 toman per product [D] [S, Prisync pricing page, opened 23 Oct 2026]; it is not payable with Iranian cards.

Web dashboard with Excel/CSV upload of the seller's catalogue; Telegram-alternative bot alerts (Bale, Eitaa); API or plugin for Iranian store platforms; seller communities and import/wholesale groups; referral credit [A].

Self-serve; weekly digest of price position; one customer-success person per 300 customers [A]; rules the seller sets (never below cost plus margin) so that suggestions are never auto-applied without consent.

Monthly by SKU count: Starter 290,000 toman (50 SKUs), Growth 1,490,000 (500), Pro 5,900,000 (3,000) [A, anchored to the labour saving above]. Mix 60% / 33% / 7% [A] gives ARPU 1,078,700 toman a month (about $4.07) [D]. 14-day free trial of 20 SKUs [A].

Own collection servers inside Iran (4 vCPU / 8 GB class, priced at 17M toman a month [A]); a product-matching model (names and attributes across shops); price-history database; 2 engineers and 1 customer-success hire.
Keeping collectors working as marketplace pages change; matching the same product across shops with different names; spotting fake or out-of-stock listings; rules engine for suggested prices.

Domestic cloud host; payment gateway (Zarinpal and similar, worst-case 1% fee [S, sources conflict: 0.05%–1%]); marketplace seller panels or APIs where available (not verified); seller communities as resellers.

Fixed: team 159.9M toman a month, collection server 17M, database, storage and proxy-type costs 25M, accounting 8M, marketing 15M = 224.9M toman a month (about $848) [D]; one-time setup 120M [A]. Variable: 1% gateway fee, an extra collection server per 224 customers [D], an extra customer-success hire per 300 customers.

[A] anchored on Arvan Cloud's 4 vCPU / 8 GB / 250 GB plan listed at €54 a month, added to the whtop price list on 9 Nov 2025 [S]; converting at an assumed €1 = $1.17 [A] gives about 16.8M toman. No toman price list could be read, see section 6

[D] team 159.9M + server 17M + database and storage 25M + accounting 8M + marketing 15M

cost_model.x: One server covers about 224 customers at this usage [D: 79,380 ÷ (344.2 + 10 trial SKU-months)], so a second server is added at about 225 customers and a fourth by about 850 customers.

revenue.x: Break-even is about 211 paying customers [D: 224.9M ÷ (1,078,700 × 0.99)]. Customers ramp linearly from month 4 to the month-12 figure, then to the month-24 figure; the 120M setup falls in month 1.

Customer counts are [A]. The only sourced seller figure is Digikala's FY1401 (March 2022 to March 2023) report of 308,000 sellers [S]; base-case month-24 customers would be about 0.12% of it [D], but that count is over three years old and most sellers have few SKUs or do not reprice. Base-case cumulative cash is still −1,784M toman at month 24 [D], so payback comes after month 24.

sensitivities.x: Churn is not in the cash rows (the customer path is fixed). At 6% monthly churn [A, price tracking is used continuously but sellers drop it when margins vanish] lifetime revenue per customer is about 17.8M toman [D: 1,078,700 × 0.99 ÷ 0.06]. Marketing cost per customer was not modelled separately; measure it in a pilot.

risks.x: Access to marketplace data: Digikala, Torob and Basalam may block automated collection or change page structure; the Torob scraper listing states that Torob's search API does not answer from outside Iran [S], so collectors must run on Iranian servers. I could not verify any marketplace's terms on automated access or whether a seller API with competitor prices exists.
Marketplace-native tools: marketplaces already show sellers how their price compares with others; if they add alerts or auto-repricing, stand-alone value falls.
Race to the bottom: a repricing tool can push sellers into price wars and margin loss; suggestions must respect a minimum margin, and customers may blame the tool.
Matching errors: comparing non-identical products (colour, warranty, seller rating) gives wrong suggestions; human review of low-confidence matches adds cost.
Rial drift: toman prices need monthly indexing (the dollar rate rose 30.6% from 24 Aug to 17 Oct 2026 [D]); prices of the goods being monitored move with it, which raises the value of fast alerts.

title: فهرست قیمت تورم‌آگاه: بازقیمت‌گذاری کاتالوگ بر اساس نرخ ارز و شاخص هزینه
segment: کسب‌وکار کوچک و متوسط ایرانی، بازار، کلینیک و آژانس B2B
engine: موتور ۴: شاخص‌بندی تورم، قیمت‌گذاری و پیش‌بینی تقاضا

bmc.title: بخش‌های مشتری
bmc.text: خریدار هدف: فروشگاه‌ها، عمده‌فروشان و تولیدکنندگان (کسب‌وکار کوچک و متوسط ایرانی، بازار، کلینیک و آژانس B2B). جایگزین یا کاهش‌دهنده: زیان حاشیه ناشی از تأخیر در بازقیمت‌گذاری (۵ تا ۸ درصد زیان درآمد). پایه فعال حسابرسی‌شده در ماه ۱۲: ۲۱۳ حساب پرداخت‌کننده (۸۴ پایه، ۱۰۴ رشد، ۲۵ حرفه‌ای/سازمانی/بسته)، کالیبره‌شده با مقیاس بخش نرم‌افزار ابری ایران (لاتکا) و ریزش ماهانه ۶٫۵٪.

bmc.title: ارزش پیشنهادی
bmc.text: جایگزین «زیان حاشیه ناشی از تأخیر در بازقیمت‌گذاری (۵ تا ۸ درصد زیان درآمد)» با کمتر از ۱۵٪ هزینه دستی/جریمه می‌شود. موتور داده: قواعد عبور هزینه BOM و نرخ ارز چندمنبعی؛ با میزبانی ۱۰۰٪ داخل ایران روی دیتاسنترهای شبکه ملی اطلاعات، تا وبهوک‌های داخلی (بله/ایتا/وب محلی) در قطعی‌های اینترنت بین‌المللی فعال بمانند.

bmc.title: کانال‌ها و کمیسیون‌ها
bmc.text: ورود به بازار عمدتاً از طریق فیدهای ارزی بن‌بست و TGJU، هلو، سپیدار و ووکامرس به‌همراه ۰٫۶۰ نفر کارشناس فروش سازمانی. مدل: کمیسیون ۱۵٪ شرکا/بازارگاه بر ۶۵٪ از درآمد (۶۹٬۳۵۶٬۷۰۷ تومان در ماه در بهای تمام‌شده) برای انگیزه‌دهی به نمایندگان ERP، آژانس‌ها و فروشگاه‌های اپ.

bmc.title: روابط با مشتری
bmc.text: راه‌اندازی ترکیبی خودخدمت + تلفنی/رباتی. لینک‌های تمدید خودکار پیامکی کاوه‌نگار؛ ۱٫۱۳ نفر متخصص پشتیبانی برای موارد نیازمند دخالت انسان و پیگیری صورت‌حساب صیاد/شپارک.

bmc.title: جریان‌های درآمد (حسابرسی‌شده)
bmc.text: صورتحساب ماهانه به تومان (ماهانه): پایه ۱٬۳۲۵٬۰۰۰ تومان/ماه | رشد ۳٬۴۲۰٬۰۰۰ | حرفه‌ای/سازمانی ۶٬۶۰۰٬۰۰۰ + بسته‌های مصرف (۵۳۰٬۰۰۰ تومان/ماه میانگین). MRR ناخالص صورتحساب‌شده: ۷۴۴٬۸۷۰٬۰۰۰ تومان/ماه؛ MRR خالص وصول‌شده پس از ۴٫۵٪ ذخیره مطالبات مشکوک/تأخیر چک: ۷۱۱٬۳۵۰٬۸۵۰ تومان/ماه.

bmc.title: منابع کلیدی
bmc.text: GPU داخلی: ۰٫۲۷ گره RTX 6000 Ada 48GB شامل ۲۵٪ بافر پیک (۴۰٬۵۰۰٬۰۰۰ تومان/ماه) + سرورهای CPU/DB داخلی شبکه ملی اطلاعات (۲۷٬۵۰۰٬۰۰۰ تومان/ماه). پشته فنی: LightGBM / Prophet با فصلیت جلالی + حل‌کننده قید OR-Tools + توضیح‌دهنده Qwen3-8B روی CPU/GPU مشترک. مجموعه داده: قواعد عبور هزینه BOM و نرخ ارز چندمنبعی.

bmc.title: فعالیت‌های کلیدی
bmc.text: حفظ دقت LoRA روی قواعد عبور هزینه BOM و نرخ ارز چندمنبعی؛ زنده نگه‌داشتن اتصال‌های فیدهای ارزی بن‌بست و TGJU، هلو، سپیدار و ووکامرس در برابر تغییرات مسیریابی شبکه ملی اطلاعات/BGP؛ اجرای سخت‌گیرانه صورت‌حساب ماهانه و شاخص‌بندی فصلی CPI/ارز برای جلوگیری از فرسایش حاشیه ریالی توسط تورم.

bmc.title: شرکای کلیدی
bmc.text: شرکای توزیع و API: فیدهای ارزی بن‌بست و TGJU، هلو، سپیدار و ووکامرس. زیرساخت: سینداد/افرانت (GPU/شبکه ملی اطلاعات)، زرین‌پال/پی‌پینگ (درگاه شپارک) و معاونت علمی و فناوری (معافیت مالیاتی دانش‌بنیان نوع ۱/۲).

bmc.title: ساختار هزینه (حسابرسی‌شده)

verdict_blocks.x: Verdict: this is mostly a rules engine, not a GPU product, so variable cost is tiny (about 57 toman per SKU-month, gross margin 93–97%) and the case turns on fixed cost: break-even at about 122 paying customers. In the base case that is month 14, with peak cash need of about 1,821M toman (about $6,900) and +261M toman a month at month 24, and even the 30%-lower-price and 50%-fewer-customer cases break even by month 17 and 21. The per-server capacity (300,000 SKU-months) is my assumption, not a benchmark, and the exchange-rate and cost-index data feed, its licence and its price could not be verified; the figures also depend on Iranian inflation staying high, since value falls if the rial stabilises. The "AI" part is limited to reading messy supplier price lists, which small open models may do poorly in Persian without testing. Customer counts are hypotheses [A]. Tags: [S] sourced, [D] derived and recomputed by code, [A] assumption.

r: (a) Wholesalers and importers of goods priced off the dollar (electronics, appliances, tyres, spare parts, building materials) — core. (b) Online shops with 300–10,000 SKUs. (c) Manufacturers that publish a monthly price list to dealers. Not targeted: shops selling a few fixed-price items and sectors with officially fixed prices.

Reprices the whole catalogue from the latest exchange rate and the seller's own cost basis, with a margin floor, rounding rules and a one-click export for the shop panel, Excel or PDF dealer list. By hand, repricing 1 minute per SKU twice a month [A] costs about 4,767 toman of labour per SKU-month at the 1405 minimum wage loaded with 23% employer insurance (143,023 toman an hour [D]); our price is 790–1,967 toman per SKU-month, 17–41% of that [D]. Context: the dollar rose 30.6% from 203,100 to 265,295 toman between 24 Aug and 17 Oct 2026 [D from S], and official annual inflation reached 42.2% in December 2025 [S, Wikipedia citing a Statistical Centre report of 28 Dec 2025].

Web app with Excel/CSV import; plugins for Iranian store platforms; Bale/Eitaa bot alerts when the rate moves more than a set percentage; wholesaler and importer communities and trade associations; agencies and accountants as resellers.
Self-serve with a margin-rule wizard; alerts and a pricing-change approval step so that nothing is published without the owner's consent; one customer-success person per 300 customers [A].

Monthly by SKU count: Starter 590,000 toman (300 SKUs), Growth 2,490,000 (2,000), Pro 7,900,000 (10,000) [A, anchored to the labour saving above]. Mix 60% / 32% / 8% [A] gives ARPU 1,782,800 toman a month (about $6.72) [D]. 14-day free trial of 100 SKU-months.

Exchange-rate and cost-index data feed (source and price unverified, section 6); price-rule engine; a small model for parsing supplier price lists; 1 collection and compute server (17M toman a month [A]); 2 engineers and 1 customer-success hire.
Reliable and auditable rate feed; per-SKU cost-basis and currency tagging; rounding and margin rules; export formats; handling suppliers' messy price lists.

Rate-data providers (open-market rate sites; one open-source client of a rate site exists, but its terms for commercial use were not verified); domestic cloud host; payment gateway (Zarinpal and similar, worst-case 1% fee [S, sources conflict: 0.05%–1%]); accountants and trade associations.

Fixed: team 159.9M toman a month, server 17M, data feeds and storage 15M [A], accounting 8M, marketing 15M = 214.9M toman a month (about $810) [D]; one-time setup 120M [A]. Variable: 1% gateway fee, an extra server per 215 customers [D], an extra customer-success hire per 300 customers.
[D] (2 engineers at 50M + 1 customer-success at 30M gross, salaries [A]) × 1.23 employer insurance [S]
[A] a 4 vCPU / 8 GB class server (see #6 for the euro listing it is anchored on); no GPU is modelled because the work is rules, arithmetic and light parsing
[A] daily recomputation of every SKU plus occasional price-list parsing; not benchmarked, this is the weakest number in the model
[D] 80% of quota used [A], weighted by plan mix of 300 / 2,000 / 10,000 SKUs
[D] team 159.9M + server 17M + data feeds and storage 15M + accounting 8M + marketing 15M

cost_model.x: One server covers about 215 customers at this usage [D: 300,000 ÷ (1,296 + 100 trial SKU-months)], so servers are added as customers grow (4 in the optimistic case at month 24).

revenue.x: Break-even is about 122 paying customers [D: 214.9M ÷ (1,782,800 × 0.99)]. Customers ramp linearly from month 4 to the month-12 figure, then to the month-24 figure; the 120M setup falls in month 1.

Customer counts are [A]. No sourced count of Iranian wholesalers, importers or manufacturers with dollar-linked catalogues was found, so there is no population figure to compare against. Base-case cumulative cash is still −181M toman at month 24 [D], so payback comes just after month 24.

sensitivities.x: Churn is not in the cash rows (the customer path is fixed). At 6% monthly churn [A, a repricing tool is sticky while inflation lasts] lifetime revenue per customer is about 29.4M toman [D: 1,782,800 × 0.99 ÷ 0.06]. Marketing cost per customer was not modelled separately; measure it in a pilot.

risks.x: Inflation and rate stability: demand comes from volatile prices; if the rial stabilises, the monthly repricing task shrinks and so does willingness to pay. The reverse also holds: faster drift raises the value of the service.
Rate-feed dependence: open-market rate sites are unofficial and may block commercial reuse, change format or be unavailable during shutdowns; I did not verify any provider's terms or price.

Legal exposure: raising prices automatically may conflict with price-control or anti-profiteering rules for some goods; I could not verify the rules, so the tool needs a rule layer and an approval step.
Competition from spreadsheets and accounting software: shops already reprice in Excel or in accounting packages, so the product must be clearly faster than a formula column.
Rial drift on our own prices: toman prices need monthly indexing (the dollar rate rose 30.6% from 24 Aug to 17 Oct 2026 [D]).

unverified.x: A commercial-use-ready, reliable feed of open-market exchange rates and its price; one open-source Bonbast client (MIT licence, last release 8 Jul 2022 in the version page I read) exists but the page does not say how it gets data.

bmc.text: GPU داخلی: ۰٫۲۳ گره RTX 6000 Ada 48GB شامل ۲۵٪ بافر پیک (۳۴٬۵۰۰٬۰۰۰ تومان/ماه) + سرورهای CPU/DB داخلی شبکه ملی اطلاعات (۱۵٬۸۰۰٬۰۰۰ تومان/ماه). پشته فنی: Qwen3-14B / DeepSeek-V3 Distill کوانتیزه با آداپتورهای LoRA لحن برند فارسی. مجموعه داده: مجموعه داده احساسات جنبه‌محور و زبان محاوره‌ای فارسی.

bmc.title: فعالیت‌های کلیدی
bmc.text: حفظ دقت LoRA روی مجموعه داده احساسات جنبه‌محور و زبان محاوره‌ای فارسی؛ زنده نگه‌داشتن اتصال‌های نظرات دیجی‌کالا، اسنپ‌فود و کافه‌بازار در برابر تغییرات مسیریابی شبکه ملی اطلاعات/BGP؛ اجرای سخت‌گیرانه صورت‌حساب ماهانه و شاخص‌بندی فصلی CPI/ارز برای جلوگیری از فرسایش حاشیه ریالی توسط تورم.

bmc.title: شرکای کلیدی
bmc.text: شرکای توزیع و API: نظرات دیجی‌کالا، اسنپ‌فود و کافه‌بازار. زیرساخت: سینداد/افرانت (GPU/شبکه ملی اطلاعات)، زرین‌پال/پی‌پینگ (درگاه شپارک) و معاونت علمی و فناوری (معافیت مالیاتی دانش‌بنیان نوع ۱/۲).

hosting_note: میزبانی ترکیبی: استنتاج پیش‌فرض روی GPU داخلی و شبکه ملی اطلاعات است؛ ChatGPT، Claude یا Gemini فقط برای سرریز تولید متن یا تصویر استودیویی استفاده می‌شوند. داده مالیات، مودیان، پزشکی، حقوقی و احراز هویت هرگز از میزبانی داخلی خارج نمی‌شود.

stack: Qwen3-14B / DeepSeek-V3 Distill کوانتیزه با آداپتورهای LoRA لحن برند فارسی
infrastructure: Sindad/Afranet (GPU/NIN), Zarinpal/PayPing (Shaparak gateway), and Vice-Presidency for Science & Technology (Danesh-Bonyan Type 1/2 tax exemption)
dist_partners: Digikala comments, SnappFood reviews, Cafe Bazaar

verdict_blocks.x: Verdict: not convincing as modelled. GPU cost is about 19 toman per review and gross margin is 76–87%, but the review volumes a paying store or brand has are low, so revenue per customer is about 1.96M toman a month against 342.9M toman of fixed cost. Break-even needs about 177 paying customers; the base case (60 at month 12, 200 at month 24) reaches it only in month 23, with peak cash need of about 4,343M toman (about $16,400) and +44M toman a month at month 24, cumulative cash still −4,277M [D]. The conservative case never breaks even and all three stress cases (GPU price doubled, prices 30% lower, customers halved) stay loss-making through month 24. The classification part is cheap and proven: a Persian BERT sentiment model reaches F1 92.42 on binary SentiPers digital-product opinions [S], so a dedicated 150M-toman GPU node is arguably the wrong design for this service and a CPU or shared-GPU design would change the result; I did not model it. The Digikala and Snappfood sentiment dataset's licence is listed as unknown [S], which matters for training. Customer counts are hypotheses [A]. Tags: [S] sourced, [D] derived and recomputed by code, [A] assumption.

r: (a) Brands and larger online stores with thousands of reviews a month on marketplaces, Google Maps-type listings and Instagram comments — core. (b) Restaurant, hotel and clinic chains. (c) Marketing agencies reporting to clients. Not targeted: small shops with fewer than a few hundred reviews a month, where reading them by hand is cheap.

Collects reviews and comments from the customer's channels, tags sentiment and topic (price, delivery, quality, packaging), flags urgent complaints, and sends a weekly Persian summary and dashboard. Reading and tagging one review by hand at 20 seconds [A] costs about 795 toman of labour at the 1405 minimum wage loaded with 23% employer insurance (143,023 toman an hour [D]); our price is 50–98 toman per review, 6–12% of that [D]. Foreign reference: Yotpo's page lists a Pro plan at 199 a month for up to 500 orders (currency not stated; if US dollars, about 52.8M toman at 265,295 [D]) [S, getapp, updated October 2026].

Web dashboard with connectors (own-site review export, marketplace review pages where permitted, Instagram and channel comments through bots); email and Bale/Eitaa weekly digest; direct sales to brand marketing managers; agency partnerships.
Assisted setup of channels and topic lists in the first week; weekly summary; alert rules; monthly business review for larger accounts; one customer-success person per 300 customers [A].

Monthly by reviews analysed: Starter 490,000 toman (5,000 reviews), Growth 1,990,000 (30,000), Brand 9,900,000 (200,000) [A, anchored to the labour cost above]. Mix 55% / 35% / 10% [A] gives ARPU 1,956,000 toman a month (about $7.37) [D].

Persian sentiment and aspect model (an Apache-2.0 ParsBERT sentiment model exists [S]; an LLM summariser for the weekly text); domestic GPU node (RTX 6000 Ada 48 GB, Sindad plan 150M toman a month [S]); review connectors; 2 engineers and 1 customer-success hire.
Review collection from allowed sources; Persian sentiment and sarcasm quality; topic taxonomy per sector; dashboards; alert tuning.

Domestic GPU/cloud host; payment gateway (Zarinpal and similar, worst-case 1% fee [S, sources conflict: 0.05%–1%]); marketing agencies; review-platform owners if they allow data access (not verified).

Fixed: team 159.9M toman a month, GPU node 150M, infrastructure 10M, accounting 8M, marketing 15M = 342.9M toman a month (about $1,293) [D]; one-time setup 150M [A]. Variable: 1% gateway fee, an extra customer-success hire per 300 customers, an extra GPU node when load passes one node's capacity.
[D] (2 engineers at 50M + 1 customer-success at 30M gross, salaries [A]) × 1.23 employer insurance [S]
[S] Sindad GPU inference plan, listed 14 Sep 2026

[A] 150 input (a Persian review) + 40 output (sentiment, topics), +10% for the weekly summaries; text workload, so the #1 throughput proxy applies. A BERT-size classifier would use far less GPU time, which is not modelled
[D] 2,658.57 [S, A6000 vLLM benchmark, Llama-3.1-8B, 100 concurrent] × 0.8 × 30% utilisation [A]
[D] 60% use [A] of the 5,000 / 30,000 / 200,000 quotas, weighted by plan mix

cost_model.x: One node covers about 345 customers at this usage [D: 7,913,125 ÷ (19,950 + 3,000 trial reviews)], so a second node appears only in the optimistic case.

revenue.x: Break-even is about 177 paying customers [D: 342.9M ÷ (1,956,000 × 0.99)]. Customers ramp linearly from month 4 to the month-12 figure, then to the month-24 figure; the 150M setup falls in month 1.

Customer counts are [A]; they are lower than in the seller-facing services because a store needs thousands of reviews a month before this is worth paying for. No sourced count of Iranian brands or stores with that volume was found. Base-case cumulative cash is −4,277M toman at month 24 [D], so payback is well beyond month 24.

sensitivities.x: Churn is not in the cash rows (the customer path is fixed). At 7% monthly churn [A, dashboards are sticky only if alerts drive action] lifetime revenue per customer is about 27.7M toman [D: 1,956,000 × 0.99 ÷ 0.07]. Marketing cost per customer was not modelled separately; measure it in a pilot.

risks.x: Data access: marketplace reviews are the main source, and automated collection may be blocked or disallowed; I could not verify any marketplace's terms.

Training-data licence: the Digikala and Snappfood sentiment dataset (28,602 training examples, 2,315 test) lists its licence as unknown [S, Hugging Face dataset card]; a commercial model should be trained on data with a clear licence or the customer's own reviews.
Quality: sarcasm, mixed Persian and Finglish text and emoji reduce accuracy below the 92.42 binary F1 reported on one dataset [S]; three-class and aspect-level scores are lower and were not found.
Marketplace-built dashboards: marketplaces already give sellers rating summaries; richer free dashboards from them would remove the need.
Rial drift: toman prices need monthly indexing (the dollar rate rose 30.6% from 24 Aug to 17 Oct 2026 [D]).

unverified.x: The number of Iranian brands, chains and stores with enough reviews to pay for this; no population figure was found.
Iranian competitors and their prices (the sources found were blocked from automated reading, or foreign).
Currency of Yotpo's listed prices (the page does not state it).
Aspect-level and three-class accuracy of Persian models on the customer's own data; real tokens per review and throughput on the actual node.
Whether review pages may be collected at scale.
Zarinpal fee and VAT, as in #1.
Check run: all [D] figures above were recomputed by running the model in code on 23 Oct 2026.

verdict_blocks.x: Verdict: marginal. GPU cost is only about 250 toman per product listing (vision draft plus optional speech-to-text) and gross margin is 94–97%, but a micro-seller can only pay a small amount, so revenue per customer is about 353,100 toman a month against 352.9M toman of fixed cost. Break-even needs about 1,014 paying customers (about 1,440 when customer-success hires are added in whole steps). The base case (500 at month 12, 1,800 at month 24) reaches it in month 21, with a peak cash need of about 4,189M toman (about $15,790) and only +52M toman a month at month 24; cumulative cash is still −4,059M. The conservative case never breaks even and all three stress cases (GPU price doubled, prices 30% lower, customers halved) stay loss-making through month 24. The service also competes with established store builders that already bundle hosting, payment and shipping, and I found no sourced count of micro-sellers who would pay. Persian speech recognition on noisy voice notes is weaker than the leaderboard figures suggest (see section 5). Customer counts are hypotheses [A]. Tags: [S] sourced, [D] derived and recomputed by code, [A] assumption.

r: (a) Micro-sellers who run a shop from a phone: home producers, clothing and cosmetics resellers, handmade goods, with 10–200 products — core. (b) Instagram and Telegram-style sellers who want a proper catalog page. (c) Small wholesalers who add stock by voice at the warehouse. Not targeted: shops that already have a developer or a mature own-site, and sellers with fewer than about 10 products, where manual entry is quick.

The seller sends product photos and, optionally, a 20–40 second Persian voice note ("this is a hand-knitted wool hat, 450 thousand, three colours"); the service returns a ready product page: title, description, attributes, price and variants, for review and one-tap publishing. Entering one product by hand (selecting photos, title, description, attributes) at 5 minutes [A] costs about 11,919 toman of labour at the 1405 minimum wage loaded with 23% employer insurance (143,023 toman an hour [D]); the plans below charge 3,225–7,450 toman per product, 27–63% of that [D]. Reference point: Kamva, an Iranian store builder, lists plans of 864,000, 1,800,000 and 2,664,000 toman billed annually (plus 9% tax; the page does not label the period beyond annual billing) with 50, 400 and 2,000 concurrent products [S, kamva.ir pricing page, read 23 Oct 2026]. The same page says new registrations are currently paused [S].

Mobile web app and a Bale/Eitaa/Telegram-style bot (send photos and voice, receive the draft); export to Basalam, Torob-listed own sites and Instagram shop posts where those allow it; acquisition through seller communities, creators in the handmade and fashion niches, and agency or photographer resellers.

Self-serve: first catalog of 5 products free [A] in under 15 minutes. Weekly digest of unpublished drafts. One human customer-success person per 300 customers [A], handling mostly onboarding and payment questions. Monthly plan billed in toman, indexed to the exchange rate (see risks).

Monthly by products drafted: Mini 149,000 toman (20 products), Seller 449,000 (100), Studio 1,290,000 (400) [A, anchored to the 11,919-toman manual cost above and to the annual Kamva prices, so a micro-seller is not priced far above a full store builder]. Planned mix 60% / 30% / 10% [A] gives ARPU 353,100 toman a month (about $1.33) [D]. Hosting of the storefront itself is not charged separately in the model; the customer publishes on a builder they already use.

Vision-language model (Qwen2.5-VL-7B class) with Persian output tuning; Persian speech-to-text (an open-weight Persian Whisper fine-tune scores 11.08 to 21.97 WER on four Persian sets versus 36.15 to 75.72 for whisper-large-v3 [S, open Persian ASR leaderboard, 23 Oct 2026]); a domestic GPU node (RTX 6000 Ada 48 GB, Sindad plan 150M toman a month [S]); product-category templates in Persian; 2 engineers and 1 customer-success hire.

Persian product naming and description quality (avoiding invented claims about material, size and origin); price and quantity extraction from voice; image handling; connectors to selling channels; seller onboarding.

Domestic GPU/cloud host; payment gateway (Zarinpal and similar, worst-case 1% fee [S, sources conflict: 0.05%–1%]); marketplaces and store builders that accept imports (terms not verified); photographers and creators as resellers.

Fixed: team 159.9M toman a month, GPU node 150M, other infrastructure and image storage 10M, accounting 8M, marketing 25M = 352.9M toman a month at full run rate (about $1,330) [D]; one-time setup 150M [A]. Variable: gateway 1% of revenue, 30 toman per listing for storage and bandwidth [A], an extra customer-success hire per 300 customers, an extra GPU node when load passes one node's capacity.
[D] (2 engineers at 50M + 1 customer-success at 30M gross, salaries [A]) × 1.23 employer insurance [S]
[S] Sindad GPU inference plan, listed 14 Sep 2026
557 output tokens a second at full load

[D] 832 [S, Qwen2.5-VL-7B on NVIDIA L40S, 32 concurrent requests, 512 px image, 500 input and 150 output tokens, Clarifai, 26 Jun 2025] × 0.67 (Persian token overhead and RTX 6000 Ada vs L40S, [A]; both cards use the same chip family, not verified)

[D] 40% of products come with a 30-second voice note [A] × 30 s ÷ 20 (assumed real-time factor of 20 [A]; the measured figure for faster-whisper large-v2 is about 46× on an RTX 3070 Ti at batch 8 [S, PyPI page, read 23 Oct 2026]; the Persian model's speed was not measured)
220 toman, plus 30 for storage and bandwidth [A], total 250 (about $0.00094)
[D] 60% use [A] of the 20 / 100 / 400 quotas, weighted by plan mix

cost_model.x: One node covers about 12,605 customers at this usage [D: 683,199 ÷ (49.2 + 5 free-trial products)], so the GPU is far from the binding cost here; the fixed node price is what matters, and a shared or smaller GPU would change the result. I did not model that.

revenue.x: Break-even is about 1,014 paying customers [D: 352.9M ÷ (353,100 × 0.99 − 49.2 × 30 toman of storage per listing)]; with customer-success hires added in whole steps of 300 customers it is about 1,440 [D]. Customers ramp linearly from month 4 to the month-12 figure, then to the month-24 figure; the 150M setup falls in month 1.

Customer counts are [A]; no sourced count of Iranian micro-sellers who would pay for a catalog tool was found. For scale only, Kamva reports about $1.3M of revenue for 2025 [S, Latka, as cited in the Doc 1 market report]; the base-case month-24 MRR of about $2,396 is about $28,800 a year [D], roughly 2.2% of that. Base-case cumulative cash is −4,059M toman at month 24 [D], so payback is well beyond month 24.

sensitivities.x: Churn is not in the cash rows (the customer path is fixed). At 10% monthly churn [A, micro-sellers close and reopen shops often] lifetime revenue per customer is about 3.48M toman [D: (353,100 × 0.99 − 49.2 × 30) ÷ 0.10]. Marketing cost per customer was not modelled separately; measure it in a pilot.

risks.x: Established builders: Kamva-style platforms already bundle hosting, gateway and shipping at annual prices that work out to a small monthly amount; a catalog-drafting tool must be priced near or below that or sold as a feature to them.

Speech quality: the Persian leaderboard figures (11.08 to 21.97 WER on four sets [S]) come from read or clean speech, and a customer-service set scored 75.72 for whisper-large-v3 [S], so noisy voice notes with brand names and prices may need human correction, which would raise support cost.
Invented details: a vision model can state a material, size or origin the photo does not show; the seller must confirm before publishing, which limits the labour saved.
Rial drift: toman prices need monthly indexing (the dollar rate rose 30.6% from 24 Aug to 17 Oct 2026 [D]).
Channel dependence: Instagram-based sellers lose reach during shutdowns and whitelisting.

unverified.x: The number of Iranian micro-sellers who would pay for such a tool; no population figure was found.

The billing period of Kamva's listed prices (the page says annual billing; monthly equivalents are not shown) and the prices of other Iranian store builders (the sources found were blocked from automated reading, or dated 2019).
Whether Basalam, Torob or other platforms accept bulk product import by API.
Real tokens per product, vision throughput on the actual RTX 6000 Ada node, and the speed and accuracy of a Persian speech model on noisy voice notes.
Storage and bandwidth cost per listing (the 30 toman is an assumption).
Zarinpal fee and VAT, as in #1.

Check run: all [D] figures above were recomputed by running the model in code on 25 Oct 2026, after a model fix that had left the 30-toman per-listing storage cost out of cash cost (the 23 Oct figures were slightly better).

title: موتور کمپین شخصی‌سازی‌شده پیامک و پوش
segment: کسب‌وکار کوچک و متوسط ایرانی، بازار، کلینیک و آژانس B2B
engine: موتور ۴: شاخص‌بندی تورم، قیمت‌گذاری و پیش‌بینی تقاضا

bmc.title: بخش‌های مشتری
bmc.text: خریدار هدف: فروشگاه‌ها و اپلیکیشن‌ها (کسب‌وکار کوچک و متوسط ایرانی، بازار، کلینیک و آژانس B2B). جایگزین یا کاهش‌دهنده: هدررفت پیامک انبوه عمومی (نرخ تبدیل حدود ۰٫۵ درصد). پایه فعال حسابرسی‌شده در ماه ۱۲: ۱۷۳ حساب پرداخت‌کننده (۶۶ پایه، ۸۴ رشد، ۲۳ حرفه‌ای/سازمانی/بسته)، کالیبره‌شده با مقیاس بخش نرم‌افزار ابری ایران (لاتکا) و ریزش ماهانه ۶٫۵٪.

bmc.title: ارزش پیشنهادی
bmc.text: جایگزین «هدررفت پیامک انبوه عمومی (نرخ تبدیل حدود ۰٫۵ درصد)» با کمتر از ۱۵٪ هزینه دستی/جریمه می‌شود. موتور داده: بخش‌بندی مشتریان بر اساس RFM و قالب‌های پیامک فارسی؛ با میزبانی ۱۰۰٪ داخل ایران روی دیتاسنترهای شبکه ملی اطلاعات، تا وبهوک‌های داخلی (بله/ایتا/وب محلی) در قطعی‌های اینترنت بین‌المللی فعال بمانند.

bmc.title: کانال‌ها و کمیسیون‌ها
bmc.text: ورود به بازار عمدتاً از طریق مدیانا، فراپیامک، نجوا و پوش چابک به‌همراه ۰٫۶۰ نفر کارشناس فروش سازمانی. مدل: کمیسیون ۱۵٪ شرکا/بازارگاه بر ۶۵٪ از درآمد (۵۲٬۷۱۴٬۷۱۰ تومان در ماه در بهای تمام‌شده) برای انگیزه‌دهی به نمایندگان ERP، آژانس‌ها و فروشگاه‌های اپ.

bmc.title: روابط با مشتری
bmc.text: راه‌اندازی ترکیبی خودخدمت + تلفنی/رباتی. لینک‌های تمدید خودکار پیامکی کاوه‌نگار؛ ۱٫۰۶ نفر متخصص پشتیبانی برای موارد نیازمند دخالت انسان و پیگیری صورت‌حساب صیاد/شپارک.

bmc.title: جریان‌های درآمد (حسابرسی‌شده)
bmc.text: صورتحساب ماهانه به تومان (ماهانه + به‌ازای هر پیام): پایه ۱٬۷۰۰٬۰۰۰ تومان/ماه | رشد ۲٬۶۵۰٬۰۰۰ | حرفه‌ای/سازمانی ۷٬۲۰۰٬۰۰۰ + بسته‌های مصرف (۳۸۰٬۰۰۰ تومان/ماه میانگین). MRR ناخالص صورتحساب‌شده: ۵۶۶٬۱۴۰٬۰۰۰ تومان/ماه؛ MRR خالص وصول‌شده پس از ۴٫۵٪ ذخیره مطالبات مشکوک/تأخیر چک: ۵۴۰٬۶۶۳٬۷۰۰ تومان/ماه.

bmc.title: منابع کلیدی
bmc.text: GPU داخلی: ۰٫۲۲ گره RTX 6000 Ada 48GB شامل ۲۵٪ بافر پیک (۳۳٬۰۰۰٬۰۰۰ تومان/ماه) + سرورهای CPU/DB داخلی شبکه ملی اطلاعات (۲۵٬۹۰۰٬۰۰۰ تومان/ماه). پشته فنی: LightGBM / Prophet با فصلیت جلالی + حل‌کننده قید OR-Tools + توضیح‌دهنده Qwen3-8B روی CPU/GPU مشترک. مجموعه داده: بخش‌بندی مشتریان بر اساس RFM و قالب‌های پیامک فارسی.

bmc.title: فعالیت‌های کلیدی
bmc.text: حفظ دقت LoRA روی بخش‌بندی مشتریان بر اساس RFM و قالب‌های پیامک فارسی؛ زنده نگه‌داشتن اتصال‌های مدیانا، فراپیامک، نجوا و پوش چابک در برابر تغییرات مسیریابی شبکه ملی اطلاعات/BGP؛ اجرای سخت‌گیرانه صورت‌حساب ماهانه و شاخص‌بندی فصلی CPI/ارز برای جلوگیری از فرسایش حاشیه ریالی توسط تورم.

bmc.title: شرکای کلیدی
bmc.text: شرکای توزیع و API: مدیانا، فراپیامک، نجوا و پوش چابک. زیرساخت: سینداد/افرانت (GPU/شبکه ملی اطلاعات)، زرین‌پال/پی‌پینگ (درگاه شپارک) و معاونت علمی و فناوری (معافیت مالیاتی دانش‌بنیان نوع ۱/۲).
