The weak points are churn (micro-sellers cancel often; 6% a month is assumed), the dependence on three messengers whose bot rules and reachability I could not verify (Bale publishes four bot libraries and reports over 30,000 active bots [S], but I found no bot interface documentation for Eitaa and Telegram is filtered in Iran [A]), and the absence of any found Iranian bot-builder price. Customer counts are hypotheses [A]. Tags: [S] sourced, [D] derived and recomputed by code, [A] assumption.

r: (a) Social-commerce sellers and small shops that already sell through Bale, Eitaa or Telegram channels and want automatic answers — core. (b) Small clinics, institutes and service firms that take enquiries in messengers. (c) Agencies that build bots for clients (reseller plan). Not targeted: large firms needing integration with core systems. Pool: Bale reports over 30,000 active bots, including AI bots [S, en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bale\_Messenger, read 23 Oct 2026]; Bale had 16.5 million monthly active users in May 2023 according to the communications minister [S, techradar.com, read 23 Oct 2026], and the Wikipedia article says over 35 million users without a date. No count of Eitaa bots or of businesses selling in messengers was found.

A visual builder where a shop owner uploads a product list or FAQ, picks a tone and publishes an AI bot to Bale, Eitaa or Telegram in minutes, with order capture, handover to a human and analytics. Handling one enquiry by hand takes about 5 minutes [A], about 11,919 toman at 143,023 toman an hour (1405 minimum wage loaded with 23% employer insurance [D]); the plans below charge 700–1,200 toman per conversation, 6–10% of that [D]. Foreign references: Botpress lists Plus at $150 a month for 250 conversations and Team at $750 for 1,500, and extra conversation packs of 100 at $65 [S, botpress.com/pricing, read 23 Oct 2026]; Tidio's Lyro AI add-on starts at $32.50 a month for 50 AI conversations [S, tidio.com/pricing, 23 Oct 2026]. Those are about $0.50–0.65 per conversation, or roughly 130,000–170,000 toman [D], against our $0.003–0.005; foreign tools do not list Bale or Eitaa and are hard to pay from Iran [A].
Bot-store listings and a Bale mini-app or channel of its own; Instagram and Telegram groups of sellers; templates by trade (clothing, cosmetics, clinics); referral by agencies.

Free tier of 50 conversations [A]; template library; guided set-up call for paying customers; one customer-success person per 40 customers [A]. Monthly plan billed in toman, indexed to the exchange rate.

Monthly by conversation bundle: Starter 1.8M toman (1,500 conversations, 1,200 each), Business 7.5M (8,000, 938 each), Pro 28M (40,000, 700 each) [A, priced at 6–10% of the labour cost of answering]. Mix 70% / 25% / 5% [A] gives ARPU 4.5M toman a month (about $17) [D].

An 8–9B Persian-capable model with retrieval over each shop's catalog; connectors to messenger bot interfaces (Bale libraries exist in Python, PHP and .NET [S, Wikipedia]; Eitaa and Telegram interfaces not verified); a domestic GPU node (RTX 6000 Ada 48 GB, Sindad plan 150M toman a month [S]); 2 engineers and 1 customer-success hire.
Builder usability for non-technical owners; answer accuracy on prices and stock (shared with services #1 and #11); keeping up with messenger bot rules; template creation; abuse and spam controls.
Messenger operators (Bale, Eitaa, Telegram), domestic GPU/cloud host, payment gateway (Zarinpal and similar, worst-case 1% fee [S, sources conflict: 0.05%–1%]), agencies and trade associations.

Fixed: team 159.9M toman a month (2 engineers at 50M + 1 customer-success at 30M gross [A] × 1.23 [S]), GPU node 150M, other infrastructure 10M, accounting 8M, marketing 30M = 357.9M toman a month (about $1,349) [D]; one-time setup 150M [A]. Variable: gateway 1% of revenue, an extra customer-success hire per 40 customers, an extra GPU node per about 551,000 conversations of monthly load (second node from the 180th customer; 1, 3 and 6 nodes at month 24 in the conservative, base and optimistic cases [D]).
[D] (2 engineers at 50M + 1 customer-success at 30M gross, salaries [A]) × 1.23 employer insurance [S]
[S] Sindad GPU inference plan, listed 14 Sep 2026
[A] four turns of 600 input (instructions, flow state, retrieved catalog text) + 120 output, plus one routing call of 120; text workload, so the #1 throughput proxy applies
[D] 2,658.57 [S, A6000 vLLM benchmark, Llama-3.1-8B, 100 concurrent] × 0.8 (Ada vs A6000 and Persian token overhead, [A]) × 30% average utilisation [A]
[D] 60% use [A] of the 1,500 / 8,000 / 40,000 bundles, weighted by plan mix

cost_model.x: One node covers about 179 customers at this usage [D: 551,281 ÷ (3,030 + 50 free conversations)], so the GPU becomes a stepped cost in the base and optimistic cases.

revenue.x: Break-even is about 80 paying customers on the fixed-cost formula [D: 357.9M ÷ (4.535M × 0.99) = 79.7], and stepping through customer counts with the nodes and hires each needs gives 97 customers [D]. Customers ramp linearly from month 4 to the month-12 figure, then to the month-24 figure; the 150M setup falls in month 1.

Customer counts are [A]. The base case reaches 400 customers, 1.3% of Bale's reported 30,000 active bots [D], though a bot count is not a count of businesses that would pay. Cumulative cash at month 24 is −4,078M toman in the conservative case, +2,587M in the base case and +17,093M in the optimistic case [D].

sensitivities.x: Churn is not in the cash rows (the customer path is fixed), and it is the main risk here. At 6% monthly churn [A, micro-sellers close shops and switch tools often] lifetime revenue per customer is about 75M toman [D: 4.535M × 0.99 ÷ 0.06], so the 400 customers of the base case need replacing at about 24 a month just to stay level [D]. Sales cost per account was not modelled; measure it in the trial.

risks.x: Platform dependence: each messenger controls its bot interface, rate limits and rules; I could not verify Eitaa's or Telegram's current bot terms, and a rule change can remove a channel.

Reachability: Telegram is filtered in Iran [A] and Iran had a near-total internet blackout from 18 June 2025 [S, techradar.com]; bots on domestic messengers keep working only if the platform and hosting stay reachable.
Churn and low ARPU: with about 4.5M toman a month per customer, small price or churn changes move break-even by many months (prices −30% adds 5 months).
Free alternatives: sellers can use free bot templates and general chat assistants; I found no Iranian bot-builder price to compare.
Accuracy: wrong prices or stock in a sales bot cost the seller money; the model's behaviour on Persian catalogs is untested.

unverified.x: The number of Iranian businesses that sell or take enquiries in Bale, Eitaa or Telegram, and the number of Eitaa bots.
Iranian no-code bot builders and their prices (the search returned only courses and tutorials).
Eitaa's bot interface, and the terms and fees of Bale's and Eitaa's business platforms.
Whether foreign bot-builder vendors can be paid from Iran (assumed not).
Real tokens per conversation and throughput on the actual node.
Zarinpal fee and VAT, as in #1.

title: مترجم گفتگو برای تجارت فارسی، عربی، ترکی و انگلیسی
segment: کسب‌وکار کوچک و متوسط ایرانی، بازار، کلینیک و آژانس B2B
engine: موتور ۵A: تولید محتوای فارسی و نگارش بازاریابی/آکادمیک

bmc.title: بخش‌های مشتری
bmc.text: خریدار هدف: صادرکنندگان و بازرگانان (کسب‌وکار کوچک و متوسط ایرانی، بازار، کلینیک و آژانس B2B). جایگزین یا کاهش‌دهنده: مترجم شفاهی تجاری (۳۵ تا ۵۰ میلیون تومان در ماه). پایه فعال حسابرسی‌شده در ماه ۱۲: ۱۷۶ حساب پرداخت‌کننده (۸۰ پایه، ۶۸ رشد، ۲۸ حرفه‌ای/سازمانی/بسته)، کالیبره‌شده با مقیاس بخش نرم‌افزار ابری ایران (لاتکا) و ریزش ماهانه ۱۱٫۰٪.

bmc.title: ارزش پیشنهادی
bmc.text: جایگزین «مترجم شفاهی تجاری (۳۵ تا ۵۰ میلیون تومان در ماه)» با کمتر از ۱۵٪ هزینه دستی/جریمه می‌شود. موتور داده: اصطلاحات تجاری عربی عراقی، ترکی استانبولی و فارسی؛ با میزبانی ۱۰۰٪ داخل ایران روی دیتاسنترهای شبکه ملی اطلاعات، تا وبهوک‌های داخلی (بله/ایتا/وب محلی) در قطعی‌های اینترنت بین‌المللی فعال بمانند.

bmc.title: کانال‌ها و کمیسیون‌ها
bmc.text: ورود به بازار عمدتاً از طریق گفتگوهای تجارت فرامرزی واتساپ، تلگرام و بله به‌همراه ۰٫۴۵ نفر کارشناس فروش سازمانی. مدل: کمیسیون ۱۲٪ شرکا/بازارگاه بر ۶۵٪ از درآمد (۴۲٬۶۱۱٬۲۵۹ تومان در ماه در بهای تمام‌شده) برای انگیزه‌دهی به نمایندگان ERP، آژانس‌ها و فروشگاه‌های اپ.

bmc.title: روابط با مشتری
bmc.text: راه‌اندازی ترکیبی خودخدمت + تلفنی/رباتی. لینک‌های تمدید خودکار پیامکی کاوه‌نگار؛ ۱٫۰۲ نفر متخصص پشتیبانی برای موارد نیازمند دخالت انسان و پیگیری صورت‌حساب صیاد/شپارک.

bmc.title: جریان‌های درآمد (حسابرسی‌شده)
bmc.text: صورتحساب ماهانه به تومان (ماهانه): پایه ۱٬۵۵۰٬۰۰۰ تومان/ماه | رشد ۲٬۶۵۰٬۰۰۰ | حرفه‌ای/سازمانی ۶٬۸۰۰٬۰۰۰ + بسته‌های مصرف (۴۴۰٬۰۰۰ تومان/ماه میانگین). MRR ناخالص صورتحساب‌شده: ۵۷۲٬۰۴۰٬۰۰۰ تومان/ماه؛ MRR خالص وصول‌شده پس از ۴٫۵٪ ذخیره مطالبات مشکوک/تأخیر چک: ۵۴۶٬۲۹۸٬۲۰۰ تومان/ماه.

bmc.text: GPU داخلی: ۰٫۲۶ گره RTX 6000 Ada 48GB شامل ۲۵٪ بافر پیک (۳۹٬۰۰۰٬۰۰۰ تومان/ماه) + سرورهای CPU/DB داخلی شبکه ملی اطلاعات (۱۷٬۴۰۰٬۰۰۰ تومان/ماه). پشته فنی: Qwen3-14B / DeepSeek-V3 Distill کوانتیزه با آداپتورهای LoRA لحن برند فارسی. مجموعه داده: اصطلاحات تجاری عربی عراقی، ترکی استانبولی و فارسی.

bmc.title: فعالیت‌های کلیدی
bmc.text: حفظ دقت LoRA روی اصطلاحات تجاری عربی عراقی، ترکی استانبولی و فارسی؛ زنده نگه‌داشتن اتصال‌های گفتگوهای تجارت فرامرزی واتساپ، تلگرام و بله در برابر تغییرات مسیریابی شبکه ملی اطلاعات/BGP؛ اجرای سخت‌گیرانه صورت‌حساب ماهانه و شاخص‌بندی فصلی CPI/ارز برای جلوگیری از فرسایش حاشیه ریالی توسط تورم.

verdict_blocks.x: Verdict: weak on these assumptions. Model cost is negligible (about 68 toman per message, gross margin 87–92% [D]), but revenue per customer is only about 3.0M toman a month against 396M toman of fixed cost, so break-even needs about 132 paying customers on paper and 182 once the customer-success hires are counted [D]. The base case (60 customers at month 12, 300 at month 24) breaks even only in month 19, with a peak cash need of about 4,465M toman (about $16,800) and +243M toman a month at month 24; cumulative cash is still −3,684M at month 24, so the base case does not pay back within the horizon. The conservative case (25 / 100) never breaks even (−171M a month at month 24), and cutting prices 30% or halving customers also prevents break-even. Doubling the GPU price delays it to month 22. The weak points are the substitute and the translation quality: Google lists NMT translation at $20 per million characters with 500,000 characters free each month [S], free consumer translators exist [A], and I could not confirm that an 8–9B open model translates Persian, Iraqi Arabic and Turkish trade language well enough to be paid for. The customer counts have no sourced count of Iranian exporters behind them. Customer counts are hypotheses [A]. Tags: [S] sourced, [D] derived and recomputed by code, [A] assumption.

r: (a) Exporters and traders who negotiate by chat and email with buyers in Iraq, Turkey and the Gulf — core. (b) Customs brokers and freight agents. (c) Online sellers and tourism firms with Arabic or Turkish customers. Not targeted: certified legal translation. Pool: Iran's non-oil exports in the first ten months of 1404 (March 2025 to January 2026) were $45.015 billion, of which China took $10.918 billion, Iraq $7.917 billion, the UAE $6.448 billion and Turkey $5.660 billion [S, marin-consult.com, read 23 Oct 2026]; Iraq, the UAE and Turkey together are 44.5% of the total [D]. No count of exporters or traders who chat with foreign buyers was found.

A translator inside the chat apps traders use: it translates incoming and outgoing messages between Persian, Arabic, Turkish and English with a trade glossary (units, Incoterms, product names, payment terms), keeps a shared term list per company, and flags ambiguous quantities or prices before sending. Translating and checking one message by hand takes about 8 minutes [A], about 19,070 toman of labour at 143,023 toman an hour (1405 minimum wage loaded with 23% employer insurance [D]); the plans below charge 350–600 toman per message, 2–3% of that [D], which also shows that the product competes with free tools, not with labour. Foreign references: Google Cloud Translation lists NMT at $20 per million characters (first 500,000 characters a month free) and LLM translation at $10 input and $10 output per million characters [S, cloud.google.com/translate/pricing, read 23 Oct 2026]; at an assumed 450 characters per message [A] that is about 2,388 toman per message [D], and our price is 15–25% of it [D]; DeepL Pro lists Individual at €7.49 a month for 300,000 characters and Team at €24.99 per user for 1,000,000, with languages not stated on the page opened [S, deepl.com/pro, read 23 Oct 2026].
Bale, Eitaa and Telegram bots and a web app; Chambers of Commerce and export associations; customs-broker and freight networks; sales through trade fairs.
Free trial of 30 messages [A]; a shared glossary built with the customer; one customer-success person per 40 customers [A]. Monthly plan billed in toman, indexed to the exchange rate.

Monthly by message bundle: Trader 0.9M toman (1 user, 1,500 messages, 600 each), Team 3.6M (5 users, 8,000 messages, 450 each), Company 14M (25 users, 40,000 messages, 350 each) [A, priced well below the foreign API rate above]. Mix 60% / 30% / 10% [A] gives ARPU 3.0M toman a month (about $11) [D].

An 8–9B multilingual model with Persian, Arabic and Turkish ability (not verified; several open translation models carry non-commercial licences, to be checked); trade glossaries; a domestic GPU node (RTX 6000 Ada 48 GB, Sindad plan 150M toman a month [S]); 2 engineers, 1 linguist for Arabic and Turkish and 1 customer-success hire.
Translation quality on trade language, numbers and units; dialect handling (Iraqi Arabic); glossary management; bot and chat integrations; human spot checks of translated samples.
Domestic GPU/cloud host; export associations and chambers; customs brokers; payment gateway (Zarinpal and similar, worst-case 1% fee [S, sources conflict: 0.05%–1%]).

Fixed: team 203.0M toman a month (2 engineers at 50M + 1 linguist at 35M + 1 customer-success at 30M gross [A] × 1.23 [S]), GPU node 150M, other infrastructure 10M, accounting 8M, marketing 25M = 396.0M toman a month (about $1,492) [D]; one-time setup 150M [A]. Variable: gateway 1% of revenue, an extra customer-success hire per 40 customers; an extra GPU node per about 2.2 million messages of monthly load (second node needed only in the optimistic case [D]).

cost_model.x: One node covers about 500 customers at this usage [D: 2,205,124 ÷ (4,380 + 30 trial messages)], so the GPU is not a binding cost; a customer-count shortfall, not model cost, drives the result.

revenue.x: Break-even is about 132 paying customers on the fixed-cost formula [D: 396.0M ÷ (3.02M × 0.99) = 132.4], and stepping through customer counts with the nodes and hires each needs gives 182 customers [D]. Customers ramp linearly from month 4 to the month-12 figure, then to the month-24 figure; the 150M setup falls in month 1.

Customer counts are [A]; no sourced count of Iranian exporters or traders who chat with foreign buyers was found. Cumulative cash at month 24 is −7,046M toman in the conservative case, −3,684M in the base case and +4,231M in the optimistic case [D].

sensitivities.x: Churn is not in the cash rows (the customer path is fixed). At 5% monthly churn [A, traders use a tool while a deal route is active and drop it when it ends] lifetime revenue per customer is about 59.8M toman [D: 3.02M × 0.99 ÷ 0.05]. Sales cost per account was not modelled; measure it in the trial.

risks.x: Free substitutes: general translators and chat assistants already translate between these languages at no or low cost; a paid tool must win on trade glossaries and chat integration, so the price per message may have to be lower still.
Translation quality: a wrong quantity, unit or payment term in a trade message can cost real money; Iraqi Arabic dialect and Turkish trade phrases were not tested on any model.
Sanctions exposure: trade with foreign buyers is payment- and platform-sensitive, so export volumes and the customer pool can shift quickly.
Licence: several open translation models are non-commercial; a model must be chosen or trained with a commercial licence.
Rial drift: toman prices need monthly indexing (the dollar rate rose 30.6% from 24 Aug to 17 Oct 2026 [D]).

title: OCR فاکتور و رسید به اسناد حسابداری (ارقام فارسی، تاریخ جلالی)
segment: کسب‌وکار کوچک و متوسط ایرانی، بازار، کلینیک و آژانس B2B
engine: موتور ۲: استخراج اسناد، بینایی و OCR فارسی

bmc.title: بخش‌های مشتری
bmc.text: خریدار هدف: حسابداران و فروشگاه‌ها (کسب‌وکار کوچک و متوسط ایرانی، بازار، کلینیک و آژانس B2B). جایگزین یا کاهش‌دهنده: ورود داده توسط کمک‌حسابدار (۱۸ تا ۲۴ میلیون تومان در ماه). پایه فعال حسابرسی‌شده در ماه ۱۲: ۲۰۴ حساب پرداخت‌کننده (۹۷ پایه، ۸۸ رشد، ۱۹ حرفه‌ای/سازمانی/بسته)، کالیبره‌شده با مقیاس بخش نرم‌افزار ابری ایران (لاتکا) و ریزش ماهانه ۷٫۰٪.

bmc.title: ارزش پیشنهادی
bmc.text: جایگزین «ورود داده توسط کمک‌حسابدار (۱۸ تا ۲۴ میلیون تومان در ماه)» با کمتر از ۱۵٪ هزینه دستی/جریمه می‌شود. موتور داده: مدل بینایی-زبانی رسید چاپی/حرارتی فارسی و تاریخ جلالی؛ با میزبانی ۱۰۰٪ داخل ایران روی دیتاسنترهای شبکه ملی اطلاعات، تا وبهوک‌های داخلی (بله/ایتا/وب محلی) در قطعی‌های اینترنت بین‌المللی فعال بمانند.

bmc.title: کانال‌ها و کمیسیون‌ها
bmc.text: ورود به بازار عمدتاً از طریق قالب‌های ورود هلو، سپیدار، حساب‌فا و پیدارسان به‌همراه ۰٫۶۰ نفر کارشناس فروش سازمانی. مدل: کمیسیون ۱۸٪ شرکا/بازارگاه بر ۶۵٪ از درآمد (۶۸٬۶۹۸٬۵۸۸ تومان در ماه در بهای تمام‌شده) برای انگیزه‌دهی به نمایندگان ERP، آژانس‌ها و فروشگاه‌های اپ.

bmc.title: روابط با مشتری
bmc.text: راه‌اندازی ترکیبی خودخدمت + تلفنی/رباتی. لینک‌های تمدید خودکار پیامکی کاوه‌نگار؛ ۱٫۲۲ نفر متخصص پشتیبانی برای موارد نیازمند دخالت انسان و پیگیری صورت‌حساب صیاد/شپارک.

bmc.title: جریان‌های درآمد (حسابرسی‌شده)
bmc.text: صورتحساب ماهانه به تومان (به‌ازای هر سند): پایه ۱٬۴۷۵٬۰۰۰ تومان/ماه | رشد ۲٬۷۶۰٬۰۰۰ | حرفه‌ای/سازمانی ۷٬۰۰۰٬۰۰۰ + بسته‌های مصرف (۴۷۰٬۰۰۰ تومان/ماه میانگین). MRR ناخالص صورتحساب‌شده: ۶۱۴٬۸۳۵٬۰۰۰ تومان/ماه؛ MRR خالص وصول‌شده پس از ۴٫۵٪ ذخیره مطالبات مشکوک/تأخیر چک: ۵۸۷٬۱۶۷٬۴۲۵ تومان/ماه.

bmc.title: منابع کلیدی
bmc.text: GPU داخلی: ۰٫۷۱ گره RTX 6000 Ada 48GB شامل ۲۵٪ بافر پیک (۱۰۶٬۵۰۰٬۰۰۰ تومان/ماه) + سرورهای CPU/DB داخلی شبکه ملی اطلاعات (۲۴٬۵۰۰٬۰۰۰ تومان/ماه). پشته فنی: Qwen2.5-VL-7B/32B تنظیم‌شده + PaddleOCR فارسی + پردازشگر پسین سفارشی جلالی/ارقام روی GPU داخلی. مجموعه داده: مدل بینایی-زبانی رسید چاپی/حرارتی فارسی و تاریخ جلالی.

bmc.title: فعالیت‌های کلیدی
bmc.text: حفظ دقت LoRA روی مدل بینایی-زبانی رسید چاپی/حرارتی فارسی و تاریخ جلالی؛ زنده نگه‌داشتن اتصال‌های قالب‌های ورود هلو، سپیدار، حساب‌فا و پیدارسان در برابر تغییرات مسیریابی شبکه ملی اطلاعات/BGP؛ اجرای سخت‌گیرانه صورت‌حساب ماهانه و شاخص‌بندی فصلی CPI/ارز برای جلوگیری از فرسایش حاشیه ریالی توسط تورم.

verdict_blocks.x: Verdict: weak on these assumptions. Model cost is small (about 290 toman per document including staff re-checks, gross margin 84–90% [D]), but the plans below charge only 1,167–1,933 toman per document, so revenue per customer is about 1.32M toman a month against 396M toman of fixed cost; break-even needs about 309 paying customers on paper and 568 once the customer-success hires are counted [D]. The base case (100 customers at month 12, 450 at month 24) never breaks even within 24 months: it is still losing 77M toman a month at month 24 and its cumulative cash is −6,301M toman (about $23,800), so the peak cash need is a floor, not a peak. The conservative case (40 / 150) loses 277M a month at month 24; only the optimistic case (250 / 1,200) breaks even, in month 17, with +255M a month at month 24. Doubling the GPU price, cutting prices 30% or halving customers each leaves the base case unprofitable. The service also depends on an unproven capability: I found no accuracy figure for any open vision model on Persian invoices (Persian digits, Jalali dates, tax IDs), and the only Persian invoice sample set I found is 50 synthetic images. The customer counts have no sourced count of Iranian shops or bookkeeping offices behind them. Customer counts are hypotheses [A]. Tags: [S] sourced, [D] derived and recomputed by code, [A] assumption.

r: (a) Bookkeeping offices and certified accountants who key purchase and sales invoices for many small clients — core. (b) Shops and small firms with their own bookkeeper. (c) Back offices of distributors that receive paper invoices and cheques from suppliers. Not targeted at first: large firms with an ERP and their own scanning vendor. Pool: the Iranian Institute of Certified Accountants says it has more than 6,000 members [S, en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Iranian\_Institute\_of\_Certified\_Accountants, read 24 Oct 2026; no date given], which counts certified accountants only, not the many uncertified bookkeepers and shop owners; a search headline (eghtesadnews, undated) reports 12 million tax-registered payers [S, headline only, page not opened]. System Group, maker of the Hamkaran accounting software, says it has served over 53,000 clients since 1987, a group-wide figure [S, en.wikipedia.org/wiki/System\_Group, read 24 Oct 2026]. No count of Iranian offices that key invoices by hand was found.

Photograph or upload an invoice, receipt or cheque stub and receive the extracted fields (seller, tax ID, Jalali date converted to the accounting calendar, line items, VAT, total) as a draft accounting entry the bookkeeper confirms in one click, with Persian and Arabic-Indic digits normalised. Keying one document by hand takes about 4 minutes [A], about 9,535 toman of labour at 143,023 toman an hour (1405 minimum wage loaded with 23% employer insurance [D]); the plans below charge 1,167–1,933 toman per document, 12–20% of that [D]. Foreign reference: Google Document AI lists its Invoice Parser and Expense Parser at $0.10 for every 10 pages in a document [S, cloud.google.com/document-ai/pricing, read 24 Oct 2026], which is about 26,530 toman per document [D]; our price is 4–7% of it [D], but Iranian firms cannot easily pay that vendor and Persian support is not stated on the page.

Bale and Eitaa bots and a phone web app for photo capture; an upload and email-in address; export files for the accounting packages offices already use (the file formats were not verified); accountants' associations and training courses; referral from existing bookkeeping customers.

Free trial of 20 documents [A]; a confidence score per field with the low-confidence fields highlighted for review; our staff re-check about 2% of documents [A]; one customer-success person per 60 customers [A] because every office needs its chart of accounts and export format set up. Monthly plan billed in toman, indexed to the exchange rate.

Monthly by document bundle: Shop 0.29M toman (150 documents, 1,933 each), Office 1.5M (1,000 documents, 1,500 each), Firm 7M (6,000 documents, 1,167 each) [A, priced at 12–20% of the manual keying cost above]. Mix 60% / 30% / 10% [A] gives ARPU 1.32M toman a month (about $5) [D].

A vision-language model (a 7B class model such as Qwen2.5-VL, or a fine-tuned document model) with Persian digit and Jalali date handling, a rules layer for VAT, tax IDs and totals, an invoice test set (not available: the only Persian set found, DocFlow, is 50 synthetic samples under Apache 2.0 [S, huggingface.co/datasets/alirezaaminzadeh/docflow-invoice-samples-fa, read 24 Oct 2026]); a domestic GPU node (RTX 6000 Ada 48 GB, Sindad plan 150M toman a month [S]); 2 engineers, 1 accounting specialist and 1 customer-success hire.

Field-level accuracy on real Iranian invoices (handwritten amounts, stamps, thermal receipts, skewed phone photos); mapping extracted fields to each customer's chart of accounts; export to accounting packages; building a labelled test set from consenting customers; confidence calibration.

Domestic GPU/cloud host; accounting-software makers for import formats; accountants' associations and training firms; payment gateway (Zarinpal and similar, worst-case 1% fee [S, sources conflict: 0.05%–1%]).

Fixed: team 203.0M toman a month (2 engineers at 50M + 1 accounting specialist at 35M + 1 customer-success at 30M gross [A] × 1.23 [S]), GPU node 150M, other infrastructure 10M, accounting 8M, marketing 25M = 396.0M toman a month (about $1,492) [D]; one-time setup 150M [A]. Variable: gateway 1% of revenue, staff re-checks 48 toman per document [A], an extra customer-success hire per 60 customers [A]; an extra GPU node per about 619,000 documents of monthly load (second node needed only in the optimistic case [D]).
[D] (2 engineers at 50M + 1 accounting specialist at 35M + 1 customer-success at 30M gross, salaries [A]) × 1.23 employer insurance [S]
[S] Sindad GPU inference plan, listed 14 Sep 2026

[D] 350 output tokens [A, JSON of header fields and about 4 line items] ÷ 557 tokens a second × 2.0 for the longer image prefill [A]; 557 = 832 [S, Qwen2.5-VL-7B on an L40S, 32 concurrent requests, 512-pixel image, 500 in / 150 out tokens, Clarifai blog, 26 Jun 2025] × 0.67 (Persian token overhead and Ada vs L40S, [A]). This is a proxy for a vision model, not a measured invoice benchmark
[A] 2% of documents re-checked, 1 minute each at 143,023 toman an hour [D]
[D] 60% use [A] of the 150 / 1,000 / 6,000 bundles, weighted by plan mix

cost_model.x: One node covers about 1,000 customers at this usage [D: 619,236 ÷ (594 + 20)], so the GPU is not a binding cost; a customer-count shortfall, not model cost, drives the result. Image storage, PDF conversion and CPU pre-processing are inside the 10M infrastructure line [A].

revenue.x: Break-even is about 309 paying customers on the fixed-cost formula [D: 396.0M ÷ (1.324M × 0.99 − 594 documents × 48 toman) = 308.8], and stepping through customer counts with the nodes, hires and re-check cost each needs gives 568 customers [D]. Customers ramp linearly from month 4 to the month-12 figure, then to the month-24 figure; the 150M setup falls in month 1.

Customer counts are [A]; no sourced count of Iranian bookkeeping offices or shops that key invoices by hand was found. In the conservative and base cases cash is still falling at month 24, so the peak cash need is the position at month 24 and would be larger if the losses continued [D]. Cumulative cash at month 24 is −7,986M toman in the conservative case, −6,301M in the base case and −2,392M in the optimistic case [D].

sensitivities.x: Churn is not in the cash rows (the customer path is fixed). At 4% monthly churn [A, an office that has set up its chart of accounts and export format switches rarely] lifetime contribution per customer is about 32.1M toman [D: (1.324M × 0.99 − 594 × 48) ÷ 0.04]. Sales cost per account was not modelled; measure it in the trial.

risks.x: Extraction accuracy: a wrong digit in an amount, tax ID or Jalali date creates a wrong accounting entry; no accuracy figure on Persian invoices was found for any open vision model. The one Persian OCR result I opened, a two-stage vision-language model at 98% word accuracy (WER 2%), was measured on a Persian sentence test set, not on invoices, and the same page gave no figures for Qwen2.5-VL-7B or Tesseract [S, stim.qom.ac.ir/article\_4523.html, read 24 Oct 2026]. The DocFlow sample set reports a macro accuracy of 0.667 on 3 evaluated samples, a demo figure only [S, huggingface.co, read 24 Oct 2026].

Shrinking input: as sellers issue electronic invoices through the national tax system, more incoming documents may arrive as structured data or PDF rather than paper; I could not open a source on the share of paper invoices still in circulation, so the document volume per customer is uncertain.
Price pressure: the plans are 4–7% of the foreign parser price but accountants may expect OCR bundled free in their accounting software; Iranian accounting-software prices could not be read.
Data handling: invoices carry company names and tax IDs; a domestic host and a retention rule are needed, and I did not verify the legal text.
Rial drift: toman prices need monthly indexing (the dollar rate rose 30.6% from 24 Aug to 17 Oct 2026 [D]).

unverified.x: The number of Iranian bookkeeping offices, accountants and shops that key invoices by hand, and their documents per month.
Iranian accounting-software and OCR-service prices (the Sepidar price page is blocked to automated reading; none found for OCR) and the import formats of common packages.
Field-level accuracy of any open vision model on Persian invoices, handwritten amounts and thermal receipts, and the licence of the model chosen.
Amazon Textract's price (the page did not open) and the share of paper invoices that remain under the national e-invoicing rules; the 12 million payer figure is a search headline I could not open.
Zarinpal fee and VAT, as in #1.
Check run: all [D] figures above were recomputed by running the model in code on 24 Oct 2026.

bmc.title: بخش‌های مشتری
bmc.text: خریدار هدف: کسب‌وکارهای کوچک و متوسط و حسابداران (کسب‌وکار کوچک و متوسط ایرانی، بازار، کلینیک و آژانس B2B). جایگزین یا کاهش‌دهنده: جریمه مالیاتی (۱۰ تا ۲۰ درصد فاکتور) یا حق‌الزحمه مشاور مالیاتی. پایه فعال حسابرسی‌شده در ماه ۱۲: ۱۹۱ حساب پرداخت‌کننده (۶۶ پایه، ۱۰۰ رشد، ۲۵ حرفه‌ای/سازمانی/بسته)، کالیبره‌شده با مقیاس بخش نرم‌افزار ابری ایران (لاتکا) و ریزش ماهانه ۷٫۰٪.

bmc.title: ارزش پیشنهادی
bmc.text: جایگزین «جریمه مالیاتی (۱۰ تا ۲۰ درصد فاکتور) یا حق‌الزحمه مشاور مالیاتی» با کمتر از ۱۵٪ هزینه دستی/جریمه می‌شود. موتور داده: قواعد ماده ۱۶۹ و قانون پایانه‌های فروشگاهی؛ با میزبانی ۱۰۰٪ داخل ایران روی دیتاسنترهای شبکه ملی اطلاعات، تا وبهوک‌های داخلی (بله/ایتا/وب محلی) در قطعی‌های اینترنت بین‌المللی فعال بمانند.

bmc.title: کانال‌ها و کمیسیون‌ها
bmc.text: ورود به بازار عمدتاً از طریق پورتال مودیان سازمان امور مالیاتی و کلیدهای CSR به‌همراه ۰٫۶۰ نفر کارشناس فروش سازمانی. مدل: کمیسیون ۱۸٪ شرکا/بازارگاه بر ۶۵٪ از درآمد (۷۳٬۱۷۵٬۲۵۱ تومان در ماه در بهای تمام‌شده) برای انگیزه‌دهی به نمایندگان ERP، آژانس‌ها و فروشگاه‌های اپ.

bmc.title: روابط با مشتری
bmc.text: راه‌اندازی ترکیبی خودخدمت + تلفنی/رباتی. لینک‌های تمدید خودکار پیامکی کاوه‌نگار؛ ۱٫۱۹ نفر متخصص پشتیبانی برای موارد نیازمند دخالت انسان و پیگیری صورت‌حساب صیاد/شپارک.

bmc.text: حفظ دقت LoRA روی قواعد ماده ۱۶۹ و قانون پایانه‌های فروشگاهی؛ زنده نگه‌داشتن اتصال‌های پورتال مودیان سازمان امور مالیاتی و کلیدهای CSR در برابر تغییرات مسیریابی شبکه ملی اطلاعات/BGP؛ اجرای سخت‌گیرانه صورت‌حساب ماهانه و شاخص‌بندی فصلی CPI/ارز برای جلوگیری از فرسایش حاشیه ریالی توسط تورم.

verdict_blocks.x: Verdict: weak on these assumptions. Model cost is almost nil (about 25 toman per invoice, gross margin 98% [D]) because only an assumed 20% of invoices need a language-model check and the rest are rule-checked [A], but revenue per customer is only about 0.80M toman a month against 396M toman of fixed cost, so break-even needs about 498 paying customers on paper and 1,103 once the customer-success hires are counted [D]. The base case (150 customers at month 12, 700 at month 24) never breaks even within 24 months: it still loses 135M toman a month at month 24 and its cumulative cash is −6,864M toman (about $25,900), so the peak cash need is a floor. The conservative case (60 / 250) loses 308M a month at month 24; only the optimistic case (400 / 2,000) breaks even, in month 18, and its cumulative cash is still −3,231M at month 24. Doubling the GPU price, cutting prices 30% or halving customers each leaves the base case unprofitable. The commercial problem is the substitute: accounting packages already advertise sending invoices to the tax system (search headline only), the portal itself is the government's, and an open-source library for the same API exists [S], so the assistant has to sell on error explanations and return drafting, not on submission. The GPU node (150M of the 396M fixed cost) is far larger than this workload needs, so a CPU-only version would change the result; I kept the node so the data stays on a domestic GPU host like the other services. The customer counts have no sourced count of Iranian businesses behind them. Customer counts are hypotheses [A]. Tags: [S] sourced, [D] derived and recomputed by code, [A] assumption.

r: (a) Small shops and service firms that issue invoices through the national tax system and have no accountant on staff — core. (b) Bookkeeping offices that file for 10–30 client companies. (c) Freelancers and professionals who need an economic code and invoices. Not targeted: large firms whose ERP already submits invoices. Pool: a search headline (eghtesadnews, undated) reports 12 million tax-registered payers [S, headline only, page not opened]; the Iranian Institute of Certified Accountants says it has more than 6,000 members [S, en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Iranian\_Institute\_of\_Certified\_Accountants, read 24 Oct 2026; undated]. The head of the national tax administration said in August 2022 that an economic code covering individuals and companies would be used to link electronic invoices to buyers, from Aban 1401 (November 2022) [S, nourlaw.com, read 24 Oct 2026]. IMARC estimates the Iranian e-invoicing market at $60.8 million in 2025 [S, imarcgroup.com/iran-e-invoicing-market, read 24 Oct 2026; vendor estimate, method not shown]. No count of businesses that must file and have no accounting package was found.

A guided assistant that checks each invoice against the tax system's field rules before it is sent, explains rejection messages in Persian, prepares the corrections and returns the tax system accepts, and drafts the periodic VAT return from the month's invoices for the owner or accountant to review and submit (the assistant never files on its own). Preparing and sending one invoice by hand takes about 5 minutes [A], about 11,919 toman of labour at 143,023 toman an hour (1405 minimum wage loaded with 23% employer insurance [D]); the plans below charge 1,167–2,500 toman per invoice, 10–21% of that [D]. Reference points: Iran's VAT is listed at 9% for 2026 [S, taxatlas.io/country/iran/vat-sales-tax, read 24 Oct 2026; a second source was not opened]; a Laravel library that sends invoices to the Moadian API is published free under GPL-3.0, version 3.0.0 dated 1 June 2026 with about 7,561 installs, and needs a username, private key and certificate from the API provider [S, packagist.org/packages/jooyeshgar/moadian, read 24 Oct 2026].
Web app and Bale/Eitaa bot; plug-ins for popular accounting and shop software (not verified); accountants' associations and training courses; chambers of guilds; referral by bookkeeping offices.

Free trial of 10 invoices [A]; onboarding to connect the business's tax-system credentials and economic code; one customer-success person per 80 customers [A]; reminders before filing deadlines. Monthly plan billed in toman, indexed to the exchange rate.

Monthly by invoice bundle: Basic 0.25M toman (100 invoices, 2,500 each), Business 0.9M (500 invoices, 1,800 each), Accountant 3.5M (3,000 invoices across about 20 client companies, 1,167 each) [A, priced at 10–21% of the manual cost above]. Mix 55% / 35% / 10% [A] gives ARPU 0.80M toman a month (about $3) [D].

A rules engine for the tax system's invoice fields and codes (the specification was not read: official pages are blocked); an 8–9B model for explanations and drafts; a domestic GPU node (RTX 6000 Ada 48 GB, Sindad plan 150M toman a month [S]); 2 engineers, 1 tax and accounting specialist and 1 customer-success hire; credentials and a certificate arrangement with an authorised API provider (terms not found).
Tracking changes to the tax system's rules and rejection codes; validation rules; Persian explanations; return drafting; securing customers' signing keys; support during filing deadlines.

An authorised tax-system API provider; accounting-software makers; accountants' associations; domestic GPU/cloud host; payment gateway (Zarinpal and similar, worst-case 1% fee [S, sources conflict: 0.05%–1%]).

Fixed: team 203.0M toman a month (2 engineers at 50M + 1 specialist at 35M + 1 customer-success at 30M gross [A] × 1.23 [S]), GPU node 150M, other infrastructure 10M, accounting 8M, marketing 25M = 396.0M toman a month (about $1,492) [D]; one-time setup 150M [A]. Variable: gateway 1% of revenue, an extra customer-success hire per 80 customers [A]; any per-invoice fee of the API provider is not modelled because none was found.
[D] (2 engineers at 50M + 1 specialist at 35M + 1 customer-success at 30M gross, salaries [A]) × 1.23 employer insurance [S]
[S] Sindad GPU inference plan, listed 14 Sep 2026

[A] 20% of invoices need a model check of 1,400 tokens (1,000 rules and context + 200 invoice input + 200 output); the other 80% are rule-checked on CPU; text workload, so the #1 throughput proxy applies
[D] 2,658.57 [S, A6000 vLLM benchmark, Llama-3.1-8B, 100 concurrent] × 0.8 (Ada vs A6000 and Persian token overhead, [A]) × 30% average utilisation [A]
[D] 60% use [A] of the 100 / 500 / 3,000 bundles, weighted by plan mix

cost_model.x: One node could serve about 18,000 customers at this usage [D: 5,906,583 ÷ (318 + 10)], so the GPU is idle capacity here; the customer count drives the result. No per-invoice fee of an authorised API provider and no certificate cost is included because none was found.

revenue.x: Break-even is about 498 paying customers on the fixed-cost formula [D: 396.0M ÷ (0.8025M × 0.99) = 498.4], and stepping through customer counts with the hires each needs gives 1,103 customers [D]. Customers ramp linearly from month 4 to the month-12 figure, then to the month-24 figure; the 150M setup falls in month 1.

Customer counts are [A]; no sourced count of Iranian businesses that issue invoices without an accounting package was found. In the conservative and base cases cash is still falling at month 24, so the peak cash need is the month-24 position and would grow if losses continued [D]. Cumulative cash at month 24 is −8,130M toman in the conservative case, −6,864M in the base case and −3,231M in the optimistic case [D].

sensitivities.x: Churn is not in the cash rows (the customer path is fixed). At 4% monthly churn [A, filing is a recurring duty, but customers can move to an accounting package that bundles submission] lifetime revenue per customer is about 19.9M toman [D: 0.8025M × 0.99 ÷ 0.04]. Sales cost per account was not modelled; measure it in the trial.

risks.x: Bundled substitutes: accounting-software makers advertise sending invoices to the tax system (search headline only), and a free open-source client exists [S]; a standalone assistant must win on explanations and return drafting.
Rule changes: the tax system's invoice fields, codes and deadlines change; the rules layer needs a person tracking them, and I could not read the official specification.
Credentials and liability: the assistant handles customers' signing keys and drafts returns; an error or leak is a legal and trust risk; filing stays with the user.
Platform terms: the API providers' terms, fees and whether a third party may resell access were not found.
Rial drift: toman prices need monthly indexing (the dollar rate rose 30.6% from 24 Aug to 17 Oct 2026 [D]).

unverified.x: The number of Iranian businesses that must issue electronic invoices, how many use an accounting package that already submits them, and how many have an accountant (the 12 million payer figure is a headline I could not open).

The tax system's official specification, phase dates, penalties and VAT filing calendar (official and portal pages are blocked or were not found); the 9% rate comes from one page and was not cross-checked.
Prices and bundling of accounting packages' submission feature (Sepidar's pages are blocked to automated reading) and any fee of an authorised API provider.
Whether an 8–9B model explains Persian rejection messages and drafts returns reliably.
Zarinpal fee and VAT, as in #1.
Check run: all [D] figures above were recomputed by running the model in code on 24 Oct 2026.

bmc.text: جایگزین «حسابدار پاره‌وقت (۸ تا ۱۵ میلیون تومان در ماه)» با کمتر از ۱۵٪ هزینه دستی/جریمه می‌شود. موتور داده: نگاشت دفتر دوطرفه فارسی در قالب گفتگو؛ با میزبانی ۱۰۰٪ داخل ایران روی دیتاسنترهای شبکه ملی اطلاعات، تا وبهوک‌های داخلی (بله/ایتا/وب محلی) در قطعی‌های اینترنت بین‌المللی فعال بمانند.

bmc.title: کانال‌ها و کمیسیون‌ها
bmc.text: ورود به بازار عمدتاً از طریق ربات بله/تلگرام و همگام‌سازی با حساب‌فا/هلو به‌همراه ۰٫۶۰ نفر کارشناس فروش سازمانی. مدل: کمیسیون ۱۴٪ شرکا/بازارگاه بر ۶۵٪ از درآمد (۵۲٬۸۹۷٬۷۶۹ تومان در ماه در بهای تمام‌شده) برای انگیزه‌دهی به نمایندگان ERP، آژانس‌ها و فروشگاه‌های اپ.

bmc.title: روابط با مشتری
bmc.text: راه‌اندازی ترکیبی خودخدمت + تلفنی/رباتی. لینک‌های تمدید خودکار پیامکی کاوه‌نگار؛ ۱٫۱۱ نفر متخصص پشتیبانی برای موارد نیازمند دخالت انسان و پیگیری صورت‌حساب صیاد/شپارک.

bmc.title: جریان‌های درآمد (حسابرسی‌شده)
bmc.text: صورتحساب ماهانه به تومان (ماهانه): پایه ۱٬۳۲۵٬۰۰۰ تومان/ماه | رشد ۲٬۹۸۰٬۰۰۰ | حرفه‌ای/سازمانی ۷٬۴۰۰٬۰۰۰ + بسته‌های مصرف (۵۳۰٬۰۰۰ تومان/ماه میانگین). MRR ناخالص صورتحساب‌شده: ۶۰۸٬۶۸۵٬۰۰۰ تومان/ماه؛ MRR خالص وصول‌شده پس از ۴٫۵٪ ذخیره مطالبات مشکوک/تأخیر چک: ۵۸۱٬۲۹۴٬۱۷۵ تومان/ماه.

bmc.title: منابع کلیدی
bmc.text: GPU داخلی: ۰٫۳۸ گره RTX 6000 Ada 48GB شامل ۲۵٪ بافر پیک (۵۷٬۰۰۰٬۰۰۰ تومان/ماه) + سرورهای CPU/DB داخلی شبکه ملی اطلاعات (۲۰٬۴۰۰٬۰۰۰ تومان/ماه). پشته فنی: Qwen3-14B/32B کوانتیزه (AWQ، مجوز Apache 2.0) با vLLM + امبدینگ فارسی BGE-M3 + پایگاه برداری Qdrant روی CPU. مجموعه داده: نگاشت دفتر دوطرفه فارسی در قالب گفتگو.

bmc.title: فعالیت‌های کلیدی
bmc.text: حفظ دقت LoRA روی نگاشت دفتر دوطرفه فارسی در قالب گفتگو؛ زنده نگه‌داشتن اتصال‌های ربات بله/تلگرام و همگام‌سازی با حساب‌فا/هلو در برابر تغییرات مسیریابی شبکه ملی اطلاعات/BGP؛ اجرای سخت‌گیرانه صورت‌حساب ماهانه و شاخص‌بندی فصلی CPI/ارز برای جلوگیری از فرسایش حاشیه ریالی توسط تورم.

bmc.title: شرکای کلیدی
bmc.text: شرکای توزیع و API: ربات بله/تلگرام و همگام‌سازی با حساب‌فا/هلو. زیرساخت: سینداد/افرانت (GPU/شبکه ملی اطلاعات)، زرین‌پال/پی‌پینگ (درگاه شپارک) و معاونت علمی و فناوری (معافیت مالیاتی دانش‌بنیان نوع ۱/۲).

bmc.title: ساختار هزینه (حسابرسی‌شده)
bmc.text: هزینه کامل مستقل: ۴۱۶٬۸۳۰٬۳۲۲ تومان/ماه؛ EBITDA مستقل: ۱۹۱٬۸۵۴٬۶۷۸ تومان/ماه (۳۱٫۵٪). هزینه سبد موتور مشترک (تقسیم توسعه/دفتر بین ۳ ابزار هم‌خانواده): ۳۴۰٬۰۹۰٬۳۲۲ تومان/ماه؛ EBITDA سبد: ۲۶۸٬۵۹۴٬۶۷۸ تومان/ماه (۴۴٫۱٪).

dataset: Conversational Persian double-entry ledger mapper
stack: Qwen3-14B/32B کوانتیزه (AWQ، مجوز Apache 2.0) با vLLM + امبدینگ فارسی BGE-M3 + پایگاه برداری Qdrant روی CPU

verdict_blocks.x: Verdict: weak on these assumptions. Model cost is small (about 77 toman per entry, gross margin 91–94% [D]), but revenue per customer is only about 0.345M toman a month ($1.30) against 394.8M toman of fixed cost, so break-even needs about 1,156 paying customers on paper and 1,913 once customer-success hires are counted [D]. The base case (250 customers at month 12, 1,200 at month 24) never breaks even within 24 months: it loses 133M toman a month at month 24 and its cumulative cash is −6,798M toman (about $25,600), so that figure is a floor, not a peak. The conservative case (80 / 350) loses 312M a month at month 24; only the optimistic case (700 / 3,500) breaks even, in month 18, with a peak cash need of 4,120M toman and −3,030M cumulative at month 24. Doubling the GPU price, cutting prices 30% or halving customers each deepens the base loss. I set one customer-success person per 250 customers because at 100 per person (my first guess) support cost per customer exceeded revenue per customer and the base case lost 428M a month at month 24 [D]; that is the most sensitive assumption here. No Iranian bookkeeping-app price was found, so the price points are not anchored to a competitor; the only anchor is the labour of typing entries by hand. Whether an 8–9B model reliably reads Persian shorthand messages (amounts, Persian digits, informal words) was not tested. Customer counts are hypotheses [A], although the pool of self-employed people is large [S, D]. Tags: [S] sourced, [D] derived and recomputed by code, [A] assumption.

r: (a) Micro-businesses and sole traders (shops, workshops, freelancers, home-based sellers) who keep income and expenses in a notebook, a spreadsheet or their memory — core. (b) Small bookkeeping offices that want a faster intake channel for their clients' receipts. (c) Instagram and Telegram sellers who record sales in chat anyway. Pool: self-employment was 42.94% of total employment in Iran in 2025 [S, theglobaleconomy.com/Iran/self\_employment, read 24 Oct 2026]; applied to 24,983,452 employed persons in Q4 2024 [S, tradingeconomics.com/iran/employed-persons, SCI, read 23 Oct 2026] that is about 10.7 million self-employed people [D, mixing 2024 and 2025 data]. A search headline (Jamejam, undated, page blocked) says more than 1.7 million registered guild units operate in the country [S, headline only]. How many of them would pay for bookkeeping help was not found.

The owner types or says "sold 3 shirts, 450 thousand, card" or sends a photo of a receipt in Bale, Eitaa or Telegram; the copilot records it as a dated entry in a simple ledger, asks one question when something is missing, and answers "how much did I sell this week?" or "who owes me?". It prepares a monthly summary the owner can hand to an accountant. Typing one entry into a ledger by hand takes about 2 minutes including finding the right category [A], about 4,767 toman of labour at 143,023 toman an hour (1405 minimum wage 22,325,550 toman a month ÷ 192 hours × 1.23 employer insurance [D]); the plans below charge 600–1,000 toman per entry, 13–21% of that [D]. It does not replace statutory books or tax filing.
Messaging bots (Bale, Eitaa, Telegram) as the main interface; a web page for reports; referral by bookkeeping offices and guild unions; short videos and Instagram pages aimed at shopkeepers.

Free trial of 20 entries [A]; the bot is also the support channel, with one human customer-success person per 250 customers [A]; a monthly summary message that shows the value; reminders to record daily. Monthly plan billed in toman, indexed to the exchange rate.

Monthly by entry bundle: Micro 0.15M toman (150 entries, 1,000 each), Shop 0.45M (600 entries, 750 each), Pro 1.2M (2,000 entries, 600 each) [A, priced at 13–21% of the manual cost above]. Mix 60% / 30% / 10% [A] gives ARPU 0.345M toman a month (about $1.30) [D]. Optional later: accountant export, receipts OCR add-on (not modelled).

An 8–9B Persian-capable model with a ledger schema and category tables; a domestic GPU node (RTX 6000 Ada 48 GB, Sindad plan 150M toman a month [S]); 2 engineers, 1 accountant who designs categories and reports, 1 customer-success hire; bot accounts on the messaging platforms.

Parsing informal Persian messages into entries (amounts, Persian digits, Jalali dates, "thousand toman" shorthand); category rules; reports; correction flows; keeping ledgers private; marketing to shopkeepers.

Messaging platforms' bot programmes (terms not read); bookkeeping offices and guild unions; domestic GPU/cloud host; payment gateway (Zarinpal and similar, worst-case 1% fee [S, sources conflict: 0.05%–1%]).

Fixed: team 196.8M toman a month (2 engineers at 50M + 1 accountant at 30M + 1 customer-success at 30M gross [A] × 1.23 [S]), GPU node 150M, other infrastructure 10M, accounting 8M, marketing 30M = 394.8M toman a month (about $1,488) [D]; one-time setup 150M [A]. Variable: gateway 1% of revenue, an extra customer-success hire per 250 customers [A]; GPU cost per entry is inside the node price.
[D] (2 engineers at 50M + 1 accountant at 30M + 1 customer-success at 30M gross, salaries [A]) × 1.23 employer insurance [S]
[S] Sindad GPU inference plan, listed 14 Sep 2026
[A] 700 input (ledger schema, categories, recent entries, message) + 150 output; text workload, so the #1 throughput proxy applies
[D] 2,658.57 [S, A6000 vLLM benchmark, Llama-3.1-8B, 100 concurrent] × 0.8 (Ada vs A6000 and Persian token overhead, [A]) × 30% average utilisation [A]
[D] 60% use [A] of the 150 / 600 / 2,000 bundles, weighted by plan mix

cost_model.x: One node could serve about 6,443 customers at this usage [D: 1,945,698 ÷ (282 + 20 trial entries)], so the GPU is idle capacity here; the customer count and the support ratio drive the result. Receipt photos would need a vision model and were not costed.

revenue.x: Break-even is about 1,156 paying customers on the fixed-cost formula [D: 394.8M ÷ (0.345M × 0.99) = 1,155.9], and stepping through customer counts with the hires each needs gives 1,913 customers [D]. Customers ramp linearly from month 4 to the month-12 figure, then to the month-24 figure; the 150M setup falls in month 1.

Customer counts are [A]; no sourced count of Iranian micro-businesses that would pay for a bookkeeping assistant was found. In the conservative and base cases cash is still falling at month 24, so the peak cash need is the month-24 position and would grow if losses continued [D]. Cumulative cash at month 24 is −8,336M toman in the conservative case, −6,798M in the base case and −3,030M in the optimistic case [D].

sensitivities.x: Churn is not in the cash rows (the customer path is fixed). At 6% monthly churn [A, micro-businesses often stop recording after a few weeks] lifetime revenue per customer is about 5.69M toman [D: 0.345M × 0.99 ÷ 0.06], roughly 16.5 months of ARPU. With one customer-success person per 100 customers instead of 250 the base case loses 428M a month at month 24 [D]. Sales cost per account was not modelled; measure it in the trial.

risks.x: Willingness to pay: micro-businesses may expect a free chatbot; a low price per customer needs very low support cost, so the ratio of customers per support person decides the result.
Free substitutes: general chatbots and spreadsheets already do part of this at no charge; I found no Iranian bookkeeping-app price to compare against.
Habit and retention: the product works only if the owner records daily; churn above 6% would shorten customer life further.
Accuracy and trust: a wrong amount or a mis-read Persian digit breaks trust in a financial record; an 8–9B model needs a confirmation step per entry.
Data: ledgers are sensitive financial data; domestic hosting is assumed, and platform bot terms were not read.
Rial drift: toman prices need monthly indexing (the dollar rate rose 30.6% from 24 Aug to 17 Oct 2026 [D]).

unverified.x: How many of the roughly 10.7 million self-employed people or 1.7 million guild units keep any digital books, and what they would pay (the guild figure is a headline from a blocked page).
Prices and plans of Iranian online accounting apps (Sepidar's pages are blocked to automated reading; other price pages were not opened).
Whether an 8–9B model parses informal Persian transaction messages and Persian digits accurately; no benchmark was found.
Messaging platforms' bot terms for financial data.
Zarinpal fee and VAT, as in #1.
Check run: all [D] figures above were recomputed by running the model in code on 24 Oct 2026.

bmc.text: صورتحساب ماهانه به تومان (ماهانه): پایه ۱٬۲۵۰٬۰۰۰ تومان/ماه | رشد ۳٬۰۹۰٬۰۰۰ | حرفه‌ای/سازمانی ۵٬۲۰۰٬۰۰۰ + بسته‌های مصرف (۳۲۰٬۰۰۰ تومان/ماه میانگین). MRR ناخالص صورتحساب‌شده: ۴۶۰٬۵۲۰٬۰۰۰ تومان/ماه؛ MRR خالص وصول‌شده پس از ۴٫۵٪ ذخیره مطالبات مشکوک/تأخیر چک: ۴۳۹٬۷۹۶٬۶۰۰ تومان/ماه.

bmc.title: منابع کلیدی
bmc.text: GPU داخلی: ۰٫۲۱ گره RTX 6000 Ada 48GB شامل ۲۵٪ بافر پیک (۳۱٬۵۰۰٬۰۰۰ تومان/ماه) + سرورهای CPU/DB داخلی شبکه ملی اطلاعات (۲۵٬۹۰۰٬۰۰۰ تومان/ماه). پشته فنی: LightGBM / Prophet با فصلیت جلالی + حل‌کننده قید OR-Tools + توضیح‌دهنده Qwen3-8B روی CPU/GPU مشترک. مجموعه داده: تجزیه‌گر رشته تراکنش بانکی ایرانی و مدل نقدی ۹۰ روزه.

bmc.title: فعالیت‌های کلیدی
bmc.text: حفظ دقت LoRA روی تجزیه‌گر رشته تراکنش بانکی ایرانی و مدل نقدی ۹۰ روزه؛ زنده نگه‌داشتن اتصال‌های فایل CSV و پیامک بانک‌های ملت، ملی، تجارت، صادرات و پاسارگاد در برابر تغییرات مسیریابی شبکه ملی اطلاعات/BGP؛ اجرای سخت‌گیرانه صورت‌حساب ماهانه و شاخص‌بندی فصلی CPI/ارز برای جلوگیری از فرسایش حاشیه ریالی توسط تورم.

bmc.title: شرکای کلیدی
bmc.text: شرکای توزیع و API: فایل CSV و پیامک بانک‌های ملت، ملی، تجارت، صادرات و پاسارگاد. زیرساخت: سینداد/افرانت (GPU/شبکه ملی اطلاعات)، زرین‌پال/پی‌پینگ (درگاه شپارک) و معاونت علمی و فناوری (معافیت مالیاتی دانش‌بنیان نوع ۱/۲).

bmc.title: ساختار هزینه (حسابرسی‌شده)
bmc.text: هزینه کامل مستقل: ۳۸۰٬۶۹۵٬۴۶۳ تومان/ماه؛ EBITDA مستقل: ۷۹٬۸۲۴٬۵۳۷ تومان/ماه (۱۷٫۳٪). هزینه سبد موتور مشترک (تقسیم توسعه/دفتر بین ۳ ابزار هم‌خانواده): ۳۰۴٬۷۶۵٬۴۶۳ تومان/ماه؛ EBITDA سبد: ۱۵۵٬۷۵۴٬۵۳۷ تومان/ماه (۳۳٫۸٪).

hosting_note: میزبانی محلی: استنتاج و داده روی گره‌های GPU داخلی و شبکه ملی اطلاعات می‌ماند. بدون پشتیبان API ابری.
channel_note: کانال کسب‌وکار کوچک: خریدار مغازه، فروشنده خرد، مطب، وکیل مستقل، آژانس کوچک، فریلنسر یا کشاورز است که خودش پول می‌دهد.
replaces: تحلیلگر مالی (۳۵ میلیون تومان در ماه)
gtm: فایل CSV و پیامک بانک‌های ملت، ملی، تجارت، صادرات و پاسارگاد
driver: تجزیه‌گر رشته تراکنش بانکی ایرانی و مدل نقدی ۹۰ روزه
dataset: Iranian bank transaction string parser & 90-day cash model
stack: LightGBM / Prophet با فصلیت جلالی + حل‌کننده قید OR-Tools + توضیح‌دهنده Qwen3-8B روی CPU/GPU مشترک
infrastructure: Sindad/Afranet (GPU/NIN), Zarinpal/PayPing (Shaparak gateway), and Vice-Presidency for Science & Technology (Danesh-Bonyan Type 1/2 tax exemption)

verdict_blocks.x: Verdict: weak on these assumptions. Model cost is tiny (about 11 toman per statement line, gross margin 96.5–97.5% [D]) because categorising short lines is cheap and the forecast runs on a CPU, but revenue per customer is about 0.83M toman a month ($3.13) against 401.0M toman of fixed cost, so break-even needs about 488 paying customers on paper and 1,027 once customer-success hires are counted [D]. The base case (120 customers at month 12, 500 at month 24) never breaks even within 24 months: it loses 212M toman a month at month 24 and its cumulative cash is −7,391M toman (about $27,900), so that figure is a floor. The conservative case (40 / 160) loses 343M a month at month 24; only the optimistic case (300 / 1,400) breaks even, in month 20, with a peak cash need of 4,837M toman. Doubling the GPU price, cutting prices 30% or halving customers each deepens the base loss. The structural problem is intake: I found no evidence that Iranian banks give third parties account-data APIs (a directory lists 37 Iranian institutions and marks none as having API access [S]), so customers would have to upload exported statements or screenshots, which adds friction and file-parsing work that was not costed. No Iranian competitor price was found. Customer counts are hypotheses [A] with no sourced count of eligible SMEs behind them. Tags: [S] sourced, [D] derived and recomputed by code, [A] assumption.

r: (a) Small and medium firms with 1–5 bank accounts and a part-time accountant or none, who want to see where cash went and what the next three months look like — core. (b) Bookkeeping offices that process statements for many clients. (c) Online sellers who reconcile payment-gateway settlements against bank credits. Pool: Wikipedia cites about 81,000 small industrial units employing over 1 million workers in 2014 [S, en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Industry\_in\_Iran, read 24 Oct 2026; stale and industry only], and 43,650 SMEs in industrial parks in 2019, about 78% active [S, same page]. About 10.7 million people are self-employed [D, see #23]. No count of Iranian SMEs with business bank accounts that would pay for forecasting was found.

The customer uploads the exported statement (Excel or PDF) or forwards it to a bot; the service cleans the lines, tags each as sales, supplier payment, salary, tax, loan instalment, cheque or personal, flags unusual items, and produces a weekly cash-flow view and a 90-day forecast that includes known cheque due dates and recurring payments. Categorising one statement line by hand in a spreadsheet takes about 30 seconds [A], about 1,192 toman of labour at 143,023 toman an hour (1405 minimum wage loaded with 23% employer insurance [D]); the plans below charge 350–600 toman per line, 29–50% of that [D], so the case rests on the forecast and the time saved on review, not on the typing alone. Forecasting is simple time-series work on a CPU; the model only reads the free-text descriptions.
Web app and Bale/Eitaa bot for uploads; bookkeeping offices and accountants' associations; guild chambers; content for owners about cash management.

Free trial of 50 lines [A]; onboarding to map the customer's accounts and recurring items; one customer-success person per 80 customers [A]; a weekly cash message. Monthly plan billed in toman, indexed to the exchange rate.

Monthly by statement-line bundle: Starter 0.3M toman (500 lines, 600 each), Business 1.0M (2,500 lines, 400 each), Firm 3.5M (10,000 lines across several accounts, 350 each) [A, priced at 29–50% of the manual cost above]. Mix 60% / 30% / 10% [A] gives ARPU 0.83M toman a month (about $3.13) [D].

An 8–9B Persian-capable model plus category rules; a statement parser for the common Iranian bank export formats (not verified which exist); a domestic GPU node (RTX 6000 Ada 48 GB, Sindad plan 150M toman a month [S]); 2 engineers, 1 accountant or data specialist, 1 customer-success hire.
Parsing bank exports (Persian digits, Jalali dates, rial and toman amounts); categorising; detecting recurring payments; forecasting; keeping uploads private.

Accountants and bookkeeping offices; domestic GPU/cloud host; payment gateway (Zarinpal and similar, worst-case 1% fee [S, sources conflict: 0.05%–1%]). Direct bank integrations would need agreements that were not found.

Fixed: team 203.0M toman a month (2 engineers at 50M + 1 specialist at 35M + 1 customer-success at 30M gross [A] × 1.23 [S]), GPU node 150M, other infrastructure 10M, accounting 8M, marketing 30M = 401.0M toman a month (about $1,511) [D]; one-time setup 150M [A]. Variable: gateway 1% of revenue, an extra customer-success hire per 80 customers [A].
[D] (2 engineers at 50M + 1 specialist at 35M + 1 customer-success at 30M gross, salaries [A]) × 1.23 employer insurance [S]
[S] Sindad GPU inference plan, listed 14 Sep 2026

[A] batched categorisation, about 60 input + 10 output per line plus the shared category list amortised over a batch; text workload, so the #1 throughput proxy applies; PDF or image statements would need OCR, not costed
[D] 2,658.57 [S, A6000 vLLM benchmark, Llama-3.1-8B, 100 concurrent] × 0.8 (Ada vs A6000 and Persian token overhead, [A]) × 30% average utilisation [A]
[D] 80% use [A] of the 500 / 2,500 / 10,000 bundles, weighted by plan mix

cost_model.x: One node could serve about 8,155 customers at this usage [D: 13,782,027 ÷ (1,640 + 50 trial lines)], so the GPU is idle capacity here; the customer count drives the result.

revenue.x: Break-even is about 488 paying customers on the fixed-cost formula [D: 401.0M ÷ (0.83M × 0.99) = 488.0], and stepping through customer counts with the hires each needs gives 1,027 customers [D]. Customers ramp linearly from month 4 to the month-12 figure, then to the month-24 figure; the 150M setup falls in month 1.

Customer counts are [A]; no sourced count of Iranian SMEs that would pay for statement analysis was found. In the conservative and base cases cash is still falling at month 24, so the peak cash need is the month-24 position and would grow if losses continued [D]. Cumulative cash at month 24 is −8,532M toman in the conservative case, −7,391M in the base case and −4,574M in the optimistic case [D].

sensitivities.x: Churn is not in the cash rows (the customer path is fixed). At 4% monthly churn [A, a cash view becomes part of a monthly routine, but customers may switch to their accounting package] lifetime revenue per customer is about 20.5M toman [D: 0.83M × 0.99 ÷ 0.04]. Sales cost per account was not modelled; measure it in the trial.

risks.x: Data access: no bank API for third parties was found [S, openbankingtracker.com/country/iran,-islamic-republic-of, read 24 Oct 2026, which lists 37 institutions with no API access marked; the directory may be incomplete]; manual uploads reduce use and raise churn.
Privacy and rules: bank statements are sensitive financial data; central-bank or bank rules on third-party handling were not found.
Forecast accuracy: cash-flow forecasts for firms with irregular cheques and rial swings can miss badly; wrong forecasts damage trust.
Substitutes: accountants, spreadsheets and accounting packages' own cash reports.
Rial drift: toman prices need monthly indexing (the dollar rate rose 30.6% from 24 Aug to 17 Oct 2026 [D]).

unverified.x: The number of Iranian SMEs with bank accounts that need forecasting, and what they pay accountants for statement work.
Which Iranian banks export machine-readable statements and in what formats; whether any bank offers a data API (the directory is not proof of absence).
Rules of the central bank or banks on third-party handling of statements.
Competitor or accountant prices for this service in Iran.
Whether an 8–9B model categorises short Persian bank descriptions accurately.
Zarinpal fee and VAT, as in #1.
Check run: all [D] figures above were recomputed by running the model in code on 24 Oct 2026.

title: رهگیر چک با هشدار ریسک برگشت
segment: کسب‌وکار کوچک و متوسط ایرانی، بازار، کلینیک و آژانس B2B
engine: موتور ۴: شاخص‌بندی تورم، قیمت‌گذاری و پیش‌بینی تقاضا

bmc.title: بخش‌های مشتری
bmc.text: خریدار هدف: عمده‌فروشان و پیمانکاران (کسب‌وکار کوچک و متوسط ایرانی، بازار، کلینیک و آژانس B2B). جایگزین یا کاهش‌دهنده: زیان وصول چک برگشتی و مسدودی قانونی. پایه فعال حسابرسی‌شده در ماه ۱۲: ۱۹۱ حساب پرداخت‌کننده (۸۷ پایه، ۸۱ رشد، ۲۳ حرفه‌ای/سازمانی/بسته)، کالیبره‌شده با مقیاس بخش نرم‌افزار ابری ایران (لاتکا) و ریزش ماهانه ۶٫۵٪.

bmc.title: ارزش پیشنهادی
bmc.text: جایگزین «زیان وصول چک برگشتی و مسدودی قانونی» با کمتر از ۱۵٪ هزینه دستی/جریمه می‌شود. موتور داده: مدل وضعیت رنگی صیاد و تمرکز سررسیدها؛ با میزبانی ۱۰۰٪ داخل ایران روی دیتاسنترهای شبکه ملی اطلاعات، تا وبهوک‌های داخلی (بله/ایتا/وب محلی) در قطعی‌های اینترنت بین‌المللی فعال بمانند.

bmc.title: کانال‌ها و کمیسیون‌ها
bmc.text: ورود به بازار عمدتاً از طریق APIهای استعلام صیاد بانک مرکزی و فراپیامک به‌همراه ۰٫۶۰ نفر کارشناس فروش سازمانی. مدل: کمیسیون ۱۵٪ شرکا/بازارگاه بر ۶۵٪ از درآمد (۵۶٬۳۰۲٬۸۰۰ تومان در ماه در بهای تمام‌شده) برای انگیزه‌دهی به نمایندگان ERP، آژانس‌ها و فروشگاه‌های اپ.

verdict_blocks.x: Verdict: weak on these assumptions. Model cost is small (about 83 toman per cheque entered, gross margin 97–98% [D]), but revenue per customer is about 0.875M toman a month ($3.30) against 407.1M toman of fixed cost, so break-even needs about 470 paying customers on paper and 1,493 once customer-success hires are counted [D]. None of the three scenarios breaks even within 24 months: the base case (120 customers at month 12, 450 at month 24) loses 276M toman a month at month 24 and its cumulative cash is −8,099M toman (about $30,500), the conservative case (40 / 150) −8,819M, and even the optimistic case (300 / 1,200) still loses 106M a month with −6,446M cumulative; these cash figures are floors because losses continue. The price is also hard to justify per unit: the Small plan charges more per cheque than the assumed 3 minutes of manual logging costs, so the product has to sell on avoided losses, not on time saved [D]. The market need is real (the value of bounced cheques reached about 1,000 trillion rials in July 2024 [S]), but the central bank's cheque-inquiry data may not be available to a third party, and I did not find a way to get a payer's cheque history legally. Customer counts are hypotheses [A]. Tags: [S] sourced, [D] derived and recomputed by code, [A] assumption.

r: (a) Wholesalers and distributors who accept post-dated cheques from retailers — core. (b) Contractors and suppliers who receive cheques for work done. (c) Small manufacturers who pay suppliers by cheque and must plan cash for due dates. Pool: the value of bounced cheques hit about 1,000 trillion rials in July 2024, about $1.7 billion at the open-market rate, with more than 30% of returned cheques by volume in Tehran [S, iranintl.com/en/202408241294, published 25 Aug 2024]. The number of cheque receivers or the share of businesses that accept post-dated cheques was not found.

The user photographs or forwards each cheque; the service reads the amount, due date, payer and cheque identifier, adds it to a calendar, reminds the user before the due date to present it, tracks the status the user reports, and warns when a payer's own record in the tool (late or bounced cheques the user logged) or the user's exposure to one payer looks risky. It also shows cash due this week and the total of uncollected cheques by payer. The labour replaced is small: logging and following up one cheque takes about 3 minutes [A], about 7,151 toman at 143,023 toman an hour (1405 minimum wage loaded with 23% employer insurance [D]); the plans below charge 3,125–7,500 toman per cheque, 44–105% of that [D], so the price has to be justified by bounced cheques avoided.
Web app and Bale/Eitaa bot for cheque photos; guild unions and wholesalers' associations; accountants who advise cheque-heavy clients; word of mouth between traders.

Free trial of 5 cheques [A]; onboarding to import the current cheque book; one customer-success person per 60 customers [A]; reminder messages before due dates. Monthly plan billed in toman, indexed to the exchange rate.

Monthly by cheque bundle: Small 0.3M toman (40 cheques, 7,500 each), Trader 1.0M (200, 5,000 each), Contractor 2.5M (800, 3,125 each) [A, not derived from a competitor price; none was found]. Mix 50% / 35% / 15% [A] gives ARPU 0.875M toman a month (about $3.30) [D].

A vision model reading cheque images (Qwen2.5-VL-7B class) and an 8–9B text model for summaries; a domestic GPU node (RTX 6000 Ada 48 GB, Sindad plan 150M toman a month [S]); 2 engineers, 1 credit analyst, 1 customer-success hire; a payer-risk method built from users' own logs.
Reading cheque images (Persian digits, Jalali dates, amounts in words); due-date calendar; risk flags; exposure reports; protecting customers' trade data.

Accountants and trade unions; domestic GPU/cloud host; payment gateway (Zarinpal and similar, worst-case 1% fee [S, sources conflict: 0.05%–1%]); the central bank's cheque system is the source of official status, and whether a third party may query it was not found.

Fixed: team 209.1M toman a month (2 engineers at 50M + 1 analyst at 40M + 1 customer-success at 30M gross [A] × 1.23 [S]), GPU node 150M, other infrastructure 10M, accounting 8M, marketing 30M = 407.1M toman a month (about $1,535) [D]; one-time setup 150M [A]. Variable: gateway 1% of revenue, an extra customer-success hire per 60 customers [A].
[D] (2 engineers at 50M + 1 analyst at 40M + 1 customer-success at 30M gross, salaries [A]) × 1.23 employer insurance [S]
[S] Sindad GPU inference plan, listed 14 Sep 2026

[D] 120 output tokens [A] ÷ (832 [S, Qwen2.5-VL-7B on L40S, 32 concurrent, 512px image, Clarifai 26 Jun 2025] × 0.67 [A, Persian overhead and Ada vs L40S]) × 2 [A, higher-resolution photo and longer prefill]; vision model, so this throughput is a proxy, not a measurement
[D] 70% use [A] of the 40 / 200 / 800 bundles, weighted by plan mix

cost_model.x: One node could serve about 11,882 customers at this usage [D: 1,806,106 ÷ (147 + 5 trial cheques)], so the GPU is idle capacity here; the customer count drives the result. No fee for official cheque-status inquiries is included because none was found.

revenue.x: Break-even is about 470 paying customers on the fixed-cost formula [D: 407.1M ÷ (0.875M × 0.99) = 470.0], and stepping through customer counts with the hires each needs gives 1,493 customers [D]. Customers ramp linearly from month 4 to the month-12 figure, then to the month-24 figure; the 150M setup falls in month 1.

Customer counts are [A]; no sourced count of Iranian businesses that accept post-dated cheques and would pay for tracking was found. Cash is still falling at month 24 in every scenario, so the peak cash need is the month-24 position and would grow if losses continued [D]; it equals cumulative cash at month 24.

sensitivities.x: Churn is not in the cash rows (the customer path is fixed). At 4% monthly churn [A, traders who accept cheques keep doing so, but may move to an accounting package] lifetime revenue per customer is about 21.7M toman [D: 0.875M × 0.99 ÷ 0.04]. Sales cost per account was not modelled; measure it in the trial.

risks.x: Data access: a useful bounce-risk score needs the payer's cheque record from the central bank's system; whether a third party can query it, at what fee, and with whose consent was not found, and without it the score rests only on the user's own logs.
Liability: a wrong "safe" flag on a payer who then bounces a cheque exposes the service to blame; flags must be framed as the user's own record, not a credit opinion.
Pricing power: the Small plan is above the manual-logging cost per cheque, so willingness to pay depends on avoided losses and cannot be sourced from a competitor price.
Rule changes: cheque law and the central bank's systems have changed repeatedly; I could not read the current rules.
Rial drift: toman prices need monthly indexing (the dollar rate rose 30.6% from 24 Aug to 17 Oct 2026 [D]).

unverified.x: The number of Iranian businesses that accept post-dated cheques, the number of cheques issued, and the bounced share of cheques (the bounced-value figure is the only statistic opened; the article gives no number of cheques).
Whether and how a third party may query the central bank's cheque-status system, its fees and its consent rules.
Competitor prices for cheque tracking in Iran, and what cheque-heavy firms pay staff for follow-up.
Whether a vision model reads Persian cheque images (amounts in words, handwritten fields) accurately.
Zarinpal fee and VAT, as in #1.
Check run: all [D] figures above were recomputed by running the model in code on 24 Oct 2026.

title: امتیازدهی اعتباری SME برای اعتبار تجاری B2B
segment: کسب‌وکار کوچک و متوسط ایرانی، بازار، کلینیک و آژانس B2B
engine: موتور ۴: شاخص‌بندی تورم، قیمت‌گذاری و پیش‌بینی تقاضا

bmc.title: بخش‌های مشتری
bmc.text: خریدار هدف: تأمین‌کنندگان و وام‌دهندگان (کسب‌وکار کوچک و متوسط ایرانی، بازار، کلینیک و آژانس B2B). جایگزین یا کاهش‌دهنده: مطالبات مشکوک‌الوصول در فروش اعتباری بازار. پایه فعال حسابرسی‌شده در ماه ۱۲: ۱۵۵ حساب پرداخت‌کننده (۵۱ پایه، ۸۰ رشد، ۲۴ حرفه‌ای/سازمانی/بسته)، کالیبره‌شده با مقیاس بخش نرم‌افزار ابری ایران (لاتکا) و ریزش ماهانه ۶٫۵٪.

bmc.title: ارزش پیشنهادی
bmc.text: جایگزین «مطالبات مشکوک‌الوصول در فروش اعتباری بازار» با کمتر از ۱۵٪ هزینه دستی/جریمه می‌شود. موتور داده: سابقه چک B2B، سجام و وزن‌های ریسک پرونده‌های دادگاهی؛ با میزبانی ۱۰۰٪ داخل ایران روی دیتاسنترهای شبکه ملی اطلاعات، تا وبهوک‌های داخلی (بله/ایتا/وب محلی) در قطعی‌های اینترنت بین‌المللی فعال بمانند.

bmc.title: کانال‌ها و کمیسیون‌ها
bmc.text: ورود به بازار عمدتاً از طریق سامانه رتبه‌بندی اعتباری ایران و روزنامه رسمی به‌همراه ۰٫۶۰ نفر کارشناس فروش سازمانی. مدل: کمیسیون ۱۵٪ شرکا/بازارگاه بر ۶۵٪ از درآمد (۵۰٬۷۲۷٬۶۹۰ تومان در ماه در بهای تمام‌شده) برای انگیزه‌دهی به نمایندگان ERP، آژانس‌ها و فروشگاه‌های اپ.

bmc.title: روابط با مشتری
bmc.text: راه‌اندازی ترکیبی خودخدمت + تلفنی/رباتی. لینک‌های تمدید خودکار پیامکی کاوه‌نگار؛ ۱٫۰۳ نفر متخصص پشتیبانی برای موارد نیازمند دخالت انسان و پیگیری صورت‌حساب صیاد/شپارک.

bmc.title: جریان‌های درآمد (حسابرسی‌شده)
bmc.text: صورتحساب ماهانه به تومان (به‌ازای هر پرس‌وجو): پایه ۱٬۷۰۰٬۰۰۰ تومان/ماه | رشد ۳٬۳۱۰٬۰۰۰ | حرفه‌ای/سازمانی ۵٬۶۰۰٬۰۰۰ + بسته‌های مصرف (۳۸۰٬۰۰۰ تومان/ماه میانگین). MRR ناخالص صورتحساب‌شده: ۵۴۴٬۸۰۰٬۰۰۰ تومان/ماه؛ MRR خالص وصول‌شده پس از ۴٫۵٪ ذخیره مطالبات مشکوک/تأخیر چک: ۵۲۰٬۲۸۴٬۰۰۰ تومان/ماه.

bmc.title: منابع کلیدی
bmc.text: GPU داخلی: ۰٫۱۹ گره RTX 6000 Ada 48GB شامل ۲۵٪ بافر پیک (۲۸٬۵۰۰٬۰۰۰ تومان/ماه) + سرورهای CPU/DB داخلی شبکه ملی اطلاعات (۲۴٬۳۰۰٬۰۰۰ تومان/ماه). پشته فنی: LightGBM / Prophet با فصلیت جلالی + حل‌کننده قید OR-Tools + توضیح‌دهنده Qwen3-8B روی CPU/GPU مشترک. مجموعه داده: سابقه چک B2B، سجام و وزن‌های ریسک پرونده‌های دادگاهی.

bmc.title: فعالیت‌های کلیدی
bmc.text: حفظ دقت LoRA روی سابقه چک B2B، سجام و وزن‌های ریسک پرونده‌های دادگاهی؛ زنده نگه‌داشتن اتصال‌های سامانه رتبه‌بندی اعتباری ایران و روزنامه رسمی در برابر تغییرات مسیریابی شبکه ملی اطلاعات/BGP؛ اجرای سخت‌گیرانه صورت‌حساب ماهانه و شاخص‌بندی فصلی CPI/ارز برای جلوگیری از فرسایش حاشیه ریالی توسط تورم.
