title: مربی مهارت برنامه‌نویسی و اکسل به فارسی
segment: حرفه‌ای/خرد، خرده‌فروش و B2B2C (بسته‌های مدرسه/پلتفرم)
engine: موتور ۵A: تولید محتوای فارسی و نگارش بازاریابی/آکادمیک

bmc.title: بخش‌های مشتری
bmc.text: خریدار هدف: زبان‌آموزان و کارمندان (حرفه‌ای/خرد، خرده‌فروش و B2B2C (بسته‌های مدرسه/پلتفرم)). جایگزین یا کاهش‌دهنده: شهریه بوت‌کمپ (۱۵ تا ۴۰ میلیون تومان) یا دوره‌های کوئرا/فرادرس. پایه فعال حسابرسی‌شده در ماه ۱۲: ۴۷۷ حساب پرداخت‌کننده (۲۴۰ پایه، ۱۹۵ رشد، ۴۲ حرفه‌ای/سازمانی/بسته)، کالیبره‌شده با مقیاس بخش نرم‌افزار ابری ایران (لاتکا) و ریزش ماهانه ۱۳٫۰٪.

bmc.title: ارزش پیشنهادی
bmc.text: جایگزین «شهریه بوت‌کمپ (۱۵ تا ۴۰ میلیون تومان) یا دوره‌های کوئرا/فرادرس» با کمتر از ۱۵٪ هزینه دستی/جریمه می‌شود. موتور داده: فرمول‌های اکسل با تاریخ جلالی، کدگذاری فارسی و مربی پایتون/SQL؛ با میزبانی ۱۰۰٪ داخل ایران روی دیتاسنترهای شبکه ملی اطلاعات، تا وبهوک‌های داخلی (بله/ایتا/وب محلی) در قطعی‌های اینترنت بین‌المللی فعال بمانند.

bmc.title: کانال‌ها و کمیسیون‌ها
bmc.text: ورود به بازار عمدتاً از طریق محیط تمرین مرورگر و ربات بله/تلگرام به‌همراه ۰٫۴۵ نفر کارشناس فروش سازمانی. مدل: کمیسیون ۱۲٪ شرکا/بازارگاه بر ۶۵٪ از درآمد (۳۱٬۱۲۸٬۷۸۶ تومان در ماه در بهای تمام‌شده) برای انگیزه‌دهی به نمایندگان ERP، آژانس‌ها و فروشگاه‌های اپ.

bmc.title: روابط با مشتری
bmc.text: راه‌اندازی ترکیبی خودخدمت + تلفنی/رباتی. لینک‌های تمدید خودکار پیامکی کاوه‌نگار؛ ۱٫۵۶ نفر متخصص پشتیبانی برای موارد نیازمند دخالت انسان و پیگیری صورت‌حساب صیاد/شپارک.

bmc.title: جریان‌های درآمد (حسابرسی‌شده)
bmc.text: صورتحساب ماهانه به تومان (ماهانه): پایه ۳۲۰٬۰۰۰ تومان/ماه | رشد ۹۳۰٬۰۰۰ | حرفه‌ای/سازمانی ۲٬۳۵۰٬۰۰۰ + بسته‌های مصرف (۱۱۰٬۰۰۰ تومان/ماه میانگین). MRR ناخالص صورتحساب‌شده: ۴۰۹٬۳۲۰٬۰۰۰ تومان/ماه؛ MRR خالص وصول‌شده پس از ۲٫۵٪ ذخیره مطالبات مشکوک/تأخیر چک: ۳۹۹٬۰۸۷٬۰۰۰ تومان/ماه.

bmc.title: منابع کلیدی
bmc.text: GPU داخلی: ۰٫۲۰ گره RTX 6000 Ada 48GB شامل ۲۵٪ بافر پیک (۳۰٬۰۰۰٬۰۰۰ تومان/ماه) + سرورهای CPU/DB داخلی شبکه ملی اطلاعات (۲۸٬۶۰۰٬۰۰۰ تومان/ماه). پشته فنی: Qwen3-14B / DeepSeek-V3 Distill کوانتیزه با آداپتورهای LoRA لحن برند فارسی. مجموعه داده: فرمول‌های اکسل با تاریخ جلالی، کدگذاری فارسی و مربی پایتون/SQL.

bmc.title: فعالیت‌های کلیدی
bmc.text: حفظ دقت LoRA روی فرمول‌های اکسل با تاریخ جلالی، کدگذاری فارسی و مربی پایتون/SQL؛ زنده نگه‌داشتن اتصال‌های محیط تمرین مرورگر و ربات بله/تلگرام در برابر تغییرات مسیریابی شبکه ملی اطلاعات/BGP؛ اجرای سخت‌گیرانه صورت‌حساب ماهانه و شاخص‌بندی فصلی CPI/ارز برای جلوگیری از فرسایش حاشیه ریالی توسط تورم.

bmc.title: شرکای کلیدی
bmc.text: شرکای توزیع و API: محیط تمرین مرورگر و ربات بله/تلگرام. زیرساخت: سینداد/افرانت (GPU/شبکه ملی اطلاعات)، زرین‌پال/پی‌پینگ (درگاه شپارک) و معاونت علمی و فناوری (معافیت مالیاتی دانش‌بنیان نوع ۱/۲).

bmc.title: ساختار هزینه (حسابرسی‌شده)
bmc.text: هزینه کامل مستقل: ۳۲۵٬۶۷۴٬۷۱۶ تومان/ماه؛ EBITDA مستقل: ۸۳٬۶۴۵٬۲۸۴ تومان/ماه (۲۰٫۴٪). هزینه سبد موتور مشترک (تقسیم توسعه/دفتر بین ۳ ابزار هم‌خانواده): ۲۶۳٬۹۰۴٬۷۱۶ تومان/ماه؛ EBITDA سبد: ۱۴۵٬۴۱۵٬۲۸۴ تومان/ماه (۳۵٫۵٪).

verdict_blocks.x: Verdict: marginal. The base case breaks even in month 9 and earns +1,679M toman a month (about $6,329) at month 24 with 9,000 paying subscribers, which is 0.036% of the 24.98 million employed people in Iran [S, SCI Q4 2024]; the conservative case (2,400) breaks even in month 19 and has not repaid its cash need by month 24 (cumulative −3,373M) [D]. The price per subscriber is low (ARPU about $1.04), so the result depends on a large consumer base and cheap acquisition, and subscriber counts are assumptions. Free chatbots already answer coding and Excel questions, and I found no Iranian price for tutoring in these skills. The coach can only be sold if it does something free chat does not, such as run the learner's own spreadsheet or code safely and track a path.

r: (a) Employees and students learning Excel, Python, SQL or web basics. (b) Office workers who need Excel formulas, in Persian with Persian digits and right-to-left sheets. (c) Companies buying seats for staff [A]. Pool: 24.98 million employed people (SCI Q4 2024 [S]) and 73.8 million internet users (Datareportal, Oct 2025 [S]); the share who would pay is unknown. 9,000 subscribers at month 24 is [A].

A chat coach that explains a formula or a code error in Persian, reads an uploaded workbook or script, suggests a fix, gives exercises and tracks progress. The labour replaced is a 10-minute tutor or colleague help [A], 23,837 toman at 143,023 toman an hour (1405 minimum wage loaded with 23% employer insurance [D]). The plans work out at 2,500, 2,000 and 1,800 toman an interaction, 10.5%, 8.4% and 7.6% of that cost [D]. Foreign anchors: GitHub Copilot at $10 a month and Cursor at $20 a month (morphllm.com comparison, read 28 Oct 2026 [S]); these are tools for developers, not Persian learners. Persian course-platform prices (Faradars, Maktabkhooneh) could not be retrieved.
Telegram and Instagram communities for Excel and programming, YouTube and Aparat tutorials, referral codes, bundles with course sellers, and a free 10-interaction trial.
Self-service app and Telegram bot; progress tracking; 1 support person per 1,500 subscribers [A]. Prices in toman, indexed to the exchange rate.

Monthly plans: Learner with 60 interactions 150,000 toman (about $0.57), Pro with 200 interactions 400,000 (about $1.51), Team seat with 500 interactions 900,000 (about $3.39) [A, no price was found]. Mix 60% / 35% / 5% [A] gives ARPU 275,000 toman a month (about $1.04) [D]. Subscribers use 50% of their quota [A]. 20% monthly churn [A].

A 14B-class model with a sandbox for running spreadsheets and code on a domestic GPU node (RTX 6000 Ada 48 GB, Sindad plan 150M toman a month [S]); an exercise library; 2 engineers at 50M and 1 support person at 25M, gross [A].
Building the safe execution sandbox, Persian explanations of errors and formulas, exercise design, a Telegram bot, consumer marketing.
Domestic GPU/cloud host, course platforms and content creators for distribution, and a payment gateway (worst-case 1% fee [S, sources conflict: 0.05%–1%]).

Fixed: team 153.75M toman a month ((50M + 50M + 25M) gross [A] × 1.23 [S]), GPU node 150M, other infrastructure 10M, accounting 8M, marketing 100M = 421.75M toman a month (about $1,590) [D]; one-time setup 150M [A] (about $565). Variable: gateway 1% of revenue, 25 toman per interaction for sandbox runs [A], GPU time, and an added node when load passes one node's capacity.
[D] (2 engineers at 50M + 1 support at 25M, gross, salaries [A]) × 1.23 employer insurance [S]
[S] Sindad GPU inference plan, listed 14 Sep 2026
[A] about 1,500 tokens in and 600 out; 2,100 tokens at 2,658.57 tokens a second [S, A6000 vLLM benchmark, Llama-3.1-8B] × 0.8 [A] × 0.55 for a 14B-class model [A]
[D] 50% use [A] of the 60 / 200 / 500 quotas, weighted by plan mix

cost_model.x: One node serves about 5,737 subscribers including 10 free trial interactions each [D: 433,149 ÷ (65.5 + 10)], so the base case needs one node at month 12 and 2 at month 24, and the optimistic case 5 [D]. Gross margin is high; the constraint is the low revenue per subscriber against a fixed cost of about 422M a month.

revenue.x: Break-even is about 1,559 paying subscribers on the fixed-cost formula [D: 421.75M ÷ (275,000 × 0.99 − 65.5 × 25) = 1,558.5], and stepping through subscriber counts with support staff and nodes gives 1,673 [D]. Subscribers ramp linearly from month 4 to the month-12 figure, then to the month-24 figure; the 150M setup falls in month 1.

Subscriber counts are [A]. Cumulative cash at month 24 is −3,373M toman in the conservative case, +12,054M in the base case and +45,852M in the optimistic case [D]. Lifetime value per subscriber at 20% churn is about 1.35M toman, about $5.10 [D: (275,000 × 0.99 − 65.5 × 25) ÷ 0.20].

sensitivities.x: The base case holds 9,000 subscribers at 20% monthly churn [A], which needs 1,800 replacements a month and the ramp adds 500 [D], so about 2,300 gross additions a month at month 24. With 100M of marketing that is about 43,500 toman (about $0.16) per subscriber [D], below a plausible cost of acquiring a paying consumer; the model does not stress marketing, so the break-even months above are optimistic on acquisition.

risks.x: Free substitutes: general chatbots answer Excel and code questions at no charge, and the product must beat them on Persian, on files and on guided learning.
Churn: learners leave when the skill is learned; 20% monthly churn is an assumption and 30% would cut lifetime value by a third.
Willingness to pay: no Iranian price for coding or Excel tutoring was found, and the toman prices above are guesses.
Sandbox safety: running user code and spreadsheets needs isolation and costs engineering time not separately budgeted.
Accuracy: wrong formulas or code in Persian explanations damage trust; evaluation was not done.
Rial drift: toman prices need monthly indexing (the dollar rate rose 30.6% from 24 Aug to 17 Oct 2026 [D]).

bmc.title: بخش‌های مشتری
bmc.text: خریدار هدف: استخدام‌کنندگان و کسب‌وکارهای کوچک و متوسط (کسب‌وکار کوچک و متوسط ایرانی، بازار، کلینیک و آژانس B2B). جایگزین یا کاهش‌دهنده: کارشناس منابع انسانی برای بررسی بیش از ۵۰۰ فایل PDF (۲۴ میلیون تومان در ماه). پایه فعال حسابرسی‌شده در ماه ۱۲: ۱۹۱ حساب پرداخت‌کننده (۶۹ پایه، ۹۹ رشد، ۲۳ حرفه‌ای/سازمانی/بسته)، کالیبره‌شده با مقیاس بخش نرم‌افزار ابری ایران (لاتکا) و ریزش ماهانه ۷٫۰٪.

bmc.title: ارزش پیشنهادی
bmc.text: جایگزین «کارشناس منابع انسانی برای بررسی بیش از ۵۰۰ فایل PDF (۲۴ میلیون تومان در ماه)» با کمتر از ۱۵٪ هزینه دستی/جریمه می‌شود. موتور داده: رتبه‌بندی دانشگاه‌های ایران، وضعیت نظام وظیفه و استخراج مهارت؛ با میزبانی ۱۰۰٪ داخل ایران روی دیتاسنترهای شبکه ملی اطلاعات، تا وبهوک‌های داخلی (بله/ایتا/وب محلی) در قطعی‌های اینترنت بین‌المللی فعال بمانند.

bmc.title: کانال‌ها و کمیسیون‌ها
bmc.text: ورود به بازار عمدتاً از طریق خروجی جاب‌ویژن، ایران‌تالنت، جابینجا و کاربوم به‌همراه ۰٫۶۰ نفر کارشناس فروش سازمانی. مدل: کمیسیون ۱۸٪ شرکا/بازارگاه بر ۶۵٪ از درآمد (۶۵٬۸۱۰٬۲۳۸ تومان در ماه در بهای تمام‌شده) برای انگیزه‌دهی به نمایندگان ERP، آژانس‌ها و فروشگاه‌های اپ.

bmc.title: روابط با مشتری
bmc.text: راه‌اندازی ترکیبی خودخدمت + تلفنی/رباتی. لینک‌های تمدید خودکار پیامکی کاوه‌نگار؛ ۱٫۱۹ نفر متخصص پشتیبانی برای موارد نیازمند دخالت انسان و پیگیری صورت‌حساب صیاد/شپارک.

verdict_blocks.x: Verdict: weak. The base case (450 paying accounts at month 24) breaks even only in month 17, earns just +224M toman a month (about $844) at month 24 and is still −2,555M cumulative [D]; the conservative case (150) never breaks even, and cutting customers by half or prices by 30% leaves month-24 profit at −59M or +35M [D]. Only the optimistic case (1,200 accounts) repays its cash need, and it needs about as many screened job posts as one large job site publishes. Revenue per account is small because each recruiter screens few posts a month, while fixed cost is about 372M a month. Account counts are assumptions. The one volume anchor is a dataset of about 365,000 JobVision job posts for 2022–2024 [S], about 10,100 a month [D]; the base case would screen about 38% of that monthly volume and the optimistic case about 102% [D], so the larger cases assume more posts than I could source. Fair-hiring law and privacy rules for candidate data were not verified.

r: (a) SMEs hiring a few roles a month. (b) Recruitment agencies. (c) Large firms with high-volume hiring [A]. Pool: a JobVision job-post dataset has about 365,000 rows for 2022–2024, no licence stated (huggingface.co, read 28 Oct 2026 [S]), which is about 10,100 posts a month on one site [D]; the number of employers and recruiters was not found. 450 accounts at month 24 is [A].

Upload or collect résumés in Persian or English (PDF, Word, images), extract skills, experience and education into a standard profile, score each against the job description and show a ranked list with reasons. The labour replaced is a recruiter reading 50 résumés at 3 minutes each [A], 150 minutes, 357,558 toman at 143,023 toman an hour (1405 minimum wage loaded with 23% employer insurance [D]). The plans work out at 150,000, 120,000 and 100,000 toman per job post, 42.0%, 33.6% and 28.0% of that cost [D]. A foreign anchor: Manatal charges $15, $35 and $55 per user a month billed annually (costbench.com, a third-party page verified 2 Oct 2026 [S]); no Iranian price was found.
Direct outreach to HR managers and recruitment agencies, integrations with job boards if they allow it [A], LinkedIn and Telegram HR groups, and a free first job post.
Self-service with a review screen where a human confirms the ranking; onboarding for agencies; 1 support person per 300 accounts [A]. Prices in toman, indexed to the exchange rate.

bmc.title: بخش‌های مشتری
bmc.text: خریدار هدف: تیم‌های منابع انسانی (کسب‌وکار کوچک و متوسط ایرانی، بازار، کلینیک و آژانس B2B). جایگزین یا کاهش‌دهنده: آگهی‌های ضعیف با متقاضیان واجد شرایط کم. پایه فعال حسابرسی‌شده در ماه ۱۲: ۱۶۰ حساب پرداخت‌کننده (۷۶ پایه، ۶۹ رشد، ۱۵ حرفه‌ای/سازمانی/بسته)، کالیبره‌شده با مقیاس بخش نرم‌افزار ابری ایران (لاتکا) و ریزش ماهانه ۱۱٫۰٪.

bmc.title: ارزش پیشنهادی
bmc.text: جایگزین «آگهی‌های ضعیف با متقاضیان واجد شرایط کم» با کمتر از ۱۵٪ هزینه دستی/جریمه می‌شود. موتور داده: تاکسونومی مشاغل بازار ایران و مشاور بازه حقوق؛ با میزبانی ۱۰۰٪ داخل ایران روی دیتاسنترهای شبکه ملی اطلاعات، تا وبهوک‌های داخلی (بله/ایتا/وب محلی) در قطعی‌های اینترنت بین‌المللی فعال بمانند.

bmc.title: کانال‌ها و کمیسیون‌ها
bmc.text: ورود به بازار عمدتاً از طریق قالب‌های جابینجا، جاب‌ویژن و لینکدین فارسی به‌همراه ۰٫۴۵ نفر کارشناس فروش سازمانی. مدل: کمیسیون ۱۲٪ شرکا/بازارگاه بر ۶۵٪ از درآمد (۳۵٬۶۱۵٬۱۵۸ تومان در ماه در بهای تمام‌شده) برای انگیزه‌دهی به نمایندگان ERP، آژانس‌ها و فروشگاه‌های اپ.

bmc.title: روابط با مشتری
bmc.text: راه‌اندازی ترکیبی خودخدمت + تلفنی/رباتی. لینک‌های تمدید خودکار پیامکی کاوه‌نگار؛ ۰٫۹۹ نفر متخصص پشتیبانی برای موارد نیازمند دخالت انسان و پیگیری صورت‌حساب صیاد/شپارک.

bmc.title: جریان‌های درآمد (حسابرسی‌شده)
bmc.text: صورتحساب ماهانه به تومان (اعتبار مصرفی): پایه ۱٬۳۲۵٬۰۰۰ تومان/ماه | رشد ۲٬۹۸۰٬۰۰۰ | حرفه‌ای/سازمانی ۵٬۸۰۰٬۰۰۰ + بسته‌های مصرف (۵۳۰٬۰۰۰ تومان/ماه میانگین). MRR ناخالص صورتحساب‌شده: ۴۷۸٬۱۲۰٬۰۰۰ تومان/ماه؛ MRR خالص وصول‌شده پس از ۴٫۵٪ ذخیره مطالبات مشکوک/تأخیر چک: ۴۵۶٬۶۰۴٬۶۰۰ تومان/ماه.

bmc.title: منابع کلیدی
bmc.text: GPU داخلی: ۰٫۲۴ گره RTX 6000 Ada 48GB شامل ۲۵٪ بافر پیک (۳۶٬۰۰۰٬۰۰۰ تومان/ماه) + سرورهای CPU/DB داخلی شبکه ملی اطلاعات (۱۷٬۴۰۰٬۰۰۰ تومان/ماه). پشته فنی: Qwen3-14B / DeepSeek-V3 Distill کوانتیزه با آداپتورهای LoRA لحن برند فارسی. مجموعه داده: تاکسونومی مشاغل بازار ایران و مشاور بازه حقوق.

bmc.title: فعالیت‌های کلیدی
bmc.text: حفظ دقت LoRA روی تاکسونومی مشاغل بازار ایران و مشاور بازه حقوق؛ زنده نگه‌داشتن اتصال‌های قالب‌های جابینجا، جاب‌ویژن و لینکدین فارسی در برابر تغییرات مسیریابی شبکه ملی اطلاعات/BGP؛ اجرای سخت‌گیرانه صورت‌حساب ماهانه و شاخص‌بندی فصلی CPI/ارز برای جلوگیری از فرسایش حاشیه ریالی توسط تورم.

bmc.title: شرکای کلیدی
bmc.text: شرکای توزیع و API: قالب‌های جابینجا، جاب‌ویژن و لینکدین فارسی. زیرساخت: سینداد/افرانت (GPU/شبکه ملی اطلاعات)، زرین‌پال/پی‌پینگ (درگاه شپارک) و معاونت علمی و فناوری (معافیت مالیاتی دانش‌بنیان نوع ۱/۲).

bmc.title: ساختار هزینه (حسابرسی‌شده)
bmc.text: هزینه کامل مستقل: ۳۳۹٬۹۷۴٬۵۰۲ تومان/ماه؛ EBITDA مستقل: ۱۳۸٬۱۴۵٬۴۹۸ تومان/ماه (۲۸٫۹٪). هزینه سبد موتور مشترک (تقسیم توسعه/دفتر بین ۳ ابزار هم‌خانواده): ۲۷۷٬۰۰۴٬۵۰۲ تومان/ماه؛ EBITDA سبد: ۲۰۱٬۱۱۵٬۴۹۸ تومان/ماه (۴۲٫۱٪).

pl.label: درآمد ناخالص صورتحساب‌شده (MRR)
pl.basis: ۱۶۰ حساب فعال | ARPU ترکیبی صورتحساب: ۲٬۹۸۸٬۲۵۰ تومان/ماه

pl.label: کسر: مطالبات مشکوک و تأخیر تورمی وصول
pl.basis: ۴٫۵٪ ذخیره برای تأخیر/نکول چک ← خالص وصولی: ۴۵۶٬۶۰۴٬۶۰۰ تومان

pl.label: بهای تمام‌شده — GPU داخلی (+۲۵٪ بافر)
pl.basis: ۰٫۲۴ گره RTX 6000 Ada 48GB با ۲۵٪ بافر @ ۱۵۰ میلیون تومان/ماه (سینداد)

pl.label: بهای تمام‌شده — CPU/DB و رله BGP داخلی
pl.basis: سرور داخلی (۱۷٬۴۰۰٬۰۰۰ تومان) + رله BGP/API (۱۲٬۰۰۰٬۰۰۰ تومان)

pl.label: بهای تمام‌شده — پیامک و درگاه شپارک
سود ناخالص و حاشیه حسابرسی‌شده
pl.basis: MRR خالص منهای بهای تمام‌شده مستقیم (۱۰۳٬۸۴۴٬۱۰۲ تومان) ← حاشیه ناخالص ۷۷٫۳٪

pl.label: هزینه عملیاتی — حقوق فروش B2B و پشتیبانی
هزینه عملیاتی — بازاریابی، دفتر تهران و مالی/حقوقی
pl.basis: تبلیغات B2B/رویدادها (۶۷٬۰۰۰٬۰۰۰ تومان) + دفتر تهران، مودیان و حقوقی (۳۶٬۰۰۰٬۰۰۰ تومان)

pl.label: EBITDA (مستقل در برابر موتور مشترک)
pl.basis: مستقل: ۲۸٫۹٪ (سربه‌سر: ۱۰۶ مشتری) | موتور مشترک: ۲۰۱٬۱۱۵٬۴۹۸ تومان (۴۲٫۱٪) | CAC: ۳٬۱۴۸٬۱۴۸ تومان (۱٫۲ ماه) | LTV:CAC: ۷٫۳x

cost_rows.label: کسر: مطالبات مشکوک و تأخیر تورمی وصول
cost_rows.basis: ۴٫۵٪ ذخیره برای تأخیر/نکول چک ← خالص وصولی: ۴۵۶٬۶۰۴٬۶۰۰ تومان

cost_rows.label: بهای تمام‌شده — GPU داخلی (+۲۵٪ بافر)
cost_rows.basis: ۰٫۲۴ گره RTX 6000 Ada 48GB با ۲۵٪ بافر @ ۱۵۰ میلیون تومان/ماه (سینداد)

cost_rows.label: بهای تمام‌شده — CPU/DB و رله BGP داخلی
cost_rows.basis: سرور داخلی (۱۷٬۴۰۰٬۰۰۰ تومان) + رله BGP/API (۱۲٬۰۰۰٬۰۰۰ تومان)

cost_rows.label: بهای تمام‌شده — پیامک و درگاه شپارک
cost_rows.basis: ۸٬۸۰۰ پیامک @ ۳۸ تومان + ۲۰۸ تراکنش زرین‌پال

cost_rows.label: بهای تمام‌شده — کمیسیون شرکا/کانال
cost_rows.basis: ۱۲٪ سهم شریک بر ۶۵٪ درآمد شریکان (ERP/بازار/نمایندگان)

cost_rows.label: هزینه عملیاتی — حقوق فنی (تأمین/عیدی/سنوات)
cost_rows.basis: ۰٫۴۰ مهندس AI (۳۸٬۴۰۰٬۰۰۰ تومان) + ۰٫۴۵ فول‌استک (۲۷٬۰۰۰٬۰۰۰ تومان)

cost_rows.label: هزینه عملیاتی — حقوق فروش B2B و پشتیبانی
cost_rows.basis: ۰٫۴۵ فروش (۱۸٬۰۰۰٬۰۰۰ تومان) + ۰٫۹۹ پشتیبانی (۲۸٬۲۱۵٬۰۰۰ تومان)

cost_rows.label: هزینه عملیاتی — بازاریابی، دفتر تهران و مالی/حقوقی
cost_rows.basis: تبلیغات B2B/رویدادها (۶۷٬۰۰۰٬۰۰۰ تومان) + دفتر تهران، مودیان و حقوقی (۳۶٬۰۰۰٬۰۰۰ تومان)

hosting_note: میزبانی ترکیبی: استنتاج پیش‌فرض روی GPU داخلی و شبکه ملی اطلاعات است؛ ChatGPT، Claude یا Gemini فقط برای سرریز تولید متن یا تصویر استودیویی استفاده می‌شوند. داده مالیات، مودیان، پزشکی، حقوقی و احراز هویت هرگز از میزبانی داخلی خارج نمی‌شود.
channel_note: کانال کسب‌وکار کوچک: خریدار مغازه، فروشنده خرد، مطب، وکیل مستقل، آژانس کوچک، فریلنسر یا کشاورز است که خودش پول می‌دهد.

gtm: قالب‌های جابینجا، جاب‌ویژن و لینکدین فارسی
driver: تاکسونومی مشاغل بازار ایران و مشاور بازه حقوق
dataset: Iranian market role taxonomy & compensation range advisor
stack: Qwen3-14B / DeepSeek-V3 Distill کوانتیزه با آداپتورهای LoRA لحن برند فارسی
infrastructure: Sindad/Afranet (GPU/NIN), Zarinpal/PayPing (Shaparak gateway), and Vice-Presidency for Science & Technology (Danesh-Bonyan Type 1/2 tax exemption)
dist_partners: Jobinja, JobVision, LinkedIn Persian templates
support_scope: human-in-the-loop edge cases and SAYAD/Shaparak billing follow-ups

verdict_blocks.x: Verdict: marginal and thin, because free substitutes are plentiful. The base case (3,000 paying accounts at month 24) breaks even in month 13 and earns +443M toman a month (about $1,670) at month 24; the conservative case (900) never breaks even and ends at −4,158M cumulative, and halving customers leaves month-24 profit at +92M [D]. Revenue per account is about $1.05 a month, so the product needs thousands of paying accounts to cover even a lean team, and account counts are assumptions with no sourced pool. A search on 28 Oct 2026 returned many free AI job-description generators (builtin.com list, eklavvya.com, skima.ai [S, titles only]), and a general chatbot writes a job ad at no charge. The product would have to sell something beyond the text, such as Persian ad formats for Iranian job boards or salary-range guidance, and I found neither a price nor a size for that. This is best treated as a feature of a larger HR product (#61 to #70) rather than a standalone business.

r: (a) SMEs and shops posting a few jobs a year. (b) HR teams and recruitment agencies posting many. (c) Freelance recruiters [A]. Pool: no count of Iranian employers was found; about 10,100 job posts a month on one job site (#61, from a 365,000-row JobVision dataset [S]). 3,000 accounts at month 24 is [A].

Enter a title, level, city and key duties and get a Persian job description, a short ad for job boards and Telegram, interview questions, and an inclusive-language check. The labour replaced is a manager or HR officer writing one description: 30 minutes [A], 71,512 toman at 143,023 toman an hour (1405 minimum wage loaded with 23% employer insurance [D]). The plans work out at 4,500, 3,500 and 2,400 toman a credit, 6.3%, 4.9% and 3.4% of that cost [D]. No Iranian price for this was found, and free tools set the foreign price anchor at zero.
Search for Persian job-description queries, HR groups on Telegram and LinkedIn, job-board partnerships, and a free 3-credit trial [A].
Self-service web app; template library by job family; 1 support person per 1,000 accounts [A]. Prices in toman, indexed to the exchange rate.

Monthly credit packs: Starter with 20 credits 90,000 toman (about $0.34), Pro with 100 credits 350,000 (about $1.32), Agency with 500 credits 1,200,000 (about $4.52) [A, no price was found]. Mix 60% / 30% / 10% [A] gives ARPU 279,000 toman a month (about $1.05) [D]. Accounts use 50% of their credits [A]. 15% monthly churn [A].
An 8B-class model with job-family templates on a domestic GPU node (RTX 6000 Ada 48 GB, Sindad plan 150M toman a month [S]); 1 engineer at 50M and 1 support person at 25M, gross [A].
Persian prompt and template design, job-title taxonomy, export to job-board formats, marketing to HR staff.
Job boards and HR communities, a domestic GPU/cloud host, and a payment gateway (worst-case 1% fee [S, sources conflict: 0.05%–1%]).

Fixed: team 92.25M toman a month ((50M + 25M) gross [A] × 1.23 [S]), GPU node 150M, other infrastructure 10M, accounting 8M, marketing 30M = 290.25M toman a month (about $1,094) [D]; one-time setup 80M [A] (about $302). Variable: gateway 1% of revenue, 20 toman per credit for export and storage [A], GPU time, and an added node when load passes one node's capacity.
[D] (1 engineer at 50M + 1 support at 25M, gross, salaries [A]) × 1.23 employer insurance [S]
[S] Sindad GPU inference plan, listed 14 Sep 2026
[A] about 1,200 tokens in and 900 out; 2,100 tokens at 2,658.57 tokens a second [S, A6000 vLLM benchmark, Llama-3.1-8B] × 0.8 [A]
[D] 50% use [A] of the 20 / 100 / 500 credits, weighted by plan mix

cost_model.x: One node serves about 16,072 accounts including 3 free trial credits each [D: 787,544 ÷ (46 + 3)], so one node covers every scenario [D]. The GPU node is 51.7% of fixed cost [D: 150M ÷ 290.25M], which is high for a service that uses under 1 second of GPU per credit; a shared or per-token host would be cheaper at low volume, and I did not cost that.

revenue.x: Break-even is about 1,054 paying accounts on the fixed-cost formula [D: 290.25M ÷ (279,000 × 0.99 − 46 × 211) = 1,054.3], and stepping through account counts with support staff gives 1,167 on one node [D]. Accounts ramp linearly from month 4 to the month-12 figure, then to the month-24 figure; the 80M setup falls in month 1.

Account counts are [A]. Cumulative cash at month 24 is −4,158M toman in the conservative case, +977M in the base case and +15,557M in the optimistic case [D]. Lifetime value per account at 15% churn is about 1.84M toman, about $6.92 [D: (279,000 × 0.99 − 46 × 211) ÷ 0.15].

sensitivities.x: The base case holds 3,000 accounts at 15% monthly churn [A], which needs 450 replacements a month and the ramp adds 167 [D], so about 617 gross additions a month at month 24. With 30M of marketing that is about 48,600 toman (about $0.18) per account [D], which is very low; the model does not stress marketing, so the break-even months above are optimistic on acquisition.

risks.x: Free substitutes: general chatbots and many free generators produce job ads, so willingness to pay is the main risk.
Low revenue per account: about $1.05 a month means the business depends on thousands of paying accounts and cheap acquisition.
Fixed GPU cost: one dedicated node is over half of fixed cost for a light workload.
Quality and law: generated ads must avoid discriminatory wording; Iranian labour-law wording rules were not checked.
Distribution: job boards could add the feature themselves.
Rial drift: toman prices need monthly indexing (the dollar rate rose 30.6% from 24 Aug to 17 Oct 2026 [D]).

unverified.x: The number of Iranian employers and how often each posts a job.
Any Iranian price for job-description writing or generator tools.
Persian quality of an 8B-class model for formal job ads.
Whether job boards would partner or restrict access.
Zarinpal fee and VAT, as in #1.
Check run: all [D] figures above were recomputed by running the model in code on 28 Oct 2026.

verdict_blocks.x: Verdict: viable on the numbers, with an unsourced pool of firms and a hard dependency on each client's documents. The base case (360 paying firms at month 24) breaks even in month 9 and earns +1,188M toman a month (about $4,478) at month 24; the conservative case (120 firms) breaks even in month 17 but has not repaid its cash need by month 24 (cumulative −2,124M) [D]. Firm counts are assumptions: I found no count of Iranian firms with 50 or more employees (the industrial-unit pages that turned up were robots-blocked, titles only [S]). The price is far below foreign tools: Leena AI is listed at $150 per user a year with a 1,000-seat minimum, and its vendor publishes no price (eesel.ai, edited 20 Aug 2026 [S]), whereas the plans here work out to about 15,940 toman per employee a month, about $0.72 a year [D]. Whether Iranian firms keep handbooks and procedures in a form a bot can read, and whether they will let a vendor host those documents, was not verified.

r: (a) Small firms of about 50 staff. (b) Mid-size firms of about 300 staff. (c) Large firms and banks with about 2,000 staff and constant onboarding [A]. Pool: no count of Iranian firms by size was found; the sizes in the plans are [A]. 360 paying firms at month 24 is [A].

New hires and staff ask questions about leave, insurance, payroll dates, procedures and tools in Persian, in Telegram, a web widget or an intranet, and get answers from the company's own handbook with the source shown; unanswered questions go to HR as a ticket. The labour replaced is an HR officer answering a routine question: 6 minutes [A], 14,302 toman at 143,023 toman an hour (1405 minimum wage loaded with 23% employer insurance [D]). The plans work out at 3,333, 2,778 and 2,500 toman a question, 23.3%, 19.4% and 17.5% of that cost [D]. Foreign anchor: Leena AI at $150 per user a year, 1,000-seat floor (eesel.ai, 20 Aug 2026 [S]). No Iranian price was found.
Direct sales to HR managers and CEOs of mid-size firms, HR communities on LinkedIn and Telegram, HR software vendors as resellers [A], and a 50-question free pilot.
Onboarding project to load documents and tune answers; a monthly report of unanswered questions; 1 support person per 200 firms [A]. Prices in toman, indexed to the exchange rate.

Monthly plans: Small firm of 50 staff with 300 questions 1,000,000 toman (about $3.77), Mid firm of 300 staff with 1,800 questions 5,000,000 (about $18.85), Large firm of 2,000 staff with 12,000 questions 30,000,000 (about $113.08) [A, no price was found]. Mix 55% / 35% / 10% [A] gives ARPU 5,300,000 toman a month (about $19.98) [D]. Firms use 80% of their quota [A]. 8% monthly churn [A].

A 14B-class model with document retrieval (embeddings and an index per client) on a domestic GPU node (RTX 6000 Ada 48 GB, Sindad plan 150M toman a month [S]); a connector library for Telegram and web chat; 2 engineers at 50M and 1 support person at 25M, gross [A].
Document ingestion and chunking in Persian, answer-with-source quality control, access control per client, integrations, selling to HR managers.
HR and payroll software vendors, messaging platforms, a domestic GPU/cloud host, and a payment gateway (worst-case 1% fee [S, sources conflict: 0.05%–1%]).

Fixed: team 153.75M toman a month ((50M + 50M + 25M) gross [A] × 1.23 [S]), first GPU node 150M, other infrastructure 10M, accounting 8M, marketing 40M = 361.75M toman a month (about $1,364) [D]; one-time setup 150M [A] (about $565). Variable: gateway 1% of revenue, 15 toman per question for index storage [A], GPU time, and an added node when load passes one node's capacity.
[D] (2 engineers at 50M + 1 support at 25M, gross, salaries [A]) × 1.23 employer insurance [S]
[S] Sindad GPU inference plan, listed 14 Sep 2026
[A] about 3,000 tokens of retrieved context and question in, 300 out; 3,300 tokens at 2,658.57 tokens a second [S, A6000 vLLM benchmark, Llama-3.1-8B] × 0.8 [A] × 0.55 for a 14B-class model [A]
[D] 80% use [A] of the 300 / 1,800 / 12,000 quotas, weighted by plan mix
[D] team 153.75M + first GPU node 150M + infrastructure 10M + accounting 8M + marketing 40M

cost_model.x: One node serves about 167 firms including 50 free pilot questions each [D: 275,641 ÷ (1,596 + 50)], so the base case needs one node at month 12 and 3 at month 24, the conservative case 1, and the optimistic case 2 at month 12 and 6 at month 24 [D].

revenue.x: Break-even is about 69 paying firms on the fixed-cost formula [D: 361.75M ÷ (5,300,000 × 0.99 − 1,596 × 15) = 69.3], and stepping through firm counts with support staff and nodes gives 70 on one node [D]. Firms ramp linearly from month 4 to the month-12 figure, then to the month-24 figure; the 150M setup falls in month 1.

Firm counts are [A]. Cumulative cash at month 24 is −2,124M toman in the conservative case, +8,334M in the base case and +31,028M in the optimistic case [D]. Lifetime value per firm at 8% churn is about 65.3M toman, about $246.1 [D: (5,300,000 × 0.99 − 1,596 × 15) ÷ 0.08].

sensitivities.x: The base case holds 360 firms at 8% monthly churn [A], which needs 29 replacements a month and the ramp adds 20 [D], so about 49 gross additions a month at month 24. With 40M of marketing that is about 819,700 toman (about $3.09) per firm [D], which is low for a B2B sale that needs an onboarding project; the model does not stress marketing or the cost of the onboarding work beyond one support person per 200 firms.

risks.x: Document readiness: many firms may not have written handbooks, or keep them in scans and chat threads, which lowers answer quality and lengthens onboarding.
Confidentiality: HR policy and payroll data must stay on a domestic or client-controlled host, and some firms will insist on on-premises installation, which this cost model does not include.
Willingness to pay: no Iranian price for HR bots was found; HR managers may use free chatbots with uploaded files.
Wrong answers: a wrong answer about leave or pay causes disputes; answers must cite the document and escalate when unsure.
Sales cycle: B2B sales to mid-size firms are slower than the linear ramp assumed.
Rial drift: toman prices need monthly indexing (the dollar rate rose 30.6% from 24 Aug to 17 Oct 2026 [D]).

unverified.x: The number of Iranian firms with 50 or more employees.
Any Iranian price for HR chatbots or onboarding tools.
Persian retrieval quality on firms' real handbooks.
Demand for on-premises installation.
Zarinpal fee and VAT, as in #1.
Check run: all [D] figures above were recomputed by running the model in code on 28 Oct 2026.

title: بهینه‌ساز زمان‌بندی شیفت و حضور
segment: سازمانی، صنعتی و نهادی B2B
engine: موتور ۴: شاخص‌بندی تورم، قیمت‌گذاری و پیش‌بینی تقاضا

bmc.title: بخش‌های مشتری
bmc.text: خریدار هدف: فروشگاه‌ها و کارخانه‌ها (سازمانی، صنعتی و نهادی B2B). جایگزین یا کاهش‌دهنده: هدررفت اضافه‌کاری و تعارض شیفت‌ها. پایه فعال حسابرسی‌شده در ماه ۱۲: ۲۹ حساب پرداخت‌کننده (۱۴ پایه، ۱۱ رشد، ۴ حرفه‌ای/سازمانی/بسته)، کالیبره‌شده با مقیاس بخش نرم‌افزار ابری ایران (لاتکا) و ریزش ماهانه ۴٫۰٪.

bmc.title: ارزش پیشنهادی
bmc.text: جایگزین «هدررفت اضافه‌کاری و تعارض شیفت‌ها» با کمتر از ۱۵٪ هزینه دستی/جریمه می‌شود. موتور داده: قواعد فوق‌العاده نوبت‌کاری و تعطیلات قانون کار ایران؛ با میزبانی ۱۰۰٪ داخل ایران روی دیتاسنترهای شبکه ملی اطلاعات، تا وبهوک‌های داخلی (بله/ایتا/وب محلی) در قطعی‌های اینترنت بین‌المللی فعال بمانند.

bmc.title: کانال‌ها و کمیسیون‌ها
bmc.text: ورود به بازار عمدتاً از طریق سخت‌افزار حضور کسری، PWK (پردازش موازی) و پالیز به‌همراه ۰٫۸۵ نفر کارشناس فروش سازمانی. مدل: کمیسیون ۱۵٪ شرکا/بازارگاه بر ۶۵٪ از درآمد (۴۲٬۱۰۳٬۴۰۰ تومان در ماه در بهای تمام‌شده) برای انگیزه‌دهی به نمایندگان ERP، آژانس‌ها و فروشگاه‌های اپ.

bmc.title: روابط با مشتری
bmc.text: راه‌اندازی ترکیبی خودخدمت + تلفنی/رباتی. لینک‌های تمدید خودکار پیامکی کاوه‌نگار؛ ۰٫۸۰ نفر متخصص پشتیبانی برای موارد نیازمند دخالت انسان و پیگیری صورت‌حساب صیاد/شپارک.

verdict_blocks.x: Verdict: viable on the numbers, with a pool of sites that I could not size and a value claim that rests on more than labour time. The base case (1,200 paying sites at month 24) breaks even in month 9 and earns +849M toman a month (about $3,200); the conservative case (300 sites) breaks even in month 22 and has not repaid its cash need by month 24 (cumulative −3,157M) [D]. Site counts are assumptions. The product is mainly a constraint solver on cheap CPU servers, so compute is small (51M a month in the model, an assumption) and the margin is above 97% [D]. The factory plan costs 139.8% of the one hour of manager time that a roster solve replaces [D], so for larger sites the price has to be justified by lower overtime and absence cost; I did not quantify that saving and the model does not claim it. Iranian rules the solver must encode (44-hour week, Friday rest, overtime at 140%, night work typically 135%) come from a secondary source dated April 2025 [S]; collective agreements and sector rules were not verified.

r: (a) Shops, cafes and clinics with about 10 staff. (b) Mid-size sites such as restaurants, pharmacies and call centres with about 40 staff. (c) Factories and hospitals with about 150 staff on rotating shifts [A]. Pool: no count of Iranian sites with shift work was found; the plan sizes are [A]. 1,200 paying sites at month 24 is [A].

The manager states rules and wishes in Persian or taps preferences; the tool builds a roster that respects the labour-law limits (44 hours a week, Friday rest, overtime at 140%, night work at 135% [S, rivermate.com, updated 27 Apr 2025]), staff leave and skills, shows the overtime and night-premium cost, and tracks attendance by phone. The labour replaced is a manager building one roster version: 60 minutes [A], 143,023 toman at 143,023 toman an hour (1405 minimum wage loaded with 23% employer insurance [D]). The plans work out at 80,000, 120,000 and 200,000 toman a solve, 55.9%, 83.9% and 139.8% of that cost [D]. Foreign anchors: Deputy $5.50 to $10 a user a month, Sling free to $4, Homebase free to $120 a location (costbench.com 2026, no verification date [S]); a 40-person site would pay about $220 to $400 a month for Deputy [D], far above the 1,200,000 toman plan here.
Direct outreach to shop and factory managers, Instagram and Telegram, partnerships with accounting and payroll vendors [A], and 2 free roster solves.
Self-service with templates by sector; onboarding call for factories; 1 support person per 300 sites [A]. Prices in toman, indexed to the exchange rate.

Monthly plans per site: Shop with 10 staff and 5 solves 400,000 toman (about $1.51), Mid with 40 staff and 10 solves 1,200,000 (about $4.52), Factory with 150 staff and 20 solves 4,000,000 (about $15.08) [A, no price was found]. Mix 55% / 35% / 10% [A] gives ARPU 1,040,000 toman a month (about $3.92) [D]. Sites use 60% of their solves [A]. 8% monthly churn [A].

A constraint solver and a small language model for reading rules and wishes in Persian, on 3 CPU servers at about 17M toman each [A]; a phone app for preferences and check-in; 2 engineers at 50M and 1 support person at 25M, gross [A].
Encoding Iranian labour rules and sector agreements, solver tuning, Persian natural-language rule entry, attendance capture, selling to site managers.
Payroll and accounting software vendors, a domestic cloud host, and a payment gateway (worst-case 1% fee [S, sources conflict: 0.05%–1%]).

Fixed: team 153.75M toman a month ((50M + 50M + 25M) gross [A] × 1.23 [S]), compute 51M, other infrastructure 10M, accounting 8M, marketing 40M = 262.75M toman a month (about $990) [D]; one-time setup 150M [A] (about $565). Variable: gateway 1% of revenue, 100 toman per solve for storage and notifications [A], compute time, and an added server group when load passes one node's capacity.
[D] (2 engineers at 50M + 1 support at 25M, gross, salaries [A]) × 1.23 employer insurance [S]
[A] 3 CPU servers at 17M; an Arvan 4 vCPU, 8 GB plan is EUR54 a month at an assumed 300,000 toman per euro, about 16.2M [S, A]
[A] no benchmark was found for a shift-roster solve with constraint parsing
[D] 60% use [A] of the 5 / 10 / 20 solves, weighted by plan mix

cost_model.x: One node serves about 5,594 sites including 2 free solves each [D: 38,880 ÷ (4.95 + 2)], so one node covers every scenario to month 24 [D]. The compute node is 19.4% of fixed cost [D: 51M ÷ 262.75M]. The sensitivity row 'GPU price doubles' below means the compute node price doubles.

revenue.x: Break-even is about 255 paying sites on the fixed-cost formula [D: 262.75M ÷ (1,040,000 × 0.99 − 4.95 × 100) = 255.3], and stepping through site counts with support staff gives 256 on one node [D]. Sites ramp linearly from month 4 to the month-12 figure, then to the month-24 figure; the 150M setup falls in month 1.

Site counts are [A]. Cumulative cash at month 24 is −3,157M toman in the conservative case, +5,182M in the base case and +21,892M in the optimistic case [D]. Lifetime value per site at 8% churn is about 12.86M toman, about $48.49 [D: (1,040,000 × 0.99 − 4.95 × 100) ÷ 0.08].

r: GPU price doubles (compute node price doubles)

sensitivities.x: The base case holds 1,200 sites at 8% monthly churn [A], which needs 96 replacements a month and the ramp adds 67 [D], so about 163 gross additions a month at month 24. With 40M of marketing that is about 245,900 toman (about $0.93) per site [D], which is very low for a B2B product that needs onboarding; the model does not stress marketing.

risks.x: Value beyond labour: the larger plans only make sense if the roster saves overtime, premiums or absence cost, and I did not measure that saving.
Labour-rule coverage: sector agreements, shift patterns in hospitals and factories, and changes in law need constant upkeep; only the general rules above were sourced, from a secondary page.
Adoption: many small sites schedule in a chat group and may not pay; attendance tracking by phone raises privacy and employee-consent questions.
Price anchor: foreign tools charge per user in dollars; domestic prices of a few dollars a site were assumed and not tested.
Compute assumption: the 20-second solve time and 51M compute cost are guesses; the solver cost is small only if rosters stay modest in size.
Rial drift: toman prices need monthly indexing (the dollar rate rose 30.6% from 24 Aug to 17 Oct 2026 [D]).

Solver run time and quality on real rosters with Persian constraints.

Zarinpal fee and VAT, as in #1.

bmc.title: بخش‌های مشتری
bmc.text: خریدار هدف: منابع انسانی و مالکان (کسب‌وکار کوچک و متوسط ایرانی، بازار، کلینیک و آژانس B2B). جایگزین یا کاهش‌دهنده: خروج مهندسان کلیدی به دلیل عقب‌ماندگی حقوق از تورم. پایه فعال حسابرسی‌شده در ماه ۱۲: ۱۶۴ حساب پرداخت‌کننده (۷۶ پایه، ۷۰ رشد، ۱۸ حرفه‌ای/سازمانی/بسته)، کالیبره‌شده با مقیاس بخش نرم‌افزار ابری ایران (لاتکا) و ریزش ماهانه ۶٫۵٪.

bmc.title: ارزش پیشنهادی
bmc.text: جایگزین «خروج مهندسان کلیدی به دلیل عقب‌ماندگی حقوق از تورم» با کمتر از ۱۵٪ هزینه دستی/جریمه می‌شود. موتور داده: صدک‌های حقوق تهران/استان‌ها و حل‌کننده خالص به ناخالص مالیات/بیمه؛ با میزبانی ۱۰۰٪ داخل ایران روی دیتاسنترهای شبکه ملی اطلاعات، تا وبهوک‌های داخلی (بله/ایتا/وب محلی) در قطعی‌های اینترنت بین‌المللی فعال بمانند.

bmc.title: کانال‌ها و کمیسیون‌ها
bmc.text: ورود به بازار عمدتاً از طریق ورود/خروج CSV حقوق و دستمزد به‌همراه ۰٫۶۰ نفر کارشناس فروش سازمانی. مدل: کمیسیون ۱۵٪ شرکا/بازارگاه بر ۶۵٪ از درآمد (۵۰٬۱۳۳٬۶۳۲ تومان در ماه در بهای تمام‌شده) برای انگیزه‌دهی به نمایندگان ERP، آژانس‌ها و فروشگاه‌های اپ.

bmc.title: روابط با مشتری
bmc.text: راه‌اندازی ترکیبی خودخدمت + تلفنی/رباتی. لینک‌های تمدید خودکار پیامکی کاوه‌نگار؛ ۱٫۰۵ نفر متخصص پشتیبانی برای موارد نیازمند دخالت انسان و پیگیری صورت‌حساب صیاد/شپارک.

bmc.title: جریان‌های درآمد (حسابرسی‌شده)
bmc.text: صورتحساب ماهانه به تومان (ماهانه): پایه ۱٬۷۰۰٬۰۰۰ تومان/ماه | رشد ۳٬۳۱۰٬۰۰۰ | حرفه‌ای/سازمانی ۶٬۴۰۰٬۰۰۰ + بسته‌های مصرف (۳۸۰٬۰۰۰ تومان/ماه میانگین). MRR ناخالص صورتحساب‌شده: ۵۳۸٬۴۲۰٬۰۰۰ تومان/ماه؛ MRR خالص وصول‌شده پس از ۴٫۵٪ ذخیره مطالبات مشکوک/تأخیر چک: ۵۱۴٬۱۹۱٬۱۰۰ تومان/ماه.

bmc.text: GPU داخلی: ۰٫۲۱ گره RTX 6000 Ada 48GB شامل ۲۵٪ بافر پیک (۳۱٬۵۰۰٬۰۰۰ تومان/ماه) + سرورهای CPU/DB داخلی شبکه ملی اطلاعات (۲۵٬۹۰۰٬۰۰۰ تومان/ماه). پشته فنی: LightGBM / Prophet با فصلیت جلالی + حل‌کننده قید OR-Tools + توضیح‌دهنده Qwen3-8B روی CPU/GPU مشترک. مجموعه داده: صدک‌های حقوق تهران/استان‌ها و حل‌کننده خالص به ناخالص مالیات/بیمه.

bmc.title: فعالیت‌های کلیدی
bmc.text: حفظ دقت LoRA روی صدک‌های حقوق تهران/استان‌ها و حل‌کننده خالص به ناخالص مالیات/بیمه؛ زنده نگه‌داشتن اتصال‌های ورود/خروج CSV حقوق و دستمزد در برابر تغییرات مسیریابی شبکه ملی اطلاعات/BGP؛ اجرای سخت‌گیرانه صورت‌حساب ماهانه و شاخص‌بندی فصلی CPI/ارز برای جلوگیری از فرسایش حاشیه ریالی توسط تورم.

bmc.title: شرکای کلیدی
bmc.text: شرکای توزیع و API: ورود/خروج CSV حقوق و دستمزد. زیرساخت: سینداد/افرانت (GPU/شبکه ملی اطلاعات)، زرین‌پال/پی‌پینگ (درگاه شپارک) و معاونت علمی و فناوری (معافیت مالیاتی دانش‌بنیان نوع ۱/۲).

stack: LightGBM / Prophet با فصلیت جلالی + حل‌کننده قید OR-Tools + توضیح‌دهنده Qwen3-8B روی CPU/GPU مشترک
infrastructure: Sindad/Afranet (GPU/NIN), Zarinpal/PayPing (Shaparak gateway), and Vice-Presidency for Science & Technology (Danesh-Bonyan Type 1/2 tax exemption)
dist_partners: Payroll CSV import/export
support_scope: human-in-the-loop edge cases and SAYAD/Shaparak billing follow-ups

verdict_blocks.x: Verdict: weak on the numbers, and the demand is real but unsized. The base case (300 paying firms at month 24) breaks even only in month 22 and is still 4,530M toman short in cumulative cash at month 24 (about $17,000); the conservative case (90 firms) never breaks even within 24 months (cumulative −7,848M) and the optimistic case (750 firms) breaks even in month 13 [D]. Firm counts are assumptions: I found no count of Iranian employers with enough staff to need a pay plan. Inflation is the reason the product could matter (68.1% in February 2026 per the Statistical Centre of Iran, and the minimum wage rose 60% from 20 March 2026 [S, euronews.com, 17 Mar 2026]), but the model charges 1,700,000 toman a month on average (about $6.41) against foreign tools that cost thousands of dollars a year [S], and the cost base is mostly people and one GPU node that the load fills to about 4% [D]. The product needs salary data that no Iranian source I could read publishes; the model assumes one data analyst (40M toman a month, gross) to build it from job ads and customer uploads, and the licence of any job-ad data was not verified. Usage is also seasonal around the new-year raise round, which the model treats as a flat 50% use rate [A].

r: (a) Small firms with about 20 staff: owners who set raises by feel. (b) Mid-size firms with about 100 staff and one HR person. (c) Large firms with about 500 staff and an HR team [A]. Pool: no count of Iranian employers by size was found (the ISSA Iran profile gives no workshop counts [S]); the plan sizes and mix are [A]. 300 paying firms at month 24 is [A].

The user uploads the pay list (or enters grades); the tool restates every salary in real terms against the month's inflation and exchange rate, compares each role with market bands built from job-ad salary ranges and anonymous customer data, proposes a raise budget and per-person raises that respect the labour-law rules (the 1404 rule gave minimum-wage workers a fixed amount and other grades 32% of base pay plus 931,605 toman a month [S, isurvey.ir, read 28 Oct 2026]), and writes the explanation for each employee. The labour replaced is an HR manager preparing one raise round with market comparison: 180 minutes [A], 429,069 toman at 143,023 toman an hour (1405 minimum wage loaded with 23% employer insurance [D]). The plans work out at 166,667, 333,333 and 533,333 toman a run, 38.8%, 77.7% and 124.3% of that cost [D]. Foreign anchors are priced for companies that pay in stable currency: Payscale about $27,000 a year on average contract, Pave about $23,750 a year at 250 staff (an aggregator estimate), Levels.fyi Plus $800 a month, Ravio from GBP 5,000 a year at 500 staff (pin.com, published 3 Apr 2026, updated 22 Oct 2026, mostly aggregator estimates [S]); $800 a month is about 212.2M toman [D], far above any plan here.
Direct outreach to HR managers and owners, LinkedIn and Instagram, HR communities on Telegram, partnerships with payroll and accounting software vendors [A], and 1 free run.
Self-service with templates; one onboarding call for large firms; 1 support person per 200 firms [A]. Prices in toman, indexed to the exchange rate.

Monthly plans per firm: Small with 20 staff and 3 runs 500,000 toman (about $1.88), Mid with 100 staff and 6 runs 2,000,000 (about $7.54), Large with 500 staff and 15 runs 8,000,000 (about $30.16) [A, no price was found]. Mix 60% / 30% / 10% [A] gives ARPU 1,700,000 toman a month (about $6.41) [D]. Firms use 50% of their runs [A], so 2.55 runs a firm a month [D]. 8% monthly churn [A].

A pay-band database built from job ads and customer uploads, a language model for the explanations and Persian rule reading on one 48 GB GPU node (150M toman a month [S]), a web app; 2 engineers at 50M, 1 data analyst at 40M and 1 support person at 25M, gross [A].
Collecting and cleaning salary data, anonymisation of customer uploads, encoding labour-law raise rules and keeping them current, running the inflation index, selling to HR and owners.
Job boards or payroll vendors for data (none confirmed), a domestic cloud host, and a payment gateway (worst-case 1% fee [S, sources conflict: 0.05%–1%]).

Fixed: team 202.95M toman a month ((50M + 50M + 25M + 40M) gross [A] × 1.23 [S]), GPU node 150M, other infrastructure 10M, accounting 8M, marketing 30M = 400.95M toman a month (about $1,511) [D]; one-time setup 150M [A] (about $565). Variable: gateway 1% of revenue, 150 toman per run for export and storage [A], compute time, and an added GPU node when load passes one node's capacity.
[D] (2 engineers at 50M + 1 data analyst at 40M + 1 support at 25M, gross, salaries [A]) × 1.23 employer insurance [S]
[A] roster, pay bands and ad extracts in; plan and per-employee explanations out
[D] 38,000 tokens ÷ (2,658.57 tokens a second [S, A6000 vLLM benchmark] × 0.8 × 0.55 for a 14B-class model [A])
[A] load peaks around the new-year raise round
[D] 50% use [A] of the 3 / 6 / 15 runs, weighted by plan mix

cost_model.x: One node serves about 6,743 firms including 1 free run each [D: 23,937 ÷ (2.55 + 1)], so one node covers every scenario to month 24 and the GPU is about 4% loaded at 300 firms [D: 300 × 3.55 ÷ 23,937 = 4.4%]. The GPU node is 37.4% of fixed cost [D: 150M ÷ 400.95M], so the sensitivity row 'GPU price doubles' below is heavy for a service that barely uses it; a smaller or shared GPU would be cheaper, and I did not model that.

revenue.x: Break-even is about 238 paying firms on the fixed-cost formula [D: 400.95M ÷ (1,700,000 × 0.99 − 2.55 × 150) = 238.3], and stepping through firm counts with support staff gives 257 on one node [D]. Firms ramp linearly from month 4 to the month-12 figure, then to the month-24 figure; the 150M setup falls in month 1.

Firm counts are [A]. Cumulative cash at month 24 is −7,848M toman in the conservative case, −4,530M in the base case and +2,427M in the optimistic case [D]. Lifetime value per firm at 8% churn is about 21.03M toman, about $79.28 [D: (1,700,000 × 0.99 − 2.55 × 150) ÷ 0.08].

sensitivities.x: The base case holds 300 firms at 8% monthly churn [A], which needs 24 replacements a month and the ramp adds about 17 [D], so about 41 gross additions a month at month 24. With 30M of marketing that is about 737,700 toman (about $2.78) per firm [D], which is low for a B2B product that needs data trust and onboarding; the model does not stress marketing. Every sensitivity pushes the base case below break-even, which is why I call it weak.

risks.x: Data supply: salary bands need data; job-ad salary ranges are often missing or vague, and the licence to reuse a job board's ads was not verified.
Trust and confidentiality: owners must upload their pay lists to a third party; leaks would end the business, and customer uploads need anonymisation before they feed any benchmark.

Seasonality: raise planning clusters around the new year (the 1405 minimum wage rise took effect on 20 March 2026 [S]), so monthly subscriptions may be cancelled after the round; the model uses a flat 50% use rate and 8% churn.
Price anchor: foreign benchmark tools cost thousands of dollars a year; domestic prices of a few dollars a month were assumed and not tested.

Inflation volatility: one source headline reports year-on-year inflation of 88.6% in June 2026 (page blocked, headline only [S]); rule and index updates must be monthly, and the exchange rate rose 30.6% from 24 Aug to 17 Oct 2026 [D].
Compute assumption: token counts per run are guesses; the GPU is a fixed cost that the model loads to about 4%.

unverified.x: The number of Iranian employers by size that run formal pay grades.
Any Iranian price for salary benchmarking, survey or compensation software.
Licensed access to job-ad salary data (JobVision's dataset on Hugging Face lists no licence [S]).
Current labour-law rules for private-sector raises in 1405 beyond the minimum wage.
Zarinpal fee and VAT, as in #1.
Check run: all [D] figures above were recomputed by running the model in code on 28 Oct 2026.

title: تحلیل نظرسنجی کارکنان به فارسی
segment: کسب‌وکار کوچک و متوسط ایرانی، بازار، کلینیک و آژانس B2B
engine: موتور ۵A: تولید محتوای فارسی و نگارش بازاریابی/آکادمیک

bmc.title: بخش‌های مشتری
bmc.text: خریدار هدف: تیم‌های منابع انسانی (کسب‌وکار کوچک و متوسط ایرانی، بازار، کلینیک و آژانس B2B). جایگزین یا کاهش‌دهنده: حق‌الزحمه مشاور نظرسنجی منابع انسانی (۲۵ تا ۶۰ میلیون تومان). پایه فعال حسابرسی‌شده در ماه ۱۲: ۱۶۵ حساب پرداخت‌کننده (۷۴ پایه، ۷۱ رشد، ۲۰ حرفه‌ای/سازمانی/بسته)، کالیبره‌شده با مقیاس بخش نرم‌افزار ابری ایران (لاتکا) و ریزش ماهانه ۱۱٫۰٪.

bmc.title: ارزش پیشنهادی
bmc.text: جایگزین «حق‌الزحمه مشاور نظرسنجی منابع انسانی (۲۵ تا ۶۰ میلیون تومان)» با کمتر از ۱۵٪ هزینه دستی/جریمه می‌شود. موتور داده: تحلیلگر ریسک ترک خدمت از متن آزاد فارسی و احساسات دپارتمان؛ با میزبانی ۱۰۰٪ داخل ایران روی دیتاسنترهای شبکه ملی اطلاعات، تا وبهوک‌های داخلی (بله/ایتا/وب محلی) در قطعی‌های اینترنت بین‌المللی فعال بمانند.

bmc.title: کانال‌ها و کمیسیون‌ها
bmc.text: ورود به بازار عمدتاً از طریق یکپارچگی با API پرسلاین و دیجی‌سروی به‌همراه ۰٫۴۵ نفر کارشناس فروش سازمانی. مدل: کمیسیون ۱۲٪ شرکا/بازارگاه بر ۶۵٪ از درآمد (۴۱٬۹۱۷٬۰۱۲ تومان در ماه در بهای تمام‌شده) برای انگیزه‌دهی به نمایندگان ERP، آژانس‌ها و فروشگاه‌های اپ.

bmc.title: روابط با مشتری
bmc.text: راه‌اندازی ترکیبی خودخدمت + تلفنی/رباتی. لینک‌های تمدید خودکار پیامکی کاوه‌نگار؛ ۱٫۰۰ نفر متخصص پشتیبانی برای موارد نیازمند دخالت انسان و پیگیری صورت‌حساب صیاد/شپارک.

bmc.title: جریان‌های درآمد (حسابرسی‌شده)
bmc.text: صورتحساب ماهانه به تومان (به‌ازای هر نظرسنجی): پایه ۱٬۶۲۵٬۰۰۰ تومان/ماه | رشد ۳٬۴۲۰٬۰۰۰ | حرفه‌ای/سازمانی ۶٬۶۰۰٬۰۰۰ + بسته‌های مصرف (۴۱۰٬۰۰۰ تومان/ماه میانگین). MRR ناخالص صورتحساب‌شده: ۵۶۲٬۷۲۰٬۰۰۰ تومان/ماه؛ MRR خالص وصول‌شده پس از ۴٫۵٪ ذخیره مطالبات مشکوک/تأخیر چک: ۵۳۷٬۳۹۷٬۶۰۰ تومان/ماه.

bmc.title: منابع کلیدی
bmc.text: GPU داخلی: ۰٫۲۵ گره RTX 6000 Ada 48GB شامل ۲۵٪ بافر پیک (۳۷٬۵۰۰٬۰۰۰ تومان/ماه) + سرورهای CPU/DB داخلی شبکه ملی اطلاعات (۱۷٬۴۰۰٬۰۰۰ تومان/ماه). پشته فنی: Qwen3-14B / DeepSeek-V3 Distill کوانتیزه با آداپتورهای LoRA لحن برند فارسی. مجموعه داده: تحلیلگر ریسک ترک خدمت از متن آزاد فارسی و احساسات دپارتمان.

bmc.title: فعالیت‌های کلیدی
bmc.text: حفظ دقت LoRA روی تحلیلگر ریسک ترک خدمت از متن آزاد فارسی و احساسات دپارتمان؛ زنده نگه‌داشتن اتصال‌های یکپارچگی با API پرسلاین و دیجی‌سروی در برابر تغییرات مسیریابی شبکه ملی اطلاعات/BGP؛ اجرای سخت‌گیرانه صورت‌حساب ماهانه و شاخص‌بندی فصلی CPI/ارز برای جلوگیری از فرسایش حاشیه ریالی توسط تورم.

bmc.title: شرکای کلیدی
bmc.text: شرکای توزیع و API: یکپارچگی با API پرسلاین و دیجی‌سروی. زیرساخت: سینداد/افرانت (GPU/شبکه ملی اطلاعات)، زرین‌پال/پی‌پینگ (درگاه شپارک) و معاونت علمی و فناوری (معافیت مالیاتی دانش‌بنیان نوع ۱/۲).

bmc.title: ساختار هزینه (حسابرسی‌شده)
bmc.text: هزینه کامل مستقل: ۳۵۰٬۳۰۴٬۷۲۰ تومان/ماه؛ EBITDA مستقل: ۲۱۲٬۴۱۵٬۲۸۰ تومان/ماه (۳۷٫۷٪). هزینه سبد موتور مشترک (تقسیم توسعه/دفتر بین ۳ ابزار هم‌خانواده): ۲۸۷٬۰۳۴٬۷۲۰ تومان/ماه؛ EBITDA سبد: ۲۷۵٬۶۸۵٬۲۸۰ تومان/ماه (۴۹٫۰٪).

verdict_blocks.x: Verdict: marginal and thin, with an unsized pool and light usage. The base case (300 paying firms at month 24) breaks even in month 17 but has not repaid its cash need by month 24 (cumulative −2,146M toman, about $8,090); the conservative case (90 firms) never breaks even and the optimistic case (750 firms) breaks even in month 10 [D]. Halving the customer counts also prevents break-even [D]. Firm counts are assumptions: I found no count of Iranian employers that run employee surveys. Employee surveys are usually run once or twice a year, so the model assumes firms use only 35% of their paid analyses and 10% monthly churn [A]; both are guesses. The compute node is 42.6% of fixed cost while loaded to under 5% [D], so a smaller GPU would help, which I did not model. Persian text quality is unverified for this task: embedding benchmarks exist (FaMTEB, below) but I found no benchmark on employee-comment theme coding. Employee comments are confidential, so customers may refuse to upload them.

r: (a) Small firms that run 1 to 2 surveys with an online form tool. (b) Mid-size firms with an HR team, up to 5 surveys a month. (c) Large firms and holding groups running up to 15 surveys a month across units [A]. Pool: no count of Iranian employers running employee surveys was found; the plan sizes and mix are [A]. 300 paying firms at month 24 is [A].

The HR user uploads survey exports (Persian answers, scales and demographics) from Porsline, Google Forms or Excel; the tool groups open-ended answers into themes, labels sentiment, ranks themes by unit, and writes a Persian summary with quotations and suggested actions. The labour replaced is an analyst reading and coding about 400 answers: 240 minutes [A], 572,092 toman at 143,023 toman an hour (1405 minimum wage loaded with 23% employer insurance [D]). The plans work out at 300,000, 500,000 and 600,000 toman a survey, 52.4%, 87.4% and 104.9% of that cost [D]. Foreign anchors: mid-market feedback-analytics platforms cost roughly $25,000 to $75,000 a year, Qualtrics a median near $30,000 a year (276 deals), self-serve survey tools $19 to $50 a month, which are collection tools (getthematic.com, updated 15 Jul 2026, vendor page [S]); $25,000 a year is about $2,083 a month [D], far above any plan here. The main Iranian survey tool, Porsline, lists Pro at CAD 20 a month billed annually (pricingsaas.com, 20 Jul 2026; its history page lists euros, so the currency conflicts [S]).
Integrations or partnerships with Iranian survey and form tools [A], direct outreach to HR managers, LinkedIn and Telegram HR groups, and 1 free analysis.
Self-service upload and dashboard; onboarding call for large firms; 1 support person per 200 firms [A]. Prices in toman, indexed to the exchange rate.

Monthly plans per firm: Starter with 2 surveys 600,000 toman (about $2.26), Standard with 5 surveys 2,500,000 (about $9.42), Enterprise with 15 surveys 9,000,000 (about $33.92) [A, no price was found]. Mix 55% / 35% / 10% [A] gives ARPU 2,105,000 toman a month (about $7.93) [D]. Firms use 35% of their surveys [A], so 1.52 analyses a firm a month [D]. 10% monthly churn [A].

risks.x: Confidentiality: employees' free-text comments can identify people; firms may refuse to upload them, and a leak would end the business. Small-group suppression is needed.

verdict_blocks.x: Verdict: viable on the numbers, with willingness to pay and the project feed unproven. The base case (3,000 paying freelancers at month 24) breaks even in month 9 and earns +1,438M toman a month (about $5,420); the conservative case (1,000 freelancers) breaks even in month 17 and has not repaid its cash need by month 24 (cumulative −1,834M) [D]. The plan prices include a success fee on won contracts, which is assumed and not tested; I found no Iranian platform commission rate. The product cannot match anyone without a feed of open projects, and the platforms that hold the projects are its natural competitors, so the data supply is the main blocker. Prices per proposal are 12,000 to 15,000 toman (about $0.045 to $0.057) [D] against a general-purpose chatbot that freelancers can already use for free or for a few dollars [A]; I did not benchmark proposal quality.

bmc.title: بخش‌های مشتری
bmc.text: خریدار هدف: تیم‌های منابع انسانی (کسب‌وکار کوچک و متوسط ایرانی، بازار، کلینیک و آژانس B2B). جایگزین یا کاهش‌دهنده: بودجه‌های آموزش سازمانی بدون هدف‌گذاری. پایه فعال حسابرسی‌شده در ماه ۱۲: ۱۲۵ حساب پرداخت‌کننده (۵۷ پایه، ۵۳ رشد، ۱۵ حرفه‌ای/سازمانی/بسته)، کالیبره‌شده با مقیاس بخش نرم‌افزار ابری ایران (لاتکا) و ریزش ماهانه ۶٫۵٪.

bmc.title: ارزش پیشنهادی
bmc.text: جایگزین «بودجه‌های آموزش سازمانی بدون هدف‌گذاری» با کمتر از ۱۵٪ هزینه دستی/جریمه می‌شود. موتور داده: تحلیلگر ماتریس شایستگی نقش در برابر ارزیابی کارمند؛ با میزبانی ۱۰۰٪ داخل ایران روی دیتاسنترهای شبکه ملی اطلاعات، تا وبهوک‌های داخلی (بله/ایتا/وب محلی) در قطعی‌های اینترنت بین‌المللی فعال بمانند.

bmc.title: کانال‌ها و کمیسیون‌ها
bmc.text: ورود به بازار عمدتاً از طریق HRIS داخلی و اسناد انطباق ISO 10015 به‌همراه ۰٫۶۰ نفر کارشناس فروش سازمانی. مدل: کمیسیون ۱۵٪ شرکا/بازارگاه بر ۶۵٪ از درآمد (۴۱٬۰۳۸٬۸۶۸ تومان در ماه در بهای تمام‌شده) برای انگیزه‌دهی به نمایندگان ERP، آژانس‌ها و فروشگاه‌های اپ.

bmc.title: روابط با مشتری
bmc.text: راه‌اندازی ترکیبی خودخدمت + تلفنی/رباتی. لینک‌های تمدید خودکار پیامکی کاوه‌نگار؛ ۰٫۹۷ نفر متخصص پشتیبانی برای موارد نیازمند دخالت انسان و پیگیری صورت‌حساب صیاد/شپارک.

bmc.title: جریان‌های درآمد (حسابرسی‌شده)
bmc.text: صورتحساب ماهانه به تومان (به‌ازای هر کارمند): پایه ۱٬۴۷۵٬۰۰۰ تومان/ماه | رشد ۳٬۶۴۰٬۰۰۰ | حرفه‌ای/سازمانی ۷٬۰۰۰٬۰۰۰ + بسته‌های مصرف (۴۷۰٬۰۰۰ تومان/ماه میانگین). MRR ناخالص صورتحساب‌شده: ۴۴۰٬۷۴۵٬۰۰۰ تومان/ماه؛ MRR خالص وصول‌شده پس از ۴٫۵٪ ذخیره مطالبات مشکوک/تأخیر چک: ۴۲۰٬۹۱۱٬۴۷۵ تومان/ماه.

bmc.title: منابع کلیدی
bmc.text: GPU داخلی: ۰٫۱۸ گره RTX 6000 Ada 48GB شامل ۲۵٪ بافر پیک (۲۷٬۰۰۰٬۰۰۰ تومان/ماه) + سرورهای CPU/DB داخلی شبکه ملی اطلاعات (۲۴٬۳۰۰٬۰۰۰ تومان/ماه). پشته فنی: LightGBM / Prophet با فصلیت جلالی + حل‌کننده قید OR-Tools + توضیح‌دهنده Qwen3-8B روی CPU/GPU مشترک. مجموعه داده: تحلیلگر ماتریس شایستگی نقش در برابر ارزیابی کارمند.

bmc.title: فعالیت‌های کلیدی
bmc.text: حفظ دقت LoRA روی تحلیلگر ماتریس شایستگی نقش در برابر ارزیابی کارمند؛ زنده نگه‌داشتن اتصال‌های HRIS داخلی و اسناد انطباق ISO 10015 در برابر تغییرات مسیریابی شبکه ملی اطلاعات/BGP؛ اجرای سخت‌گیرانه صورت‌حساب ماهانه و شاخص‌بندی فصلی CPI/ارز برای جلوگیری از فرسایش حاشیه ریالی توسط تورم.

bmc.title: شرکای کلیدی
bmc.text: شرکای توزیع و API: HRIS داخلی و اسناد انطباق ISO 10015. زیرساخت: سینداد/افرانت (GPU/شبکه ملی اطلاعات)، زرین‌پال/پی‌پینگ (درگاه شپارک) و معاونت علمی و فناوری (معافیت مالیاتی دانش‌بنیان نوع ۱/۲).

bmc.title: ساختار هزینه (حسابرسی‌شده)
bmc.text: هزینه کامل مستقل: ۳۷۸٬۲۷۲٬۰۷۹ تومان/ماه؛ EBITDA مستقل: ۶۲٬۴۷۲٬۹۲۱ تومان/ماه (۱۴٫۲٪). هزینه سبد موتور مشترک (تقسیم توسعه/دفتر بین ۳ ابزار هم‌خانواده): ۳۰۳٬۲۴۲٬۰۷۹ تومان/ماه؛ EBITDA سبد: ۱۳۷٬۵۰۲٬۹۲۱ تومان/ماه (۳۱٫۲٪).

verdict_blocks.x: Verdict: weak on the numbers. The base case (180 paying firms at month 24) breaks even in month 19 and is still 3,353M toman short in cumulative cash at month 24 (about $12,640); the conservative case (60 firms) never breaks even within 24 months (cumulative −6,531M), and the optimistic case (450 firms) breaks even in month 11 [D]. A GPU price rise, 30% lower prices, or half the customers each push the base case below break-even [D]. Firm counts are assumptions: I found no count of Iranian firms with a training function. The price per employee is tiny (about $0.07 an employee analysis [D]) because the model prices against the labour of an L&D specialist and not against LMS per-seat fees, so the service needs many firms to cover a team of three and a 150M toman GPU node that the load fills to about 12% [D]. The recommendations depend on a catalogue of Persian courses and on a skills taxonomy that I could not verify exists in usable form; without a catalogue the output is generic.

r: (a) Small firms with about 30 staff and no training function. (b) Mid-size firms with about 150 staff and an HR or training officer. (c) Large firms and holdings with about 800 staff and a training department [A]. Pool: no count of Iranian firms by size with training budgets was found; an Iranian study of 20 organisations reports large and private firms outperforming SMEs in training but gives no budget figures in its abstract [S, rimag.ir/en/Article/29319]. The plan sizes and mix are [A]. 180 paying firms at month 24 is [A].

For each employee the tool takes the job description, a short self-assessment and manager rating, finds skill gaps against the role, and recommends courses, books or on-the-job tasks from a catalogue (the firm's own plus public Persian courses), with a quarterly plan and a firm-level gap summary for the budget. The labour replaced is an L&D specialist preparing one individual development plan: 45 minutes [A], 107,267 toman at 143,023 toman an hour (1405 minimum wage loaded with 23% employer insurance [D]). The plans work out at 20,000, 20,000 and 17,500 toman an employee analysis, 18.6%, 18.6% and 16.3% of that cost [D]. Foreign anchors are per-seat monthly fees: LMS software typically $2 to $50 per user a month, average $9 across 3 tools, 360Learning $8 (costbench.com, 2026, no date; Degreed price not found [S]); the Mid plan here works out at 20,000 toman an employee a month, about $0.075 [D].
HR conferences and communities, LinkedIn and Telegram, partnerships with training firms and online course sellers who want to be in the catalogue [A], and 10 free employee analyses.
Self-service for small firms; onboarding workshop for large firms; 1 support person per 150 firms [A]. Prices in toman, indexed to the exchange rate.

Monthly plans per firm: Small with 30 employees 600,000 toman (about $2.26), Mid with 150 employees 3,000,000 (about $11.31), Large with 800 employees 14,000,000 (about $52.77) [A, no price was found]. Mix 55% / 35% / 10% [A] gives ARPU 2,780,000 toman a month (about $10.48) [D]. Firms analyse 35% of their quota each month [A], so 52.15 analyses a firm a month [D]. 8% monthly churn [A]. Possible extra: referral fees from course sellers, not modelled.
A language model on one 48 GB GPU node (150M toman a month [S]), a Persian course and skill catalogue, a web dashboard; 2 engineers at 50M and 1 support person at 25M, gross [A].
Building and updating the catalogue and skills taxonomy, Persian prompt tuning, manager-rating workflows, reporting for budgets, selling to HR.
Training providers and course platforms for catalogue access (none confirmed), a domestic cloud host, and a payment gateway (worst-case 1% fee [S, sources conflict: 0.05%–1%]).

Fixed: team 153.75M toman a month ((50M + 50M + 25M) gross [A] × 1.23 [S]), GPU node 150M, other infrastructure 10M, accounting 8M, marketing 30M = 351.75M toman a month (about $1,326) [D]; one-time setup 150M [A] (about $565). Variable: gateway 1% of revenue, 20 toman per analysis for storage [A], compute time, and an added GPU node when load passes one node's capacity.
[D] (2 engineers at 50M + 1 support at 25M, gross, salaries [A]) × 1.23 employer insurance [S]
[A] role profile, self-assessment, skill list and catalogue extract in; plan out
[D] 9,500 tokens ÷ (2,658.57 tokens a second [S, A6000 vLLM benchmark] × 0.8 × 0.55 for a 14B-class model [A])
[A] load peaks when quarterly reviews open
[D] 35% use [A] of the 30 / 150 / 800 quotas, weighted by plan mix

cost_model.x: One node serves about 1,541 firms including 10 free analyses each [D: 95,749 ÷ (52.15 + 10)], so one node covers every scenario to month 24 and the load is 11.7% at 180 firms [D: 180 × 62.15 ÷ 95,749]. The GPU node is 42.6% of fixed cost [D: 150M ÷ 351.75M].

revenue.x: Break-even is about 128 paying firms on the fixed-cost formula [D: 351.75M ÷ (2,780,000 × 0.99 − 52.15 × 20) = 127.9], and stepping through firm counts with support staff gives 128 on one node [D]. Firms ramp linearly from month 4 to the month-12 figure, then to the month-24 figure; the 150M setup falls in month 1.

Firm counts are [A]. Cumulative cash at month 24 is −6,531M toman in the conservative case, −3,353M in the base case and +3,552M in the optimistic case [D]. Lifetime value per firm at 8% churn is about 34.39M toman, about $129.63 [D: (2,780,000 × 0.99 − 52.15 × 20) ÷ 0.08].

sensitivities.x: The base case holds 180 firms at 8% monthly churn [A], which needs about 14 replacements a month and the ramp adds 10 [D], so about 24 gross additions a month at month 24. With 30M of marketing that is about 1.23M toman (about $4.63) per firm [D], and the model does not stress marketing. Every sensitivity pushes the base case below break-even, which is why I call it weak.

risks.x: Catalogue: recommendations need a maintained catalogue of Persian courses with prices and levels; no open source of one was found, and course sellers may not share data.
Skills taxonomy: a usable Persian job and skills taxonomy was not verified; building one is work the 3-person team does not budget separately.
Manager data: ratings and self-assessments are subjective and may be gamed; employee data is sensitive.
Price anchor: LMS vendors charge per seat and may add the same feature; the model prices below labour cost and still has thin economics.
Compute assumption: token counts per analysis are guesses; the GPU is a fixed cost loaded to about 12% at 180 firms.
Rial drift: toman prices need monthly indexing (the dollar rate rose 30.6% from 24 Aug to 17 Oct 2026 [D]).

unverified.x: The number of Iranian firms with a training function or budget, by size.
Iranian prices for LMS or skills-gap software.
A maintained Persian course catalogue with prices and levels, and its licence.
Whether manager-rated skill gaps predict training value in Iranian firms.
Zarinpal fee and VAT, as in #1.
Check run: all [D] figures above were recomputed by running the model in code on 28 Oct 2026.

bmc.text: حفظ دقت LoRA روی تولیدکننده بازخورد عملکرد فارسی بدون سوگیری و خلاصه KPI؛ زنده نگه‌داشتن اتصال‌های وب‌اپ و افزونه HRIS در برابر تغییرات مسیریابی شبکه ملی اطلاعات/BGP؛ اجرای سخت‌گیرانه صورت‌حساب ماهانه و شاخص‌بندی فصلی CPI/ارز برای جلوگیری از فرسایش حاشیه ریالی توسط تورم.

verdict_blocks.x: Verdict: unprofitable on these assumptions. The base case (360 paying accounts at month 24) does not break even within 24 months and loses 69M toman a month at month 24 (cumulative −5,231M, about $19,720); the conservative case (120 accounts) also never breaks even (cumulative −7,137M), and the optimistic case (900 accounts) breaks even in month 15 but is still −1,174M cumulative at month 24 [D]. Account counts are assumptions: I found no count of Iranian firms that run formal performance reviews. Reviews are seasonal and the model assumes accounts use 30% of their paid drafts [A]. The average account pays 880,000 toman a month (about $3.32) [D], too little to carry a three-person team and a GPU node at the user counts I assumed; the compute load is about 3% of one node [D]. Foreign per-seat prices are low as well (Lattice $8 a user a month with a $4,000 minimum annual spend [S]), and a general chatbot costs nothing or $20 a month [S], so I see little room for a higher price. Persian quality of review text was not benchmarked.

r: (a) Individual managers who pay for themselves. (b) Teams of managers in mid-size firms. (c) Companies with a review cycle across about 200 reviews a month in season [A]. Pool: no count of Iranian firms with formal review cycles was found; the plan sizes and mix are [A]. 360 paying accounts at month 24 is [A].

The manager pastes notes, goals and peer comments (or imports them); the tool drafts a balanced Persian review with evidence, a rating rationale and next-quarter goals, flags biased or vague wording, and keeps a record per employee. The labour replaced is a manager writing one review with evidence: 40 minutes [A], 95,349 toman at 143,023 toman an hour (1405 minimum wage loaded with 23% employer insurance [D]). The plans work out at 30,000, 25,000 and 20,000 toman a draft, 31.5%, 26.2% and 21.0% of that cost [D]. Foreign anchors: Lattice $8 a user a month ($4,000 minimum annual), 15Five about $11, Workleap $5 to $6.25 with a 10-user minimum, Culture Amp about $9 to $14 through resellers, ChatGPT free or $20 a month flat (dupple.com, published 16 Jun 2026, prices as of June 2026 [S]).
LinkedIn, HR Telegram groups, content on writing reviews, partnerships with HR consultancies [A], and 3 free drafts.
Self-service with templates; a short onboarding for company plans; 1 support person per 250 accounts [A]. Prices in toman, indexed to the exchange rate.

Monthly plans: Solo manager with 10 drafts 300,000 toman (about $1.13), Team with 40 drafts 1,000,000 (about $3.77), Company with 200 drafts 4,000,000 (about $15.08) [A, no price was found]. Mix 60% / 30% / 10% [A] gives ARPU 880,000 toman a month (about $3.32) [D]. Accounts use 30% of their drafts [A], so 11.4 drafts an account a month [D]. 10% monthly churn [A].
A language model on one 48 GB GPU node (150M toman a month [S]), a review template library, a web app; 2 engineers at 50M and 1 support person at 25M, gross [A].
Persian tone and fairness tuning, templates by sector and rating scale, bias-wording checks, selling to managers and HR.
HR consultancies and HR software vendors, a domestic cloud host, and a payment gateway (worst-case 1% fee [S, sources conflict: 0.05%–1%]).

Fixed: team 153.75M toman a month ((50M + 50M + 25M) gross [A] × 1.23 [S]), GPU node 150M, other infrastructure 10M, accounting 8M, marketing 30M = 351.75M toman a month (about $1,326) [D]; one-time setup 150M [A] (about $565). Variable: gateway 1% of revenue, 25 toman per draft for storage [A], compute time, and an added GPU node when load passes one node's capacity.

[D] 5,900 tokens ÷ (2,658.57 tokens a second [S, A6000 vLLM benchmark] × 0.8 × 0.55 for a 14B-class model [A])

cost_model.x: One node serves about 10,706 accounts including 3 free drafts each [D: 154,172 ÷ (11.4 + 3)], so one node covers every scenario to month 24, with 3.4% load at 360 accounts [D: 360 × 14.4 ÷ 154,172]. The GPU node is 42.6% of fixed cost [D: 150M ÷ 351.75M]; the gross margin is above 97% but the fixed cost is what the business cannot cover.

revenue.x: Break-even is about 404 paying accounts on the fixed-cost formula [D: 351.75M ÷ (880,000 × 0.99 − 11.4 × 25) = 403.9], and stepping through account counts with support staff gives 440 on one node [D]. Accounts ramp linearly from month 4 to the month-12 figure, then to the month-24 figure; the 150M setup falls in month 1.

Account counts are [A]. Cumulative cash at month 24 is −7,137M toman in the conservative case, −5,231M in the base case and −1,174M in the optimistic case [D]. Lifetime value per account at 10% churn is about 8.71M toman, about $32.83 [D: (880,000 × 0.99 − 11.4 × 25) ÷ 0.10].

sensitivities.x: The base case holds 360 accounts at 10% monthly churn [A], which needs 36 replacements a month and the ramp adds 20 [D], so about 56 gross additions a month at month 24. With 30M of marketing that is about 535,700 toman (about $2.02) per account [D]; the model does not stress marketing, and no sensitivity reaches break-even.

risks.x: Substitution: a general chatbot already writes review text for free or $20 a month [S]; the model's prices were not tested against it.
Seasonality: reviews cluster at a few points a year, so accounts may pay for a month and leave; the model uses 30% use and 10% churn.
Fairness and legal exposure: AI-written reviews affect pay and dismissal; Iranian labour disputes may use them as evidence, and I did not verify any rule on this.
Sensitive data: reviews contain personal and pay information that firms may refuse to upload.
Persian quality: tone, politeness levels and rating language were not benchmarked.
Rial drift: toman prices need monthly indexing (the dollar rate rose 30.6% from 24 Aug to 17 Oct 2026 [D]).

unverified.x: The number of Iranian firms with formal performance-review cycles.
Iranian prices for performance-management software.
How many managers would pay personally for a drafting tool.
Labour-law or dispute-resolution rules on AI-assisted reviews.
Zarinpal fee and VAT, as in #1.
Check run: all [D] figures above were recomputed by running the model in code on 28 Oct 2026.

title: نگهداشت پیش‌بینانه از داده ارتعاش و سنسور
segment: سازمانی، صنعتی و نهادی B2B
engine: موتور ۴: شاخص‌بندی تورم، قیمت‌گذاری و پیش‌بینی تقاضا

bmc.title: بخش‌های مشتری
bmc.text: خریدار هدف: کارخانه‌ها (سازمانی، صنعتی و نهادی B2B). جایگزین یا کاهش‌دهنده: توقف خط بدون برنامه (زیان ۲۰۰ میلیون تا ۲ میلیارد تومان در روز) و کمبود بلبرینگ. پایه فعال حسابرسی‌شده در ماه ۱۲: ۳۱ حساب پرداخت‌کننده (۱۱ پایه، ۱۴ رشد، ۶ حرفه‌ای/سازمانی/بسته)، کالیبره‌شده با مقیاس بخش نرم‌افزار ابری ایران (لاتکا) و ریزش ماهانه ۴٫۰٪.

bmc.title: ارزش پیشنهادی
bmc.text: جایگزین «توقف خط بدون برنامه (زیان ۲۰۰ میلیون تا ۲ میلیارد تومان در روز) و کمبود بلبرینگ» با کمتر از ۱۵٪ هزینه دستی/جریمه می‌شود. موتور داده: مدل ناهنجاری ارتعاش FFT و عمر باقیمانده ماشین‌های دوار؛ با میزبانی ۱۰۰٪ داخل ایران روی دیتاسنترهای شبکه ملی اطلاعات، تا وبهوک‌های داخلی (بله/ایتا/وب محلی) در قطعی‌های اینترنت بین‌المللی فعال بمانند.

bmc.title: کانال‌ها و کمیسیون‌ها
bmc.text: ورود به بازار عمدتاً از طریق درگاه PLC با Modbus/OPC-UA و داشبورد محلی به‌همراه ۰٫۸۵ نفر کارشناس فروش سازمانی. مدل: کمیسیون ۱۵٪ شرکا/بازارگاه بر ۶۵٪ از درآمد (۴۹٬۳۲۸٬۰۲۸ تومان در ماه در بهای تمام‌شده) برای انگیزه‌دهی به نمایندگان ERP، آژانس‌ها و فروشگاه‌های اپ.

bmc.title: روابط با مشتری
bmc.text: راه‌اندازی ترکیبی خودخدمت + تلفنی/رباتی. لینک‌های تمدید خودکار پیامکی کاوه‌نگار؛ ۰٫۸۱ نفر متخصص پشتیبانی برای موارد نیازمند دخالت انسان و پیگیری صورت‌حساب صیاد/شپارک.

bmc.title: جریان‌های درآمد (حسابرسی‌شده)

MRR ناخالص صورتحساب‌شده: ۵۴۱٬۱۰۰٬۰۰۰ تومان/ماه؛ MRR خالص وصول‌شده پس از ۶٫۵٪ ذخیره مطالبات مشکوک/تأخیر چک: ۵۰۵٬۹۲۸٬۵۰۰ تومان/ماه.
