verdict_blocks.x: Verdict: viable on the numbers, with legal and data blockers that the model does not price. The base case (1,200 paying customers at month 24) breaks even in month 8, peaks at a cash need of 1,971M toman (about $7,428) and reaches +18,335M toman cumulative by month 24 [D]. The conservative case (400 customers) breaks even in month 15 but is still at -582M cumulative at month 24; the optimistic case (3,500) breaks even in month 5 and ends at +71,357M [D]. Every sensitivity stays profitable on a monthly basis: a doubled GPU price breaks even in month 10, prices 30% lower in month 11 and half the customers in month 13 [D]. ARPU is 2,870,000 toman a month (about $10.82) [D] and lifetime value about 69.8M toman (about $263) [D]. The cost that matters is compute and support together: at month 24 the base case runs 2 GPU nodes (about 33% of that month's cost of 904M) and 6 added support staff (about 24%) [D]. Customer counts are [A]: I found no count of Iranian importers, exporters or customs brokers, so the pool is unsourced. The blockers are (1) tariff-code and duty accuracy, because Iranian duties are a 4% minimum plus a trading profit set by the Council of Ministers and the schedule has 8,357 tariff lines as of 2020 [S], so a wrong code or a stale rate can cost the customer money and the service has no confirmed rate feed; (2) sanctions: the United States keeps comprehensive sanctions on Iran apart from specific licences, and General License X of 22 June 2026 covered only oil, petrochemical and related shipping, insurance and payment transactions and was due to expire on 21 August 2026 [S], so the service must run only on domestic hosting and models, must not draft documents that hide the origin, destination or parties of a shipment, and may be asked by customers to do so; (3) the customer remains legally responsible for the declaration, so liability sits with the user but disputes would reach the provider.

r: (a) Small traders and importers handling about 10 shipments a month (Small trader plan). (b) Trading companies handling about 40 shipments a month (Trader plan). (c) Customs broker offices handling about 200 shipments a month (Broker plan). Pool: no count of commercial-card holders, importers or brokers was found; 1,200 paying customers at month 24 is [A].

For each shipment the service reads the invoice, packing list and bill of lading, proposes the 8-digit tariff code with the matching duty rate and permit requirements, and checks the document set against the 14 documents Iranian import needs (warehouse receipt, commercial and proforma invoices, packing list, delivery order, bill of lading, manifest, certificate of origin, import registration permission, broker licence card, commercial card, power of attorney, inspection certificate, insurance policy) [S, Iran trade regulation guidance 2020]. The labour replaced is a trader or clerk spending 3 hours a shipment on gathering, checking and classifying [A], 429,069 toman at 143,023 toman an hour (1405 minimum wage loaded with 23% employer insurance [D]). The plans work out at 100,000, 80,000 and 60,000 toman a shipment, 23.3%, 18.6% and 14.0% of that cost [D]. Duty or delay savings are not priced.
Customs broker associations and trading chambers [A], chat-app support, a web app with document upload, and 1 free shipment per customer.
Self-service upload with a review screen before anything is used; chat support, 1 support person per 200 customers [A]; every proposed code is shown with its reasoning so the user confirms it.

Monthly plans: Small trader 1,000,000 toman (about $3.77) for 10 shipments, Trader 3,200,000 (about $12.06) for 40, Broker office 12,000,000 (about $45.23) for 200 [A, no domestic or foreign price was found]. Mix 55% / 35% / 10% [A] gives ARPU 2,870,000 toman a customer a month (about $10.82) [D]. Customers use 80% of their quota [A], so 31.6 shipments a customer on average [D]. 4% monthly churn [A].

One RTX 6000 Ada 48 GB GPU node at 150M toman a month [S, Sindad, 14 Sep 2026]; a tariff schedule and permit database kept current (source not confirmed); 2 engineers at 60M, 1 customs specialist at 40M and 1 support person at 30M, gross [A].

Document extraction for Persian and English trade documents, tariff-code retrieval and checking, duty-rate updates, permit and document checklists, sanctions screening of the parties and countries named in documents, onboarding and support.

A licensed customs broker for review of disputed codes [A, none confirmed], the owner of tariff and rate data (the customs administration or a data reseller, none confirmed), a domestic cloud host, and a payment gateway (worst-case 1% fee [S, sources conflict: 0.05%–1%]).

Fixed: team 233.7M toman a month ((60M + 60M + 40M + 30M) gross [A] × 1.23 [S]), first GPU node 150M, other infrastructure 10M, accounting 8M, marketing 40M = 441.7M toman a month (about $1,665) [D]; one-time setup 250M [A] (about $942). Variable: gateway 1% of revenue, 1,500 toman per shipment for storage and form handling [A], one added GPU node for each 1,193 customers, and one added support person (36.9M toman a month loaded) for each 200 customers.
[D] (2 engineers at 60M + 1 specialist at 40M + 1 support person at 30M, gross, salaries [A]) × 1.23 employer insurance [S]
[A] 3 documents read by a vision-language model at about 4 s each plus code retrieval and checklist, rounded; no benchmark for Persian customs documents
[D] quota weighted by plan mix × 80% use
[D] after compute, storage and 1% gateway; excludes support staff
[D] team 233.7M + first node 150M + infrastructure 10M + accounting 8M + marketing 40M

cost_model.x: One node serves about 1,193 customers including 1 free shipment each [D: 38,880 ÷ (31.6 + 1)], so the base case needs 2 nodes at month 24 and the optimistic case 3 [D, from the model]; in the base case the 2 nodes are about 33% of that month's total cost of 904M [D: 300M ÷ 904M]. The 6 added support staff cost about 221M, about 24% of it [D: 6 × 36.9M ÷ 904M].

revenue.x: Break-even is about 158 paying customers on the fixed-cost formula [D: 441.7M ÷ (2,870,000 × 0.99 − 31.6 × 1,500) = 158.1], and stepping through customer counts with support staff and node steps gives 159 on 1 node [D]. Customers ramp linearly from month 4 to the month-12 figure, then to the month-24 figure; the 250M setup falls in month 1.

Customer counts are [A]. Cumulative cash at month 24 is -582M toman in the conservative case, +18,335M in the base case and +71,357M in the optimistic case [D]. Lifetime value per customer at 4% churn is about 69.8M toman, about $263 [D: (2,870,000 × 0.99 − 31.6 × 1,500) ÷ 0.04]. The Broker plan is 10% of customers [A] but 42% of revenue [D: 1,200,000 of 2,870,000 toman], so a few broker offices decide the result.

sensitivities.x: The base case holds 1,200 customers at 4% monthly churn [A], which needs about 48 replacements a month, and the ramp adds about 75, so about 123 gross additions a month at month 24 [D]. With 40M of marketing that is about 325,000 toman (about $1.23) per customer [D], low for businesses that must trust the tool with customs declarations; the model does not stress marketing, so the base case is likely too favourable.

risks.x: Wrong code or stale duty rate: the schedule has 8,357 tariff lines (2020) and duty includes a trading profit set by the Council of Ministers [S]; a wrong answer costs the customer duty or a penalty. Vendor-reported AI first-pass accuracy of 93-96% against 90-95% for specialist brokers (camtomx.com, undated, vendor [S]) is not Iranian evidence.

Sanctions exposure: Iran remains under comprehensive US sanctions except for specific licences [S, GL X, 22 Jun 2026, expiry 21 Aug 2026, status after that not checked]. The service must use no foreign cloud or model, and customers may ask for documents that conceal parties or origin; screening and refusal rules are a cost and a churn risk.
Data access: no confirmed source for official tariff and rate updates or for permit rules by code.

Broker substitution: customs brokers already prepare declarations and bundle classification in the per-entry fee [S, camtomx.com]; a broker-office plan only works if brokers adopt the tool rather than treat it as a threat.
Liability: the user signs the declaration, but disputes over a suggested code would reach the provider; terms of service and professional insurance are unpriced.
Rial drift: toman prices need monthly indexing (the dollar rate rose 30.6% from 24 Aug to 17 Oct 2026 [D]).

unverified.x: The number of Iranian importers, exporters, commercial-card holders and customs brokers, and shipments per month (the WCO page of 17 Nov 2017 gives no counts).
Any domestic or foreign price for a tariff-code assistant (the sources found state no prices).
Whether official tariff and duty-rate data can be obtained in machine-readable form, and its licence.
Accuracy of document extraction on Persian customs documents and of code suggestions for Iranian 8-digit codes.
Whether OFAC General License X was extended past 21 August 2026, and how sanctions law applies to each customer's trade.
Zarinpal fee and VAT, as in #1.
Check run: all [D] figures above were recomputed by running the model in code on 31 Oct 2026.

title: نویسنده محتوای وبلاگ و شبکه اجتماعی فارسی با لحن برند
segment: کسب‌وکار کوچک و متوسط ایرانی، بازار، کلینیک و آژانس B2B
engine: موتور ۵A: تولید محتوای فارسی و نگارش بازاریابی/آکادمیک

bmc.title: بخش‌های مشتری
bmc.text: خریدار هدف: بازاریابان (کسب‌وکار کوچک و متوسط ایرانی، بازار، کلینیک و آژانس B2B). جایگزین یا کاهش‌دهنده: قرارداد ماهانه نویسنده محتوا (۱۲ تا ۲۵ میلیون تومان در ماه). پایه فعال حسابرسی‌شده در ماه ۱۲: ۱۸۹ حساب پرداخت‌کننده (۷۳ پایه، ۹۳ رشد، ۲۳ حرفه‌ای/سازمانی/بسته)، کالیبره‌شده با مقیاس بخش نرم‌افزار ابری ایران (لاتکا) و ریزش ماهانه ۱۱٫۰٪.

bmc.title: ارزش پیشنهادی
bmc.text: جایگزین «قرارداد ماهانه نویسنده محتوا (۱۲ تا ۲۵ میلیون تومان در ماه)» با کمتر از ۱۵٪ هزینه دستی/جریمه می‌شود. موتور داده: موتور مقاله سئو و کپشن فارسی بدون افت لحن در ترجمه؛ با میزبانی ۱۰۰٪ داخل ایران روی دیتاسنترهای شبکه ملی اطلاعات، تا وبهوک‌های داخلی (بله/ایتا/وب محلی) در قطعی‌های اینترنت بین‌المللی فعال بمانند.

bmc.title: کانال‌ها و کمیسیون‌ها
bmc.text: ورود به بازار عمدتاً از طریق افزونه فارسی وردپرس و زمان‌بند تلگرام/اینستاگرام به‌همراه ۰٫۴۵ نفر کارشناس فروش سازمانی. مدل: کمیسیون ۱۲٪ شرکا/بازارگاه بر ۶۵٪ از درآمد (۴۵٬۰۳۶٬۲۸۱ تومان در ماه در بهای تمام‌شده) برای انگیزه‌دهی به نمایندگان ERP، آژانس‌ها و فروشگاه‌های اپ.

bmc.title: روابط با مشتری
bmc.text: راه‌اندازی ترکیبی خودخدمت + تلفنی/رباتی. لینک‌های تمدید خودکار پیامکی کاوه‌نگار؛ ۱٫۰۴ نفر متخصص پشتیبانی برای موارد نیازمند دخالت انسان و پیگیری صورت‌حساب صیاد/شپارک.

bmc.title: جریان‌های درآمد (حسابرسی‌شده)
bmc.text: صورتحساب ماهانه به تومان (اعتبار مصرفی): پایه ۱٬۶۲۵٬۰۰۰ تومان/ماه | رشد ۲٬۷۶۰٬۰۰۰ | حرفه‌ای/سازمانی ۶٬۶۰۰٬۰۰۰ + بسته‌های مصرف (۴۱۰٬۰۰۰ تومان/ماه میانگین). MRR ناخالص صورتحساب‌شده: ۶۰۴٬۵۹۵٬۰۰۰ تومان/ماه؛ MRR خالص وصول‌شده پس از ۴٫۵٪ ذخیره مطالبات مشکوک/تأخیر چک: ۵۷۷٬۳۸۸٬۲۲۵ تومان/ماه.

bmc.title: منابع کلیدی
bmc.text: GPU داخلی: ۰٫۲۸ گره RTX 6000 Ada 48GB شامل ۲۵٪ بافر پیک (۴۲٬۰۰۰٬۰۰۰ تومان/ماه) + سرورهای CPU/DB داخلی شبکه ملی اطلاعات (۱۷٬۴۰۰٬۰۰۰ تومان/ماه). پشته فنی: Qwen3-14B / DeepSeek-V3 Distill کوانتیزه با آداپتورهای LoRA لحن برند فارسی. مجموعه داده: موتور مقاله سئو و کپشن فارسی بدون افت لحن در ترجمه.

bmc.title: فعالیت‌های کلیدی
bmc.text: حفظ دقت LoRA روی موتور مقاله سئو و کپشن فارسی بدون افت لحن در ترجمه؛ زنده نگه‌داشتن اتصال‌های افزونه فارسی وردپرس و زمان‌بند تلگرام/اینستاگرام در برابر تغییرات مسیریابی شبکه ملی اطلاعات/BGP؛ اجرای سخت‌گیرانه صورت‌حساب ماهانه و شاخص‌بندی فصلی CPI/ارز برای جلوگیری از فرسایش حاشیه ریالی توسط تورم.

bmc.title: شرکای کلیدی
bmc.text: شرکای توزیع و API: افزونه فارسی وردپرس و زمان‌بند تلگرام/اینستاگرام. زیرساخت: سینداد/افرانت (GPU/شبکه ملی اطلاعات)، زرین‌پال/پی‌پینگ (درگاه شپارک) و معاونت علمی و فناوری (معافیت مالیاتی دانش‌بنیان نوع ۱/۲).

bmc.title: ساختار هزینه (حسابرسی‌شده)
bmc.text: هزینه کامل مستقل: ۳۶۷٬۲۲۳٬۳۷۶ تومان/ماه؛ EBITDA مستقل: ۲۳۷٬۳۷۱٬۶۲۴ تومان/ماه (۳۹٫۳٪). هزینه سبد موتور مشترک (تقسیم توسعه/دفتر بین ۳ ابزار هم‌خانواده): ۳۰۳٬۰۵۳٬۳۷۶ تومان/ماه؛ EBITDA سبد: ۳۰۱٬۵۴۱٬۶۲۴ تومان/ماه (۴۹٫۹٪).

pl.label: درآمد ناخالص صورتحساب‌شده (MRR)

verdict_blocks.x: Verdict: viable on the numbers, with a thin ARPU and an unproven quality edge. The base case (3,500 paying customers at month 24) breaks even in month 7, peaks at a cash need of 1,570M toman (about $5,919) and reaches +27,403M toman cumulative by month 24 [D]. The conservative case (1,000 customers) breaks even in month 13 and is at +1,371M cumulative at month 24; the optimistic case (10,000) breaks even in month 5 and ends at +96,303M [D]. Every sensitivity stays profitable: a doubled GPU price breaks even in month 8, prices 30% lower in month 8 and half the customers in month 10 [D]. ARPU is 1,470,000 toman a month (about $5.54) [D] and lifetime value about 23.4M toman (about $88) [D]. Costs scale with usage, not with the team: at month 24 the base case runs 4 GPU nodes (about 36% of that month's cost of 1,660M) and 14 added support staff (about 31%) [D]. Customer counts are [A]; the base case is 1.1% of the 308,000 sellers Digikala reported for FY1401 [S] only as a scale marker, because the buyer pool (small shops, marketers, agencies) is unsourced. The blockers are Persian text quality from a 30B-class open model and its licence (not checked), the fact that general chat tools already write Persian at low or no cost (not priced here), and that Instagram and Telegram, where much of the content is posted, are subject to filtering rules that I did not verify. Foreign tools are priced at $69 (Jasper Pro, monthly) and $29 (Copy.ai Chat) per user [S, costbench.com, June 2026, third-party]; the Solo plan here is $2.26.

r: (a) Sole owners of online shops and freelancers (Solo plan). (b) Small marketing teams in shops and startups (Team plan). (c) Social-media and content agencies (Agency plan). Pool: no count of Iranian shops posting on social media or of agencies was found (a 2017 article says only 'thousands of online shops' on Instagram [S]); 3,500 paying customers at month 24 is [A].

The customer saves a brand profile (tone, forbidden words, product list, past posts) and the service drafts Persian blog posts, captions and ad copy in that voice, with calendar suggestions and rewrites. The labour replaced is a marketer writing and editing one post or short article in 45 minutes [A], 107,267 toman at 143,023 toman an hour (1405 minimum wage loaded with 23% employer insurance [D]). The plans work out at 15,000, 12,000 and 9,000 toman a task, 14.0%, 11.2% and 8.4% of that cost [D].
Instagram and Telegram pages and shop communities [A], online-shop platform listings, agency referrals, chat-app support, and 5 free tasks per customer.
Self-service web app, a brand-profile setup session, chat support; 1 support person per 250 customers [A].

Monthly plans: Solo 600,000 toman (about $2.26) for 40 tasks, Team 2,400,000 (about $9.05) for 200, Agency 9,000,000 (about $33.92) for 1,000 [A, set below the foreign per-user prices]. Mix 70% / 25% / 5% [A] gives ARPU 1,470,000 toman a customer a month (about $5.54) [D]. Customers use 80% of their quota [A], so 102.4 tasks a customer on average [D]. 6% monthly churn [A].

One RTX 6000 Ada 48 GB GPU node at 150M toman a month [S, Sindad, 14 Sep 2026] running a 30B-class Persian-capable open model [A, model and licence not chosen]; 2 engineers at 60M, 1 Persian editor at 25M and 1 support person at 30M, gross [A].
Persian prompt and style tuning, brand-profile extraction from sample posts, output quality review, template upkeep, onboarding and support.
A domestic cloud host, a payment gateway (worst-case 1% fee [S, sources conflict: 0.05%–1%]), and shop platforms for distribution (none confirmed).

Fixed: team 215.25M toman a month ((60M + 60M + 25M + 30M) gross [A] × 1.23 [S]), first GPU node 150M, other infrastructure 10M, accounting 8M, marketing 80M = 463.25M toman a month (about $1,746) [D]; one-time setup 250M [A] (about $942). Variable: gateway 1% of revenue, 500 toman per task for brand-profile storage [A], one added GPU node for each 905 customers, and one added support person (36.9M toman a month loaded) for each 250 customers.
[D] (2 engineers at 60M + 1 editor at 25M + 1 support person at 30M, gross, salaries [A]) × 1.23 employer insurance [S]

[A] about 1,200 output tokens plus brand context; Persian about 3x English token count [A]; 30B-class model about 0.30x the 8B throughput proxy of 2,658.57 tokens a second [S, A6000 vLLM, 100 concurrent] × 0.8; no benchmark
[D] quota weighted by plan mix × 80% use
[D] after compute, storage and 1% gateway; excludes support staff
[D] team 215.25M + first node 150M + infrastructure 10M + accounting 8M + marketing 80M

cost_model.x: One node serves about 905 customers including 5 free tasks each [D: 97,200 ÷ (102.4 + 5)], so the base case needs 4 nodes at month 24 and the optimistic case 12 [D, from the model]; in the base case the 4 nodes are about 36% of that month's total cost of 1,660M [D: 600M ÷ 1,660M]. The 14 added support staff cost about 517M, about 31% of it [D: 14 × 36.9M ÷ 1,660M].

revenue.x: Break-even is about 330 paying customers on the fixed-cost formula [D: 463.25M ÷ (1,470,000 × 0.99 − 102.4 × 500) = 329.9], and stepping through customer counts with support staff and node steps gives 357 on 1 node [D]. Customers ramp linearly from month 4 to the month-12 figure, then to the month-24 figure; the 250M setup falls in month 1.

Customer counts are [A]. Cumulative cash at month 24 is +1,371M toman in the conservative case, +27,403M in the base case and +96,303M in the optimistic case [D]. Lifetime value per customer at 6% churn is about 23.4M toman, about $88 [D: (1,470,000 × 0.99 − 102.4 × 500) ÷ 0.06]. The Agency plan is 5% of customers [A] but 31% of revenue [D: 450,000 of 1,470,000 toman].

sensitivities.x: The base case holds 3,500 customers at 6% monthly churn [A], which needs about 210 replacements a month, and the ramp adds about 208, so about 418 gross additions a month at month 24 [D]. With 80M of marketing that is about 191,000 toman (about $0.72) per customer [D], very low for a product with free substitutes; the model does not stress marketing, so the base case is likely too favourable.

risks.x: Persian quality: a 30B-class open model may write stiff or error-prone Persian; no Persian marketing-copy benchmark was found, and weak output means churn above the 6% assumed.
Free substitutes: general chat assistants write Persian and have free plans (Jasper and Copy.ai both have free plans too [S]); whether Iranian users can reach them reliably was not verified.
Model licence: the open model and its commercial terms are not chosen.
Platform dependence: customers publish on Instagram and Telegram, whose access rules in Iran I did not verify; a ban or filtering change moves demand.
Support load: support is about 31% of base month-24 cost at the assumed ratio [D].
Rial drift: toman prices need monthly indexing (the dollar rate rose 30.6% from 24 Aug to 17 Oct 2026 [D]).

unverified.x: The number of Iranian online shops, marketers and agencies that would buy a content tool.
Any Iranian competitor price (zoomit and similar pages are blocked from fetching).
Persian output quality and the commercial licence of any candidate open model.
The current legal and filtering status of Instagram and Telegram for business posting.
Zarinpal fee and VAT, as in #1.
Check run: all [D] figures above were recomputed by running the model in code on 31 Oct 2026.

title: خط تولید زیرنویس و دوبله ویدیو
segment: کسب‌وکار کوچک و متوسط ایرانی، بازار، کلینیک و آژانس B2B
engine: موتور ۳: تشخیص گفتار، صدا و TTS فارسی

bmc.title: بخش‌های مشتری
bmc.text: خریدار هدف: تولیدکنندگان محتوا و مدارس (کسب‌وکار کوچک و متوسط ایرانی، بازار، کلینیک و آژانس B2B). جایگزین یا کاهش‌دهنده: مترجم/دوبلور انسانی (۸۰ تا ۲۵۰ هزار تومان به‌ازای هر دقیقه). پایه فعال حسابرسی‌شده در ماه ۱۲: ۱۷۲ حساب پرداخت‌کننده (۸۲ پایه، ۶۲ رشد، ۲۸ حرفه‌ای/سازمانی/بسته)، کالیبره‌شده با مقیاس بخش نرم‌افزار ابری ایران (لاتکا) و ریزش ماهانه ۷٫۵٪.

bmc.title: ارزش پیشنهادی
bmc.text: جایگزین «مترجم/دوبلور انسانی (۸۰ تا ۲۵۰ هزار تومان به‌ازای هر دقیقه)» با کمتر از ۱۵٪ هزینه دستی/جریمه می‌شود. موتور داده: ASR، ترجمه فنی و TTS فارسی هماهنگ با لب با خروجی SRT؛ با میزبانی ۱۰۰٪ داخل ایران روی دیتاسنترهای شبکه ملی اطلاعات، تا وبهوک‌های داخلی (بله/ایتا/وب محلی) در قطعی‌های اینترنت بین‌المللی فعال بمانند.

bmc.title: کانال‌ها و کمیسیون‌ها
bmc.text: ورود به بازار عمدتاً از طریق آپارات، یوتیوب و استودیوهای آموزشی فیلیمو/نماوا به‌همراه ۰٫۶۵ نفر کارشناس فروش سازمانی. مدل: کمیسیون ۱۵٪ شرکا/بازارگاه بر ۶۵٪ از درآمد (۵۳٬۱۷۸٬۴۱۱ تومان در ماه در بهای تمام‌شده) برای انگیزه‌دهی به نمایندگان ERP، آژانس‌ها و فروشگاه‌های اپ.

bmc.title: روابط با مشتری
bmc.text: راه‌اندازی ترکیبی خودخدمت + تلفنی/رباتی. لینک‌های تمدید خودکار پیامکی کاوه‌نگار؛ ۱٫۲۱ نفر متخصص پشتیبانی برای موارد نیازمند دخالت انسان و پیگیری صورت‌حساب صیاد/شپارک.

bmc.title: جریان‌های درآمد (حسابرسی‌شده)
bmc.text: صورتحساب ماهانه به تومان (به‌ازای هر دقیقه): پایه ۱٬۵۵۰٬۰۰۰ تومان/ماه | رشد ۲٬۸۷۰٬۰۰۰ | حرفه‌ای/سازمانی ۶٬۸۰۰٬۰۰۰ + بسته‌های مصرف (۴۴۰٬۰۰۰ تومان/ماه میانگین). MRR ناخالص صورتحساب‌شده: ۵۷۱٬۱۲۰٬۰۰۰ تومان/ماه؛ MRR خالص وصول‌شده پس از ۴٫۵٪ ذخیره مطالبات مشکوک/تأخیر چک: ۵۴۵٬۴۱۹٬۶۰۰ تومان/ماه.

bmc.title: منابع کلیدی
bmc.text: GPU داخلی: ۰٫۷۳ گره RTX 6000 Ada 48GB شامل ۲۵٪ بافر پیک (۱۰۹٬۵۰۰٬۰۰۰ تومان/ماه) + سرورهای CPU/DB داخلی شبکه ملی اطلاعات (۲۴٬۴۰۰٬۰۰۰ تومان/ماه). پشته فنی: Whisper-large-v3-turbo (فارسی محاوره‌ای) تنظیم‌شده + تفکیک گویندگان Pyannote + صدای فارسی Piper/XTTS. مجموعه داده: ASR، ترجمه فنی و TTS فارسی هماهنگ با لب با خروجی SRT.

bmc.title: فعالیت‌های کلیدی
bmc.text: حفظ دقت LoRA روی ASR، ترجمه فنی و TTS فارسی هماهنگ با لب با خروجی SRT؛ زنده نگه‌داشتن اتصال‌های آپارات، یوتیوب و استودیوهای آموزشی فیلیمو/نماوا در برابر تغییرات مسیریابی شبکه ملی اطلاعات/BGP؛ اجرای سخت‌گیرانه صورت‌حساب ماهانه و شاخص‌بندی فصلی CPI/ارز برای جلوگیری از فرسایش حاشیه ریالی توسط تورم.

bmc.title: شرکای کلیدی
bmc.text: شرکای توزیع و API: آپارات، یوتیوب و استودیوهای آموزشی فیلیمو/نماوا. زیرساخت: سینداد/افرانت (GPU/شبکه ملی اطلاعات)، زرین‌پال/پی‌پینگ (درگاه شپارک) و معاونت علمی و فناوری (معافیت مالیاتی دانش‌بنیان نوع ۱/۲).

verdict_blocks.x: Verdict: marginal, and weaker than its headline break-even suggests. The base case (3,500 paying customers at month 24) breaks even in month 13, peaks at a cash need of 2,600M toman (about $9,801) and reaches only +2,515M toman cumulative by month 24 [D]. The conservative case (1,000 customers) first shows a profit in month 23 but loses 99M in month 24 when a new GPU node is added and is at -5,317M cumulative [D]; the optimistic case (10,000) breaks even in month 7 and ends at +23,240M [D]. A doubled GPU price or prices 30% lower each push the base case to no break-even within 24 months, and only halving customers still breaks even (month 16) [D]. ARPU is 955,000 toman a month (about $3.60) [D] and lifetime value about 13.2M toman (about $50) [D]. Compute is the cost that matters: gross margin by plan falls from 63.9% to 40.4%, and at month 24 the base case runs 8 GPU nodes, about 46% of that month's cost of 2,581M, plus 14 added support staff, about 20% [D]. Customer counts are [A]: I found no count of Iranian video creators, schools or channels (Aparat reports 60M+ monthly users but no creator count [S]), so the pool is unsourced. The blockers are licence and quality of the speech-synthesis step, because the Persian voice models I found are non-commercial (one CC-BY-NC 4.0, one under the Coqui public licence, which restricts commercial use [S]), and dubbing quality in Persian is unproven. Foreign dubbing tools charge about $0.24 to $2.44 per video minute [S, perso.ai, 23 Oct 2026, vendor page, Persian support not stated], while the plans here are $0.015 to $0.025 a minute; the low price is [A] and is what keeps margins thin.

r: (a) Individual video creators and course sellers (Creator plan). (b) Channels, schools and small media teams (Channel plan). (c) Studios and platforms with large back catalogues (Studio plan). Pool: no creator or channel count was found; 3,500 paying customers at month 24 is [A].

The customer uploads a video; the service returns Persian subtitles with timing, a translation into or out of Persian, and optionally a synthetic dub. The labour replaced is a freelancer spending 5 working minutes per video minute on transcription, timing and proofreading [A], 11,919 toman per minute at 143,023 toman an hour (1405 minimum wage loaded with 23% employer insurance [D]); dubbing by voice actors is not priced. The plans work out at 6,667, 5,000 and 4,000 toman a video minute, 55.9%, 42.0% and 33.6% of that cost [D].
Creator communities, online-course sellers, school and training-centre sales, a web app, and 10 free minutes per customer.
Self-service upload with a subtitle editor; chat support; 1 support person per 250 customers [A].

Monthly plans: Creator 400,000 toman (about $1.51) for 60 minutes, Channel 1,500,000 (about $5.65) for 300, Studio 6,000,000 (about $22.62) for 1,500 [A, no domestic price was found]. Mix 70% / 25% / 5% [A] gives ARPU 955,000 toman a customer a month (about $3.60) [D]. Customers use 80% of their quota [A], so 153.6 video minutes a customer on average [D]. 6% monthly churn [A].

One RTX 6000 Ada 48 GB GPU node at 150M toman a month [S, Sindad, 14 Sep 2026]; a Persian speech-recognition model (the gooya-v1.4 model scores a word error rate of 14.72 on asr-farsi-youtube against 40.95 for whisper-large-v3 [S, navidved leaderboard, 23 Oct 2026]; its licence was not checked) and a commercially usable voice model (none confirmed); 2 engineers at 60M, 1 Persian linguist at 25M and 1 support person at 30M, gross [A].
Speech recognition and timing, translation quality control, voice synthesis tuning, subtitle editor, queue and storage management, onboarding and support.
A licensed voice dataset or voice actors for a commercial voice (none confirmed), a domestic cloud host, and a payment gateway (worst-case 1% fee [S, sources conflict: 0.05%–1%]).

Fixed: team 215.25M toman a month ((60M + 60M + 25M + 30M) gross [A] × 1.23 [S]), first GPU node 150M, other infrastructure 10M, accounting 8M, marketing 60M = 443.25M toman a month (about $1,671) [D]; one-time setup 250M [A] (about $942). Variable: gateway 1% of revenue, 1,000 toman per video minute for storage and traffic [A], one added GPU node for each 475 customers, and one added support person (36.9M toman a month loaded) for each 250 customers.

[A] recognition about 1.3 s (13 minutes of audio in 17 s on an RTX 3070 Ti, faster-whisper fp16 batch 8 [S]), translation 1.5 s, speech synthesis about 6 s, muxing 1 s; no Persian TTS benchmark found
[A] storage and traffic at about 100 MB a minute, priced from Arvan EUR0.020 per GB storage and EUR0.012 per GB traffic [S]

cost_model.x: One node serves about 475 customers including 10 free minutes each [D: 77,760 ÷ (153.6 + 10)], so the base case needs 8 nodes at month 24 and the optimistic case 22 [D, from the model]; in the base case the 8 nodes are about 46% of that month's total cost of 2,581M [D: 1,200M ÷ 2,581M]. The 14 added support staff cost about 517M, about 20% of it [D: 14 × 36.9M ÷ 2,581M].

revenue.x: Break-even is about 560 paying customers on the fixed-cost formula [D: 443.25M ÷ (955,000 × 0.99 − 153.6 × 1,000) = 559.8], and stepping through customer counts with support staff and node steps gives 889 on 2 nodes [D]. Customers ramp linearly from month 4 to the month-12 figure, then to the month-24 figure; the 250M setup falls in month 1.

Customer counts are [A]. Cumulative cash at month 24 is -5,317M toman in the conservative case, +2,515M in the base case and +23,240M in the optimistic case [D]. Lifetime value per customer at 6% churn is about 13.2M toman, about $50 [D: (955,000 × 0.99 − 153.6 × 1,000) ÷ 0.06]. The Channel plan is 25% of customers [A] and 39% of revenue [D: 375,000 of 955,000 toman]; the Studio plan is 5% of customers but 31% of revenue [D: 300,000 of 955,000], at the lowest margin.

sensitivities.x: The base case holds 3,500 customers at 6% monthly churn [A], which needs about 210 replacements a month, and the ramp adds about 208, so about 418 gross additions a month at month 24 [D]. With 60M of marketing that is about 144,000 toman (about $0.54) per customer [D], very low; the model does not stress marketing, so the base case is likely too favourable.

risks.x: Voice licence: the Persian voice models found are non-commercial (CC-BY-NC 4.0 and a Coqui public licence, with conflicting metadata on one [S]); a commercial voice needs a licensed dataset or voice actors, which is unpriced.
Thin margin: GPU time is the main cost and the base case has no cushion against a price cut or a higher compute time per minute [D].
Quality: Persian dubbing timing, names and numbers are unproven; subtitles alone (the lower-compute product) may be what sells.
Foreign substitutes: foreign tools cost $0.24 to $2.44 a minute [S] but their Persian support is not confirmed and payment from Iran is difficult [A].
Content liability: a platform that dubs customer videos may be asked to remove or refuse content; no rules were checked.
Rial drift: toman prices need monthly indexing (the dollar rate rose 30.6% from 24 Aug to 17 Oct 2026 [D]).

unverified.x: The number of Iranian creators, channels, schools and studios that would buy subtitling or dubbing (Aparat's page gives only visitor and watch-time figures).
Any Iranian subtitling or dubbing price.
Commercial licence of the speech-recognition model and of any voice model, and the real node time per minute of video.
Persian support and prices of the foreign dubbing tools.
Zarinpal fee and VAT, as in #1.
Check run: all [D] figures above were recomputed by running the model in code on 31 Oct 2026.

title: تولیدکننده پوستر و بنر با تایپوگرافی صحیح فارسی
segment: کسب‌وکار کوچک و متوسط ایرانی، بازار، کلینیک و آژانس B2B
engine: موتور ۵B: بینایی استودیویی مولد، بازطراحی و تایپوگرافی فارسی

bmc.title: بخش‌های مشتری
bmc.text: خریدار هدف: فروشگاه‌ها و آژانس‌ها (کسب‌وکار کوچک و متوسط ایرانی، بازار، کلینیک و آژانس B2B). جایگزین یا کاهش‌دهنده: طراح گرافیک (۳۰۰ هزار تا ۱ میلیون تومان به‌ازای هر بنر). پایه فعال حسابرسی‌شده در ماه ۱۲: ۱۴۴ حساب پرداخت‌کننده (۵۳ پایه، ۷۳ رشد، ۱۸ حرفه‌ای/سازمانی/بسته)، کالیبره‌شده با مقیاس بخش نرم‌افزار ابری ایران (لاتکا) و ریزش ماهانه ۱۰٫۰٪.

bmc.title: ارزش پیشنهادی
bmc.text: جایگزین «طراح گرافیک (۳۰۰ هزار تا ۱ میلیون تومان به‌ازای هر بنر)» با کمتر از ۱۵٪ هزینه دستی/جریمه می‌شود. موتور داده: تولید پس‌زمینه هوش مصنوعی و لایه تایپوگرافی راست‌به‌چپ فارسی؛ با میزبانی ۱۰۰٪ داخل ایران روی دیتاسنترهای شبکه ملی اطلاعات، تا وبهوک‌های داخلی (بله/ایتا/وب محلی) در قطعی‌های اینترنت بین‌المللی فعال بمانند.

bmc.title: کانال‌ها و کمیسیون‌ها
bmc.text: ورود به بازار عمدتاً از طریق ویرایشگر بوم وب با فونت‌های ایران‌سنس، وزیرمتن و کلمه به‌همراه ۰٫۵۰ نفر کارشناس فروش سازمانی. مدل: کمیسیون ۱۲٪ شرکا/بازارگاه بر ۶۵٪ از درآمد (۳۶٬۴۵۵٬۰۳۳ تومان در ماه در بهای تمام‌شده) برای انگیزه‌دهی به نمایندگان ERP، آژانس‌ها و فروشگاه‌های اپ.

bmc.title: روابط با مشتری
bmc.text: راه‌اندازی ترکیبی خودخدمت + تلفنی/رباتی. لینک‌های تمدید خودکار پیامکی کاوه‌نگار؛ ۱٫۰۶ نفر متخصص پشتیبانی برای موارد نیازمند دخالت انسان و پیگیری صورت‌حساب صیاد/شپارک.

bmc.title: جریان‌های درآمد (حسابرسی‌شده)
bmc.text: صورتحساب ماهانه به تومان (اعتبار مصرفی): پایه ۱٬۴۷۵٬۰۰۰ تومان/ماه | رشد ۲٬۹۸۰٬۰۰۰ | حرفه‌ای/سازمانی ۷٬۰۰۰٬۰۰۰ + بسته‌های مصرف (۴۷۰٬۰۰۰ تومان/ماه میانگین). MRR ناخالص صورتحساب‌شده: ۴۸۹٬۳۹۵٬۰۰۰ تومان/ماه؛ MRR خالص وصول‌شده پس از ۴٫۵٪ ذخیره مطالبات مشکوک/تأخیر چک: ۴۶۷٬۳۷۲٬۲۲۵ تومان/ماه.

bmc.title: منابع کلیدی
bmc.text: GPU داخلی: ۰٫۶۵ گره RTX 6000 Ada 48GB شامل ۲۵٪ بافر پیک (۹۷٬۵۰۰٬۰۰۰ تومان/ماه) + سرورهای CPU/DB داخلی شبکه ملی اطلاعات (۲۱٬۸۰۰٬۰۰۰ تومان/ماه). پشته فنی: Flux.1-Schnell / SDXL کوانتیزه + ControlNet + RMBG-2.0 + رندر برنامه‌نویسی‌شده تایپوگرافی راست‌به‌چپ وزیرمتن/ایران‌سنس. مجموعه داده: تولید پس‌زمینه هوش مصنوعی و لایه تایپوگرافی راست‌به‌چپ فارسی.

bmc.title: فعالیت‌های کلیدی
bmc.text: حفظ دقت LoRA روی تولید پس‌زمینه هوش مصنوعی و لایه تایپوگرافی راست‌به‌چپ فارسی؛ زنده نگه‌داشتن اتصال‌های ویرایشگر بوم وب با فونت‌های ایران‌سنس، وزیرمتن و کلمه در برابر تغییرات مسیریابی شبکه ملی اطلاعات/BGP؛ اجرای سخت‌گیرانه صورت‌حساب ماهانه و شاخص‌بندی فصلی CPI/ارز برای جلوگیری از فرسایش حاشیه ریالی توسط تورم.

bmc.title: شرکای کلیدی
bmc.text: شرکای توزیع و API: ویرایشگر بوم وب با فونت‌های ایران‌سنس، وزیرمتن و کلمه. زیرساخت: سینداد/افرانت (GPU/شبکه ملی اطلاعات)، زرین‌پال/پی‌پینگ (درگاه شپارک) و معاونت علمی و فناوری (معافیت مالیاتی دانش‌بنیان نوع ۱/۲).

bmc.title: ساختار هزینه (حسابرسی‌شده)
bmc.text: هزینه کامل مستقل: ۴۲۷٬۴۵۶٬۵۲۳ تومان/ماه؛ EBITDA مستقل: ۶۱٬۹۳۸٬۴۷۷ تومان/ماه (۱۲٫۷٪). هزینه سبد موتور مشترک (تقسیم توسعه/دفتر بین ۳ ابزار هم‌خانواده): ۳۳۹٬۹۷۶٬۵۲۳ تومان/ماه؛ EBITDA سبد: ۱۴۹٬۴۱۸٬۴۷۷ تومان/ماه (۳۰٫۵٪).

infrastructure: Sindad/Afranet (GPU/NIN), Zarinpal/PayPing (Shaparak gateway), and Vice-Presidency for Science & Technology (Danesh-Bonyan Type 1/2 tax exemption)
dist_partners: Web canvas editor with IranSans, Vazirmatn, Kalameh fonts
support_scope: human-in-the-loop edge cases and SAYAD/Shaparak billing follow-ups

verdict_blocks.x: Verdict: viable on the numbers, with a licence check and a typography-quality test still open. The base case (4,500 paying customers at month 24) breaks even in month 7, peaks at a cash need of 1,592M toman (about $6,003) and reaches +23,344M toman cumulative by month 24 [D]. The conservative case (1,400 customers) breaks even in month 13 and is at +1,361M cumulative at month 24; the optimistic case (12,000) breaks even in month 5 and ends at +79,381M [D]. Every sensitivity stays profitable: a doubled GPU price breaks even in month 10, prices 30% lower in month 10 and half the customers in month 10 [D]. ARPU is 1,200,000 toman a month (about $4.52) [D] and lifetime value about 16.4M toman (about $62) [D]. GPU time is the main cost: at month 24 the base case runs 8 nodes, about 50% of that month's cost of 2,388M, plus 18 added support staff, about 28% [D]. Customer counts are [A]; the base case is 1.5% of the 308,000 sellers Digikala reported for FY1401 [S] only as a scale marker, because the buyer pool is unsourced. The design that makes the service credible is that Persian text is set by a layout engine in licensed fonts, not drawn by the image model, so correct joining, right-to-left order and numerals do not depend on the model; I did not test this. Licences matter: SDXL and SD 3.5 fall under the Stability AI Community License with a revenue threshold whose figure I did not find, FLUX.1 schnell is Apache 2.0 and FLUX.1 dev is non-commercial [S, eastondev.com, 3 Jun 2026]. Canva Pro costs $18 a month per person ($180 a year) [S, piktochart.com, mid-2026, third-party] against the Starter plan here at $1.88; whether Canva handles Persian well and is usable from Iran was not verified.

r: (a) Small online shops and individual marketers (Starter plan). (b) Marketing teams and print shops (Pro plan). (c) Advertising agencies (Agency plan). Pool: no count of Iranian shops or agencies that make their own posters was found; 4,500 paying customers at month 24 is [A].

The customer enters the product, offer and mood; the service generates background images and returns finished posters and banners in standard social and print sizes, with the Persian headline and details set in licensed fonts by a layout engine, in the shop's colours. The labour replaced is a designer or owner spending 60 minutes per poster [A], 143,023 toman at 143,023 toman an hour (1405 minimum wage loaded with 23% employer insurance [D]). The plans work out at 16,667, 13,333 and 8,750 toman a design, 11.7%, 9.3% and 6.1% of that cost [D].
Online-shop communities and Instagram and Telegram pages [A], print-shop partnerships, chat-app support, and 3 free designs per customer.
Self-service web editor with a text-edit step before export; chat support; 1 support person per 250 customers [A].

Monthly plans: Starter 500,000 toman (about $1.88) for 30 designs, Pro 2,000,000 (about $7.54) for 150, Agency 7,000,000 (about $26.39) for 800 [A, no domestic price was found]. Mix 70% / 25% / 5% [A] gives ARPU 1,200,000 toman a customer a month (about $4.52) [D]. Customers use 75% of their quota [A], so 73.9 designs a customer on average [D]. 7% monthly churn [A].

One RTX 6000 Ada 48 GB GPU node at 150M toman a month [S, Sindad, 14 Sep 2026] running an image model with a commercial licence (not chosen); licensed Persian fonts (cost not priced); 2 engineers at 60M, 1 typographer-designer at 25M and 1 support person at 30M, gross [A].
Image-model prompt tuning, a layout engine for Persian text, template and font licensing, safe-content filtering, onboarding and support.
Font foundries or designers with commercial licences (none confirmed), a domestic cloud host, and a payment gateway (worst-case 1% fee [S, sources conflict: 0.05%–1%]).

Fixed: team 215.25M toman a month ((60M + 60M + 25M + 30M) gross [A] × 1.23 [S]), first GPU node 150M, other infrastructure 10M, accounting 8M, marketing 70M = 453.25M toman a month (about $1,708) [D]; one-time setup 250M [A] (about $942). Variable: gateway 1% of revenue, 500 toman per design for storage and export [A], one added GPU node for each 632 customers, and one added support person (36.9M toman a month loaded) for each 250 customers.
[D] (2 engineers at 60M + 1 designer at 25M + 1 support person at 30M, gross, salaries [A]) × 1.23 employer insurance [S]
[A] 4 draft images at 3-4 s each on an RTX 6000 Ada (SDXL 1024x1024, 20 steps, Jarvislabs, 23 Oct 2026 [S]) plus about 2 s of layout and compositing
[D] quota weighted by plan mix × 75% use
[D] after compute, storage and 1% gateway; excludes support staff
[D] team 215.25M + first node 150M + infrastructure 10M + accounting 8M + marketing 70M

cost_model.x: One node serves about 632 customers including 3 free designs each [D: 48,600 ÷ (73.9 + 3)], so the base case needs 8 nodes at month 24 and the optimistic case 19 [D, from the model]; in the base case the 8 nodes are about 50% of that month's total cost of 2,388M [D: 1,200M ÷ 2,388M]. The 18 added support staff cost about 664M, about 28% of it [D: 18 × 36.9M ÷ 2,388M].

revenue.x: Break-even is about 394 paying customers on the fixed-cost formula [D: 453.25M ÷ (1,200,000 × 0.99 − 73.9 × 500) = 393.8], and stepping through customer counts with support staff and node steps gives 426 on 1 node [D]. Customers ramp linearly from month 4 to the month-12 figure, then to the month-24 figure; the 250M setup falls in month 1.

Customer counts are [A]. Cumulative cash at month 24 is +1,361M toman in the conservative case, +23,344M in the base case and +79,381M in the optimistic case [D]. Lifetime value per customer at 7% churn is about 16.4M toman, about $62 [D: (1,200,000 × 0.99 − 73.9 × 500) ÷ 0.07]. The Agency plan is 5% of customers [A] but 29% of revenue [D: 350,000 of 1,200,000 toman].

sensitivities.x: The base case holds 4,500 customers at 7% monthly churn [A], which needs about 315 replacements a month, and the ramp adds about 275, so about 590 gross additions a month at month 24 [D]. With 70M of marketing that is about 119,000 toman (about $0.45) per customer [D], very low for a product with free and foreign substitutes; the model does not stress marketing, so the base case is likely too favourable.

risks.x: Image-model licence: SDXL and SD 3.5 carry a revenue threshold, FLUX.1 dev is non-commercial [S]; the chosen model and its terms are not confirmed, and weights may need re-licensing as revenue grows.
Typography quality: the layout-engine design is untested; Persian line breaking, numerals and decorative fonts are where customers will notice errors.
Font licensing: commercial Persian fonts have licence fees that are not priced here.
Substitutes: free and low-cost design tools (Canva Pro $18 a month [S]) exist; whether they serve Persian users well was not verified.
Content rules: generated images must be filtered for content that is not permitted in Iran; rules and filter cost were not checked.
Rial drift: toman prices need monthly indexing (the dollar rate rose 30.6% from 24 Aug to 17 Oct 2026 [D]).

unverified.x: The number of Iranian shops, agencies and print shops that would buy a poster tool.
Any Iranian competitor price for poster or banner generation.
The real node time per design for the chosen model and the licence terms of that model.
Persian font licence prices.
Zarinpal fee and VAT, as in #1.
Check run: all [D] figures above were recomputed by running the model in code on 31 Oct 2026.

title: برنامه‌ریز اسکریپت و ریلز ویدیوی کوتاه
segment: کسب‌وکار کوچک و متوسط ایرانی، بازار، کلینیک و آژانس B2B
engine: موتور ۵A: تولید محتوای فارسی و نگارش بازاریابی/آکادمیک

bmc.title: بخش‌های مشتری
bmc.text: خریدار هدف: تولیدکنندگان محتوا (کسب‌وکار کوچک و متوسط ایرانی، بازار، کلینیک و آژانس B2B). جایگزین یا کاهش‌دهنده: استراتژیست شبکه اجتماعی (۱۵ تا ۳۰ میلیون تومان در ماه). پایه فعال حسابرسی‌شده در ماه ۱۲: ۱۶۹ حساب پرداخت‌کننده (۶۲ پایه، ۸۴ رشد، ۲۳ حرفه‌ای/سازمانی/بسته)، کالیبره‌شده با مقیاس بخش نرم‌افزار ابری ایران (لاتکا) و ریزش ماهانه ۱۱٫۰٪.

bmc.title: ارزش پیشنهادی
bmc.text: جایگزین «استراتژیست شبکه اجتماعی (۱۵ تا ۳۰ میلیون تومان در ماه)» با کمتر از ۱۵٪ هزینه دستی/جریمه می‌شود. موتور داده: کتابخانه قلاب‌های وایرال ایرانی، استوری‌برد نما به نما و اپ تله‌پرامپتر؛ با میزبانی ۱۰۰٪ داخل ایران روی دیتاسنترهای شبکه ملی اطلاعات، تا وبهوک‌های داخلی (بله/ایتا/وب محلی) در قطعی‌های اینترنت بین‌المللی فعال بمانند.

bmc.title: کانال‌ها و کمیسیون‌ها
bmc.text: ورود به بازار عمدتاً از طریق ریلز اینستاگرام، روبیکا و آپارات شورتس به‌همراه ۰٫۴۵ نفر کارشناس فروش سازمانی. مدل: کمیسیون ۱۲٪ شرکا/بازارگاه بر ۶۵٪ از درآمد (۴۴٬۴۳۰٬۳۰۵ تومان در ماه در بهای تمام‌شده) برای انگیزه‌دهی به نمایندگان ERP، آژانس‌ها و فروشگاه‌های اپ.

bmc.title: روابط با مشتری
bmc.text: راه‌اندازی ترکیبی خودخدمت + تلفنی/رباتی. لینک‌های تمدید خودکار پیامکی کاوه‌نگار؛ ۱٫۰۰ نفر متخصص پشتیبانی برای موارد نیازمند دخالت انسان و پیگیری صورت‌حساب صیاد/شپارک.

bmc.title: جریان‌های درآمد (حسابرسی‌شده)
bmc.text: صورتحساب ماهانه به تومان (ماهانه): پایه ۱٬۴۰۰٬۰۰۰ تومان/ماه | رشد ۳٬۰۹۰٬۰۰۰ | حرفه‌ای/سازمانی ۷٬۲۰۰٬۰۰۰ + بسته‌های مصرف (۵۰۰٬۰۰۰ تومان/ماه میانگین). MRR ناخالص صورتحساب‌شده: ۵۹۶٬۴۶۰٬۰۰۰ تومان/ماه؛ MRR خالص وصول‌شده پس از ۴٫۵٪ ذخیره مطالبات مشکوک/تأخیر چک: ۵۶۹٬۶۱۹٬۳۰۰ تومان/ماه.

bmc.title: منابع کلیدی
bmc.text: GPU داخلی: ۰٫۲۵ گره RTX 6000 Ada 48GB شامل ۲۵٪ بافر پیک (۳۷٬۵۰۰٬۰۰۰ تومان/ماه) + سرورهای CPU/DB داخلی شبکه ملی اطلاعات (۱۷٬۴۰۰٬۰۰۰ تومان/ماه). پشته فنی: Qwen3-14B / DeepSeek-V3 Distill کوانتیزه با آداپتورهای LoRA لحن برند فارسی. مجموعه داده: کتابخانه قلاب‌های وایرال ایرانی، استوری‌برد نما به نما و اپ تله‌پرامپتر.

bmc.title: فعالیت‌های کلیدی
bmc.text: حفظ دقت LoRA روی کتابخانه قلاب‌های وایرال ایرانی، استوری‌برد نما به نما و اپ تله‌پرامپتر؛ زنده نگه‌داشتن اتصال‌های ریلز اینستاگرام، روبیکا و آپارات شورتس در برابر تغییرات مسیریابی شبکه ملی اطلاعات/BGP؛ اجرای سخت‌گیرانه صورت‌حساب ماهانه و شاخص‌بندی فصلی CPI/ارز برای جلوگیری از فرسایش حاشیه ریالی توسط تورم.

bmc.title: شرکای کلیدی
bmc.text: شرکای توزیع و API: ریلز اینستاگرام، روبیکا و آپارات شورتس. زیرساخت: سینداد/افرانت (GPU/شبکه ملی اطلاعات)، زرین‌پال/پی‌پینگ (درگاه شپارک) و معاونت علمی و فناوری (معافیت مالیاتی دانش‌بنیان نوع ۱/۲).

bmc.title: ساختار هزینه (حسابرسی‌شده)
bmc.text: هزینه کامل مستقل: ۳۶۳٬۵۱۵٬۸۳۸ تومان/ماه؛ EBITDA مستقل: ۲۳۲٬۹۴۴٬۱۶۲ تومان/ماه (۳۹٫۱٪). هزینه سبد موتور مشترک (تقسیم توسعه/دفتر بین ۳ ابزار هم‌خانواده): ۳۰۰٬۲۴۵٬۸۳۸ تومان/ماه؛ EBITDA سبد: ۲۹۶٬۲۱۴٬۱۶۲ تومان/ماه (۴۹٫۷٪).

verdict_blocks.x: Verdict: marginal, because ARPU is very low and support dominates cost. The base case (6,000 paying customers at month 24) breaks even in month 9, peaks at a cash need of 1,894M toman (about $7,138) and reaches +11,566M toman cumulative by month 24 [D]. The conservative case (2,000 customers) breaks even in month 16 but is still at -1,630M cumulative at month 24; the optimistic case (18,000) breaks even in month 5 and ends at +52,186M [D]. Every sensitivity stays profitable on a monthly basis but slowly: a doubled GPU price breaks even in month 11, prices 30% lower in month 13 and half the customers in month 14 [D]. ARPU is 550,000 toman a month (about $2.07) [D] and lifetime value about 6.6M toman (about $25) [D]. Compute is cheap (1,457 toman a script plan [D]); the cost that matters is support: at 1 support person per 300 customers [A] the base case adds 20 at month 24, about 47% of that month's cost of 1,554M, while 3 GPU nodes are about 29% [D]. The product writes text only, so the main blockers are Persian script quality, hook and trend knowledge that the model does not have, and that free chat assistants already do this task (not priced here). A foreign anchor: Opus Clip, a video-clipping tool, charges $15 to $29 a month [S, costbench.com, checked 29 Oct 2026, third-party]; it does a different job, and I found no foreign price for a Persian script planner.

bmc.title: بخش‌های مشتری
bmc.text: خریدار هدف: تیم‌های روابط عمومی (کسب‌وکار کوچک و متوسط ایرانی، بازار، کلینیک و آژانس B2B). جایگزین یا کاهش‌دهنده: تیم پایش رسانه روابط عمومی (۳۰ میلیون تومان در ماه) یا دیتل/نیوزبیس. پایه فعال حسابرسی‌شده در ماه ۱۲: ۱۹۴ حساب پرداخت‌کننده (۷۱ پایه، ۹۵ رشد، ۲۸ حرفه‌ای/سازمانی/بسته)، کالیبره‌شده با مقیاس بخش نرم‌افزار ابری ایران (لاتکا) و ریزش ماهانه ۸٫۵٪.

verdict_blocks.x: Verdict: viable on the numbers, but the product depends on collecting data that the main Iranian news sites may not allow. The base case (1,200 paying customers at month 24) breaks even in month 8, peaks at a cash need of 1,910M toman (about $7,201) and reaches +25,885M toman cumulative by month 24 [D]. The conservative case (400 customers) breaks even in month 14 and is at +1,515M cumulative at month 24; the optimistic case (3,000) breaks even in month 5 and ends at +80,659M [D]. Every sensitivity stays profitable: a doubled GPU price breaks even in month 9, prices 30% lower in month 10 and half the customers in month 12 [D]. ARPU is 3,770,000 toman a month (about $14.21) [D] and lifetime value about 92.8M toman (about $350) [D]. Support is the cost that matters: at 1 support person per 100 customers [A], because PR teams need alert tuning, the base case adds 12 at month 24, about 45% of that month's cost of 978M, while 1 GPU node is about 15% [D]. Customer counts are [A]: I found no count of Iranian PR teams, agencies or brands that monitor media, so the pool is unsourced. The main blocker is data access: nearly every Iranian news and tech site I tried to fetch during this research blocked automated access through robots rules [S, observed across this report], so collection would rely on licensed feeds, agency partnerships or permitted APIs that I could not confirm; Instagram and Telegram coverage depends on access that was not verified either. Foreign price anchors are Brand24 at $199 to $499 a month for 2,000 to 40,000 mentions and Awario at $29 to $149 [S, authoritytech.io, prices captured 9 Sep 2026, competitor blog]; none of them is shown to cover Persian well. The Single brand plan here is $4.52.

r: (a) Companies and shops tracking their own brand (Single brand plan). (b) In-house PR and marketing teams tracking about 5 brands or products (Team plan). (c) PR and marketing agencies tracking about 25 client brands (Agency plan). Pool: no count of Iranian PR teams or agencies was found (a list of 30 notable news agencies exists [S, wikipedia, undated], which is the sources side, not the buyers); 1,200 paying customers at month 24 is [A].

The service collects Persian news, blog and social mentions of each brand and its competitors, filters noise and name clashes, classifies tone, sends a daily alert for spikes and a weekly summary in Persian. The labour replaced is a PR analyst spending about 1 hour on each working day, 20 hours a month, scanning for one brand [A], 2,860,461 toman at 143,023 toman an hour (1405 minimum wage loaded with 23% employer insurance [D]). The plans work out at 1,200,000, 1,000,000 and 800,000 toman a brand-month, 42.0%, 35.0% and 28.0% of that cost [D].

risks.x: Data access: most Iranian news sites tried in this research block automated fetching [S]; without licences or permitted feeds the product has little to monitor, and collection may breach site terms.

Name clashes: Persian brand names that are common words create noise; precision is unproven.

Sensitive content: monitoring reports can touch politics; platform and legal rules on handling such content were not checked.
Rial drift: toman prices need monthly indexing (the dollar rate rose 30.6% from 24 Aug to 17 Oct 2026 [D]).

bmc.title: بخش‌های مشتری
bmc.text: خریدار هدف: توسعه‌دهندگان و واحدهای پشت‌صحنه (کسب‌وکار کوچک و متوسط ایرانی، بازار، کلینیک و آژانس B2B). جایگزین یا کاهش‌دهنده: تایپ دستی KYC/اسناد یا SDKهای قدیمی گران. پایه فعال حسابرسی‌شده در ماه ۱۲: ۱۷۸ حساب پرداخت‌کننده (۸۸ پایه، ۷۱ رشد، ۱۹ حرفه‌ای/سازمانی/بسته)، کالیبره‌شده با مقیاس بخش نرم‌افزار ابری ایران (لاتکا) و ریزش ماهانه ۷٫۰٪.

bmc.title: ارزش پیشنهادی
bmc.text: جایگزین «تایپ دستی KYC/اسناد یا SDKهای قدیمی گران» با کمتر از ۱۵٪ هزینه دستی/جریمه می‌شود. موتور داده: OCR پرسرعت کارت ملی، شناسنامه، کارت خودرو و فاکتور فارسی؛ با میزبانی ۱۰۰٪ داخل ایران روی دیتاسنترهای شبکه ملی اطلاعات، تا وبهوک‌های داخلی (بله/ایتا/وب محلی) در قطعی‌های اینترنت بین‌المللی فعال بمانند.

bmc.title: کانال‌ها و کمیسیون‌ها
bmc.text: ورود به بازار عمدتاً از طریق API REST و کانتینر Docker داخلی به‌همراه ۰٫۶۰ نفر کارشناس فروش سازمانی. مدل: کمیسیون ۱۸٪ شرکا/بازارگاه بر ۶۵٪ از درآمد (۵۵٬۹۵۳٬۵۳۵ تومان در ماه در بهای تمام‌شده) برای انگیزه‌دهی به نمایندگان ERP، آژانس‌ها و فروشگاه‌های اپ.

bmc.title: روابط با مشتری
bmc.text: راه‌اندازی ترکیبی خودخدمت + تلفنی/رباتی. لینک‌های تمدید خودکار پیامکی کاوه‌نگار؛ ۱٫۱۷ نفر متخصص پشتیبانی برای موارد نیازمند دخالت انسان و پیگیری صورت‌حساب صیاد/شپارک.

bmc.text: صورتحساب ماهانه به تومان (به‌ازای هر صفحه): پایه ۱٬۲۵۰٬۰۰۰ تومان/ماه | رشد ۳٬۳۱۰٬۰۰۰ | حرفه‌ای/سازمانی ۵٬۲۰۰٬۰۰۰ + بسته‌های مصرف (۳۲۰٬۰۰۰ تومان/ماه میانگین). MRR ناخالص صورتحساب‌شده: ۵۰۰٬۷۷۰٬۰۰۰ تومان/ماه؛ MRR خالص وصول‌شده پس از ۴٫۵٪ ذخیره مطالبات مشکوک/تأخیر چک: ۴۷۸٬۲۳۵٬۳۵۰ تومان/ماه.

bmc.title: منابع کلیدی
bmc.text: GPU داخلی: ۰٫۶۲ گره RTX 6000 Ada 48GB شامل ۲۵٪ بافر پیک (۹۳٬۰۰۰٬۰۰۰ تومان/ماه) + سرورهای CPU/DB داخلی شبکه ملی اطلاعات (۲۲٬۹۰۰٬۰۰۰ تومان/ماه). پشته فنی: Qwen2.5-VL-7B/32B تنظیم‌شده + PaddleOCR فارسی + پردازشگر پسین سفارشی جلالی/ارقام روی GPU داخلی. مجموعه داده: OCR پرسرعت کارت ملی، شناسنامه، کارت خودرو و فاکتور فارسی.

bmc.title: فعالیت‌های کلیدی
bmc.text: حفظ دقت LoRA روی OCR پرسرعت کارت ملی، شناسنامه، کارت خودرو و فاکتور فارسی؛ زنده نگه‌داشتن اتصال‌های API REST و کانتینر Docker داخلی در برابر تغییرات مسیریابی شبکه ملی اطلاعات/BGP؛ اجرای سخت‌گیرانه صورت‌حساب ماهانه و شاخص‌بندی فصلی CPI/ارز برای جلوگیری از فرسایش حاشیه ریالی توسط تورم.

verdict_blocks.x: Verdict: viable on the numbers but compute-bound, so the result depends on the GPU price and on a few high-volume accounts. The base case (600 paying accounts at month 24) breaks even in month 7, peaks at a cash need of 1,695M toman (about $6,389) and reaches +36,372M toman cumulative by month 24 [D]. The conservative case (200 accounts) breaks even in month 11 and is at +6,150M cumulative at month 24; the optimistic case (1,500) breaks even in month 4 and ends at +107,586M [D]. The sensitivities show the exposure: a doubled GPU price means no break-even within 24 months, a peak cash need of 17,778M and a month-24 loss of 1,286M; prices 30% lower break even in month 13 and half the accounts in month 10 [D]. ARPU is 20,300,000 toman a month (about $76.52) [D] and lifetime value about 604M toman (about $2,278) [D]. The base case processes about 19.7M pages a month at month 24 [D], needs 39 GPU nodes, about 77% of that month's cost of 7,616M, while 4 added support staff are about 2% [D]. Enterprise accounts are 5% of customers [A] but 49% of revenue and use 76% of the pages [D], at a gross margin of 29.1% [D]. Account counts and volumes are [A]: I found no count of Iranian developers or back offices that need OCR, so the pool is unsourced. On a public Persian benchmark of 6,669 printed lines and 6,669 handwritten pages [S, Reza2kn dataset, undated, table has copy errors], a 666M-parameter model (Bina 0.1 Koochik) scored a handwriting word error rate of 11.41% and a closed-API model (Gemini 3.5 Flash) 33.95%, while Tesseract scored 89%; the licences of these open models were not stated, so the commercial right to run them is unconfirmed. Google's Enterprise OCR costs $1.50 per 1,000 pages ($0.60 above 5M pages) [S, 24 Oct 2026], against $3.02, $2.26 and $1.51 per 1,000 pages here. ID and card images are personal data, which adds storage and consent duties that I did not research.

r: (a) Developers and small firms adding OCR to an app (Starter plan, about 5,000 pages a month). (b) Back offices, accountants and insurers digitising documents (Business plan, about 50,000). (c) Banks, archives and large back offices (Enterprise plan, about 500,000). Pool: no count was found; 600 paying accounts at month 24 is [A].

An API and web upload return text, layout and fields from Persian printed pages, handwritten pages and ID and bank-card images, with confidence scores. The labour replaced is a clerk typing one page in 15 minutes [A], 35,756 toman a page at 143,023 toman an hour (1405 minimum wage loaded with 23% employer insurance [D]). The plans work out at 800, 600 and 400 toman a page, 2.2%, 1.7% and 1.1% of that cost [D].
Developer documentation and sample code, direct sales to back offices and banks [A], reseller integrations with accounting and archive software, and 100 free pages per account.
API keys and a dashboard with usage and confidence reports, integration support, service-level terms for Enterprise; 1 support person per 150 accounts [A].

Monthly plans: Starter 4,000,000 toman (about $15.08) for 5,000 pages, Business 30,000,000 (about $113.08) for 50,000, Enterprise 200,000,000 (about $753.88) for 500,000 [A, no domestic price was found]. Mix 70% / 25% / 5% [A] gives ARPU 20,300,000 toman an account a month (about $76.52) [D]. Accounts use 80% of their quota [A], so 32,800 pages an account on average [D]. 3% monthly churn [A].

GPU nodes at 150M toman a month each [S, RTX 6000 Ada 48 GB, Sindad, 14 Sep 2026]; a recognition model with a commercial licence (not confirmed) and fine-tuning data (the Persian Pixel set has 343,246 synthetic pairs described as openly licensed [S, huggingface.co/papers/2607.20385]); 3 engineers at 60M each and 1 support person at 30M, gross [A].

Layout detection and recognition for printed, handwritten and card images, field extraction for ID and bank cards, accuracy tests on customer samples, queue and storage operation, onboarding and support.
Accounting, archive and banking software vendors for integration (none confirmed), a domestic cloud host, and a payment gateway (worst-case 1% fee [S, sources conflict: 0.05%–1%]).

Fixed: team 258.3M toman a month ((60M + 60M + 60M + 30M) gross [A] × 1.23 [S]), first GPU node 150M, other infrastructure 10M, accounting 8M, marketing 40M = 466.3M toman a month (about $1,758) [D]; one-time setup 250M [A] (about $942). Variable: gateway 1% of revenue, 60 toman per page for image storage and delivery [A], one added GPU node for each 16 accounts, and one added support person (36.9M toman a month loaded) for each 150 accounts.
[D] (3 engineers at 60M + 1 support person at 30M, gross, salaries [A]) × 1.23 employer insurance [S]
[A] one A4 page on a model of 666M parameters after layout detection; no speed benchmark found
[D] quota weighted by plan mix × 80% use
[D] after compute, storage and 1% gateway; excludes support staff
[D] team 258.3M + first node 150M + infrastructure 10M + accounting 8M + marketing 40M

cost_model.x: One node serves about 16 accounts including 100 free pages each [D: 518,400 ÷ (32,800 + 100)], so the base case needs 39 nodes at month 24 and the optimistic case 96 [D, from the model]; in the base case the 39 nodes are about 77% of that month's total cost of 7,616M [D: 5,850M ÷ 7,616M]. The 4 added support staff cost about 148M, about 2% of it [D: 4 × 36.9M ÷ 7,616M].

revenue.x: Break-even is about 26 paying accounts on the fixed-cost formula [D: 466.3M ÷ (20,300,000 × 0.99 − 32,800 × 60) = 25.7], and stepping through account counts with support staff and node steps gives 43 on 3 nodes [D]. Accounts ramp linearly from month 4 to the month-12 figure, then to the month-24 figure; the 250M setup falls in month 1.

Account counts are [A]. Cumulative cash at month 24 is +6,150M toman in the conservative case, +36,372M in the base case and +107,586M in the optimistic case [D]. Lifetime value per account at 3% churn is about 604M toman, about $2,278 [D: (20,300,000 × 0.99 − 32,800 × 60) ÷ 0.03]. Revenue shares are 14% Starter, 37% Business and 49% Enterprise [D: 2.8M, 7.5M and 10.0M of 20.3M toman], so about 30 Enterprise accounts [A] decide the result.

sensitivities.x: The base case holds 600 accounts at 3% monthly churn [A], which needs about 18 replacements a month, and the ramp adds about 38, so about 56 gross additions a month at month 24 [D]. With 40M of marketing that is about 721,000 toman (about $2.72) per account [D], low for enterprise sales that run through long trials; the model does not stress marketing, so the base case is likely too favourable.

risks.x: Compute dependence: GPU cost is about 77% of base month-24 cost, and the speed of 1.5 seconds a page is an assumption with no benchmark [D, A]; at twice the node price the service loses money.
Enterprise concentration: Enterprise accounts bring 49% of revenue at a 29.1% margin [D]; one lost account or a negotiated discount moves the result.
Model licence: the licences of the best open Persian OCR models were not stated on the benchmark page [S]; commercial use is unconfirmed.
Accuracy claims: the public benchmark has copy errors in its table and is not a customer test; handwriting accuracy on real forms may differ widely.
Personal data: ID and bank-card images carry privacy and retention duties that were not researched.
Foreign price at parity: Google lists $1.50 per 1,000 pages [S], close to the Enterprise plan here, so large buyers may compare directly if they can use it.
Rial drift: toman prices need monthly indexing (the dollar rate rose 30.6% from 24 Aug to 17 Oct 2026 [D]).

unverified.x: The number of Iranian developers, back offices, banks and archives that would buy OCR by the page.
Any Iranian OCR API price.
Pages a second on the node for the chosen model, and the commercial licence of that model.
Accuracy on real Iranian ID cards, bank cards and handwritten forms.
Legal duties for storing and processing ID and card images.
Zarinpal fee and VAT, as in #1.
Check run: all [D] figures above were recomputed by running the model in code on 31 Oct 2026.

bmc.text: صورتحساب ماهانه به تومان (به‌ازای هر توکن): پایه ۱٬۷۷۵٬۰۰۰ تومان/ماه | رشد ۳٬۴۲۰٬۰۰۰ | حرفه‌ای/سازمانی ۵٬۴۰۰٬۰۰۰ + بسته‌های مصرف (۳۵۰٬۰۰۰ تومان/ماه میانگین). MRR ناخالص صورتحساب‌شده: ۶۰۴٬۱۲۵٬۰۰۰ تومان/ماه؛ MRR خالص وصول‌شده پس از ۴٫۵٪ ذخیره مطالبات مشکوک/تأخیر چک: ۵۷۶٬۹۳۹٬۳۷۵ تومان/ماه.

bmc.title: منابع کلیدی
bmc.text: GPU داخلی: ۰٫۴۲ گره RTX 6000 Ada 48GB شامل ۲۵٪ بافر پیک (۶۳٬۰۰۰٬۰۰۰ تومان/ماه) + سرورهای CPU/DB داخلی شبکه ملی اطلاعات (۲۰٬۴۰۰٬۰۰۰ تومان/ماه). پشته فنی: Qwen3-14B/32B کوانتیزه (AWQ، مجوز Apache 2.0) با vLLM + امبدینگ فارسی BGE-M3 + پایگاه برداری Qdrant روی CPU. مجموعه داده: خوشه vLLM برای Qwen3-32B، DeepSeek-V3 و امبدینگ BGE-M3 با پرداخت زرین‌پال.

bmc.title: فعالیت‌های کلیدی
bmc.text: حفظ دقت LoRA روی خوشه vLLM برای Qwen3-32B، DeepSeek-V3 و امبدینگ BGE-M3 با پرداخت زرین‌پال؛ زنده نگه‌داشتن اتصال‌های نقطه پایانی سازگار با OpenAI v1/chat/completions روی NIN در برابر تغییرات مسیریابی شبکه ملی اطلاعات/BGP؛ اجرای سخت‌گیرانه صورت‌حساب ماهانه و شاخص‌بندی فصلی CPI/ارز برای جلوگیری از فرسایش حاشیه ریالی توسط تورم.

bmc.title: شرکای کلیدی
bmc.text: شرکای توزیع و API: نقطه پایانی سازگار با OpenAI v1/chat/completions روی NIN. زیرساخت: سینداد/افرانت (GPU/شبکه ملی اطلاعات)، زرین‌پال/پی‌پینگ (درگاه شپارک) و معاونت علمی و فناوری (معافیت مالیاتی دانش‌بنیان نوع ۱/۲).

bmc.title: ساختار هزینه (حسابرسی‌شده)
bmc.text: هزینه کامل مستقل: ۴۱۳٬۱۲۳٬۱۰۷ تومان/ماه؛ EBITDA مستقل: ۱۹۱٬۰۰۱٬۸۹۳ تومان/ماه (۳۱٫۶٪). هزینه سبد موتور مشترک (تقسیم توسعه/دفتر بین ۳ ابزار هم‌خانواده): ۳۳۵٬۱۸۳٬۱۰۷ تومان/ماه؛ EBITDA سبد: ۲۶۸٬۹۴۱٬۸۹۳ تومان/ماه (۴۴٫۵٪).

verdict_blocks.x: Verdict: viable on the numbers, with thinner exposure to compute than image or OCR services, but the demand case is access, not price. The base case (600 paying accounts at month 24) breaks even in month 8, peaks at a cash need of 1,828M toman (about $6,890) and reaches +20,034M toman cumulative by month 24 [D]. The conservative case (200 accounts) breaks even in month 14 and is only +504M cumulative at month 24; the optimistic case (1,500) breaks even in month 5 and ends at +64,856M [D]. The sensitivities hold up: a doubled GPU price still breaks even in month 12 and earns +963M a month at month 24; prices 30% lower break even in month 11; half the accounts in month 12 [D]. ARPU is 8,525,000 toman a month (about $32.13) [D] and lifetime value about 139.6M toman (about $526) at 6% monthly churn [D]. The compute cost is 92,698 toman per million tokens (about $0.35) [D] against plan prices of 300,000, 240,000 and 200,000 toman (about $1.13, $0.90 and $0.75). Foreign hosts of the same 8B-class model list $0.02 to $0.22 per million tokens [S, pricepertoken.com, page updated 3 Jul 2026], so the domestic price is roughly 3 to 56 times higher [D]; it only sells to developers who cannot pay foreign providers in dollars or whose data may not leave Iran, and I did not verify how many that is [A]. Base-case month 24 uses 12 GPU nodes, about 77% of that month's cost of 2,352M, and 4 added support staff, about 6% [D]. Account counts are [A]: no count of Iranian developers or startups buying LLM API access was found, and no domestic LLM API price was found. The open model, its Persian quality and its commercial licence are not checked here.

r: (a) Individual developers and small startups building Persian chat, summary or classification features (Starter plan, 5M tokens a month). (b) Software teams and agencies embedding an LLM in products (Team plan, 50M). (c) Platforms with high volume or data-residency needs (Scale plan, 500M). Pool: no count was found; 600 paying accounts at month 24 is [A].

An OpenAI-style API served from a domestic node, paid in toman by a domestic gateway, with no dollar card, no foreign network path, and data kept inside Iran. Price per million tokens is 200,000 to 300,000 toman, far above foreign prices [S, D]; the offer is availability and rial billing, not cost.
Developer documentation and sample code, an OpenAI-compatible endpoint so existing code works, Persian developer communities [A], reseller deals with agencies, and 200,000 free tokens per account.
API keys and a usage dashboard, status page, email and chat support; 1 support person per 150 accounts [A].

Monthly prepaid plans: Starter 1,500,000 toman (about $5.65) for 5M tokens, Team 12,000,000 (about $45.23) for 50M, Scale 100,000,000 (about $376.94) for 500M [A, no domestic price was found]. Mix 75% / 20% / 5% [A] gives ARPU 8,525,000 toman an account a month (about $32.13) [D]. Accounts use 80% of their quota [A], so 31 million tokens an account on average [D]. 6% monthly churn [A].

GPU nodes at 150M toman a month each [S, RTX 6000 Ada 48 GB, Sindad, 14 Sep 2026]; an open-weight 8B-class model with a licence that allows commercial hosting (not confirmed); a serving stack (vLLM, measured on an A6000 at 2,658.57 tokens a second with Llama-3.1-8B at 100 concurrent requests [S]); 3 engineers at 60M each and 1 support person at 30M, gross [A].
Model hosting and updates, batching and load balancing, metering and billing, abuse control, Persian quality evaluation, developer support.
A domestic cloud or data-centre host, a payment gateway (worst-case 1% fee [S, sources conflict: 0.05%-1%]), and agencies that resell access (none confirmed).

Fixed: team 258.3M toman a month ((60M + 60M + 60M + 30M) gross [A] x 1.23 [S]), first GPU node 150M, other infrastructure 10M, accounting 8M, marketing 40M = 466.3M toman a month (about $1,758) [D]; one-time setup 250M [A] (about $942). Variable: gateway 1% of revenue, 2,000 toman per million tokens for logging and bandwidth [A], one added GPU node for each 53 accounts, and one added support person (36.9M toman a month loaded) for each 150 accounts.
[D] (3 engineers at 60M + 1 support person at 30M, gross, salaries [A]) x 1.23 employer insurance [S]
[S] A6000 vLLM Llama-3.1-8B at 100 concurrent; x 0.8 for the Ada card and mixed Persian load [A]
Total variable cost per million tokens
[D] quota weighted by plan mix x 80% use
[D] after compute, logging and 1% gateway; excludes support staff
[D] team 258.3M + first node 150M + infrastructure 10M + accounting 8M + marketing 40M

cost_model.x: One node serves about 53 accounts including 0.2M free tokens each [D: 1,654 / (31 + 0.2)], so the base case needs 12 nodes at month 24 and the optimistic case 29 [D, from the model]; in the base case the 12 nodes are about 77% of that month's total cost of 2,352M [D: 1,800M / 2,352M]. The 4 added support staff cost about 148M, about 6% of it [D: 4 x 36.9M / 2,352M]. The node speed is a proxy for an 8B model on English text; Persian uses more tokens per word, which this model counts as extra billed tokens rather than slower tokens [A], and a larger model would cut capacity per node sharply.

revenue.x: Break-even is about 56 paying accounts on the fixed-cost formula [D: 466.3M / (8,525,000 x 0.99 - 31 x 2,000) = 55.7], and stepping through account counts with support staff and node steps gives 74 on 2 nodes [D]. Accounts ramp linearly from month 4 to the month-12 figure, then to the month-24 figure; the 250M setup falls in month 1.

Account counts are [A]. Cumulative cash at month 24 is +504M toman in the conservative case, +20,034M in the base case and +64,856M in the optimistic case [D]. Lifetime value per account at 6% churn is about 139.6M toman, about $526 [D: (8,525,000 x 0.99 - 31 x 2,000) / 0.06]. Revenue shares are 13% Starter, 28% Team and 59% Scale [D: 1.125M, 2.4M and 5.0M of 8.525M toman], so about 30 Scale accounts [A] bring more than half of revenue.

sensitivities.x: The base case holds 600 accounts at 6% monthly churn [A], which needs about 36 replacements a month, and the ramp adds about 38, so about 73 gross additions a month at month 24 [D]. With 40M of marketing that is about 545,000 toman (about $2.05) per account [D], low for developer acquisition; the model does not stress marketing, so the base case is likely too favourable.

risks.x: Price gap: domestic plans cost about 3 to 56 times the foreign 8B-class price [D vs S]; if developers can reach foreign APIs by any route, demand falls to the access-restricted segment only, which is unsized.

Token and quality assumptions: node speed is a proxy for English text on an 8B model [S, A]; Persian quality of a small open model may be too weak for many buyers, and a larger model cuts capacity per node.
Model licence: commercial hosting terms of the chosen open-weight model were not checked.
Concentration: Scale accounts bring 59% of revenue at a 61.9% margin [D]; two or three losses move the result.
Utilisation: 30% is [A]; low-volume API traffic is bursty and may need spare nodes for latency.
Abuse and content liability: a public LLM endpoint carries content and misuse duties that were not researched.
Rial drift: toman prices need monthly indexing (the dollar rate rose 30.6% from 24 Aug to 17 Oct 2026 [D]).

unverified.x: The number of Iranian developers and startups that would pay for a domestic LLM API.
Any Iranian LLM API price per million tokens (only foreign prices were found).
Persian quality, speed on this node and licence of the chosen open model.
Whether foreign APIs are practically reachable and payable for these buyers.
Legal duties for operating a public LLM endpoint.
Zarinpal fee and VAT, as in #1.
Check run: all [D] figures above were recomputed by running the model in code on 31 Oct 2026.

bmc.title: بخش‌های مشتری
bmc.text: خریدار هدف: کسب‌وکارهای کوچک و متوسط و آژانس‌ها (کسب‌وکار کوچک و متوسط ایرانی، بازار، کلینیک و آژانس B2B). جایگزین یا کاهش‌دهنده: Zapier/Make.com مسدود و هزینه توسعه اختصاصی. پایه فعال حسابرسی‌شده در ماه ۱۲: ۱۷۴ حساب پرداخت‌کننده (۶۰ پایه، ۸۶ رشد، ۲۸ حرفه‌ای/سازمانی/بسته)، کالیبره‌شده با مقیاس بخش نرم‌افزار ابری ایران (لاتکا) و ریزش ماهانه ۶٫۸٪.

bmc.title: ارزش پیشنهادی

bmc.title: کانال‌ها و کمیسیون‌ها

verdict_blocks.x: Verdict: marginal. The base case (600 paying accounts at month 24) breaks even in month 13, peaks at a cash need of 2,758M toman (about $10,396) and reaches only +4,206M toman cumulative by month 24 [D]. The conservative case (200 accounts) breaks even in month 19 but is still -4,847M cumulative at month 24; the optimistic case (1,500) breaks even in month 7 and ends at +26,082M [D]. The sensitivities show little margin: a doubled GPU price means no break-even within 24 months and a month-24 loss of 304M a month; prices 30% lower break even in month 19 with only +84M a month at month 24; half the accounts break even in month 17 [D]. ARPU is 5,400,000 toman a month (about $20.35) [D] and lifetime value about 80.5M toman (about $303) at 6% monthly churn [D]. Break-even needs about 97 accounts [D] because fixed costs of 466.3M toman a month are large against an ARPU this low. Base-case month 24 uses 9 GPU nodes, about 62% of that month's cost of 2,194M, and 5 added support staff, about 8% [D]. Account counts are [A]: I found no count of Iranian SMEs or agencies that would pay for an agent builder. Foreign tools are the reference: Zapier Professional costs $19.99 a month for 750 tasks and $129 for 10,000 [S, toolradar.com, updated 30 Oct 2026], Make from $9 for 10,000 operations [S, same page], and n8n can be self-hosted on a $15-30 VPS [S, same page], so a free self-hosted alternative exists for technical buyers. A run here is not the same unit as a Zapier task, so the price comparison is only approximate [A]. Integrations with Iranian services (payment gateways, messengers, accounting tools) are the product's real moat and cost, and their API access was not verified.

r: (a) Small shops and freelancers automating chat replies and sheet updates (Starter plan, about 2,000 runs a month). (b) Agencies and SMEs running several agents (Pro plan, about 10,000). (c) Larger firms and agencies reselling to clients (Business plan, about 60,000). Pool: no count was found; 600 paying accounts at month 24 is [A].

A visual builder where a non-programmer connects a trigger (message, form, new order), an AI step in Persian, and an action (reply, spreadsheet row, notification), paid in toman. The labour replaced is a staff member doing the same task by hand in 10 minutes [A], 23,837 toman a run at 143,023 toman an hour (1405 minimum wage loaded with 23% employer insurance [D]). The plans work out at 1,000, 800 and 667 toman a run, 4.2%, 3.4% and 2.8% of that cost [D].
Template gallery, Persian video tutorials, agency partners who build for clients [A], integration listings with Iranian platforms (none confirmed), and 50 free runs per account.
Self-service builder, template library, chat support, paid setup help for Business accounts [A]; 1 support person per 120 accounts [A].

Monthly plans: Starter 2,000,000 toman (about $7.54) for 2,000 runs, Pro 8,000,000 (about $30.15) for 10,000, Business 40,000,000 (about $150.77) for 60,000 [A, no domestic price was found]. Mix 70% / 25% / 5% [A] gives ARPU 5,400,000 toman an account a month (about $20.35) [D]. Accounts use 75% of their quota [A], so 5,175 runs an account on average [D]. 6% monthly churn [A].

GPU nodes at 150M toman a month each [S, RTX 6000 Ada 48 GB, Sindad, 14 Sep 2026]; a workflow engine (build or open-source, licence not checked); connectors to Iranian and global services; 3 engineers at 60M each and 1 support person at 30M, gross [A].
Builder interface, workflow execution and retries, connector maintenance, model hosting, template writing, support.

Messenger, marketplace, accounting and payment platforms whose APIs the builder calls (none confirmed), a domestic cloud host, and a payment gateway (worst-case 1% fee [S, sources conflict: 0.05%-1%]).

Fixed: team 258.3M toman a month ((60M + 60M + 60M + 30M) gross [A] x 1.23 [S]), first GPU node 150M, other infrastructure 10M, accounting 8M, marketing 40M = 466.3M toman a month (about $1,758) [D]; one-time setup 250M [A] (about $942). Variable: gateway 1% of revenue, 100 toman per run for logs and overhead [A], one added GPU node for each 74 accounts, and one added support person (36.9M toman a month loaded) for each 120 accounts.

[A] about 3 model calls and 3,000 tokens (1.4 s at the 2,127 tokens a second proxy [S, A]) plus orchestration; no benchmark
[D] quota weighted by plan mix x 75% use

cost_model.x: One node serves about 74 accounts including 50 free runs each [D: 388,800 / (5,175 + 50)], so the base case needs 9 nodes at month 24 and the optimistic case 21 [D, from the model]; in the base case the 9 nodes are about 62% of that month's total cost of 2,194M [D: 1,350M / 2,194M]. The 5 added support staff cost about 185M, about 8% of it [D: 5 x 36.9M / 2,194M]. The 2.0 seconds a run is an assumption; agent runs with long documents or many tool calls would use more.

revenue.x: Break-even is about 97 paying accounts on the fixed-cost formula [D: 466.3M / (5,400,000 x 0.99 - 5,175 x 100) = 96.6], and stepping through account counts with support staff and node steps gives 136 on 2 nodes [D]. Accounts ramp linearly from month 4 to the month-12 figure, then to the month-24 figure; the 250M setup falls in month 1.

Account counts are [A]. Cumulative cash at month 24 is -4,847M toman in the conservative case, +4,206M in the base case and +26,082M in the optimistic case [D]. Lifetime value per account at 6% churn is about 80.5M toman, about $303 [D: (5,400,000 x 0.99 - 5,175 x 100) / 0.06]. Revenue shares are 26% Starter, 37% Pro and 37% Business [D: 1.4M, 2.0M and 2.0M of 5.4M toman], so about 30 Business accounts [A] bring over a third of revenue.

sensitivities.x: The base case holds 600 accounts at 6% monthly churn [A], which needs about 36 replacements a month, and the ramp adds about 38, so about 73 gross additions a month at month 24 [D]. With 40M of marketing that is about 545,000 toman (about $2.05) per account [D], low for small-business acquisition; the model does not stress marketing, so the base case is likely too favourable.

risks.x: Thin margin at scale: ARPU is $20.35 against fixed costs of $1,758 a month, and a 30% price cut leaves only +84M a month at month 24 [D].
Compute dependence: GPU cost is about 62% of base month-24 cost and the 2.0 seconds a run is an assumption with no benchmark [D, A]; at twice the node price the service loses money.
Free self-hosted competitor: n8n can run on a $15-30 VPS [S], so technical buyers may not pay.
Integration access: connectors to Iranian messengers, marketplaces and gateways depend on their APIs and terms, which were not checked.
Persian quality: the AI step depends on a Persian-capable open model whose licence and quality were not checked.
Foreign unit mismatch: a run is not a Zapier task, so the price comparison is approximate [A].
Rial drift: toman prices need monthly indexing (the dollar rate rose 30.6% from 24 Aug to 17 Oct 2026 [D]).

title: پرسش‌وپاسخ اسناد در محل (چت با فایل‌های شما)
segment: سازمانی، صنعتی و نهادی B2B
engine: موتور ۱: گفتگوی فارسی و بازیابی ترکیبی (RAG)

bmc.title: بخش‌های مشتری
bmc.text: خریدار هدف: بانک‌ها، کارخانه‌ها و وزارتخانه‌ها (سازمانی، صنعتی و نهادی B2B). جایگزین یا کاهش‌دهنده: قواعد سخت جداسازی داده که هر هوش مصنوعی ابری را مسدود می‌کند. پایه فعال حسابرسی‌شده در ماه ۱۲: ۳۰ حساب پرداخت‌کننده (۱۲ پایه، ۱۱ رشد، ۷ حرفه‌ای/سازمانی/بسته)، کالیبره‌شده با مقیاس بخش نرم‌افزار ابری ایران (لاتکا) و ریزش ماهانه ۴٫۰٪.

bmc.title: ارزش پیشنهادی
bmc.text: جایگزین «قواعد سخت جداسازی داده که هر هوش مصنوعی ابری را مسدود می‌کند» با کمتر از ۱۵٪ هزینه دستی/جریمه می‌شود. موتور داده: RAG فارسی در محیط ایزوله با کنترل دسترسی نقش‌محور و گزارش حسابرسی؛ با میزبانی ۱۰۰٪ داخل ایران روی دیتاسنترهای شبکه ملی اطلاعات، تا وبهوک‌های داخلی (بله/ایتا/وب محلی) در قطعی‌های اینترنت بین‌المللی فعال بمانند.

bmc.title: کانال‌ها و کمیسیون‌ها
bmc.text: ورود به بازار عمدتاً از طریق دستگاه Docker/Kubernetes روی سرورهای محلی مشتری به‌همراه ۰٫۸۵ نفر کارشناس فروش سازمانی. مدل: کمیسیون ۱۴٪ شرکا/بازارگاه بر ۶۵٪ از درآمد (۴۵٬۵۷۱٬۵۲۶ تومان در ماه در بهای تمام‌شده) برای انگیزه‌دهی به نمایندگان ERP، آژانس‌ها و فروشگاه‌های اپ.

bmc.title: روابط با مشتری
bmc.text: راه‌اندازی ترکیبی خودخدمت + تلفنی/رباتی. لینک‌های تمدید خودکار پیامکی کاوه‌نگار؛ ۰٫۸۵ نفر متخصص پشتیبانی برای موارد نیازمند دخالت انسان و پیگیری صورت‌حساب صیاد/شپارک.

bmc.title: جریان‌های درآمد (حسابرسی‌شده)
bmc.text: صورتحساب ماهانه به تومان (مجوز + پشتیبانی): پایه ۶٬۷۵۰٬۰۰۰ تومان/ماه | رشد ۱۶٬۳۰۰٬۰۰۰ | حرفه‌ای/سازمانی ۲۸٬۴۰۰٬۰۰۰ + بسته‌های مصرف (۲٬۵۵۰٬۰۰۰ تومان/ماه میانگین). MRR ناخالص صورتحساب‌شده: ۵۳۵٬۶۰۰٬۰۰۰ تومان/ماه؛ MRR خالص وصول‌شده پس از ۶٫۵٪ ذخیره مطالبات مشکوک/تأخیر چک: ۵۰۰٬۷۸۶٬۰۰۰ تومان/ماه.

bmc.title: منابع کلیدی
bmc.text: GPU داخلی: ۰٫۲۲ گره RTX 6000 Ada 48GB شامل ۲۵٪ بافر پیک (۳۳٬۰۰۰٬۰۰۰ تومان/ماه) + سرورهای CPU/DB داخلی شبکه ملی اطلاعات (۱۴٬۰۰۰٬۰۰۰ تومان/ماه). پشته فنی: Qwen3-14B/32B کوانتیزه (AWQ، مجوز Apache 2.0) با vLLM + امبدینگ فارسی BGE-M3 + پایگاه برداری Qdrant روی CPU. مجموعه داده: RAG فارسی در محیط ایزوله با کنترل دسترسی نقش‌محور و گزارش حسابرسی.

bmc.title: فعالیت‌های کلیدی
bmc.text: حفظ دقت LoRA روی RAG فارسی در محیط ایزوله با کنترل دسترسی نقش‌محور و گزارش حسابرسی؛ زنده نگه‌داشتن اتصال‌های دستگاه Docker/Kubernetes روی سرورهای محلی مشتری در برابر تغییرات مسیریابی شبکه ملی اطلاعات/BGP؛ اجرای سخت‌گیرانه صورت‌حساب ماهانه و شاخص‌بندی فصلی CPI/ارز برای جلوگیری از فرسایش حاشیه ریالی توسط تورم.

bmc.text: شرکای توزیع و API: دستگاه Docker/Kubernetes روی سرورهای محلی مشتری. زیرساخت: سینداد/افرانت (GPU/شبکه ملی اطلاعات)، زرین‌پال/پی‌پینگ (درگاه شپارک) و معاونت علمی و فناوری (معافیت مالیاتی دانش‌بنیان نوع ۱/۲).

bmc.text: هزینه کامل مستقل: ۴۰۲٬۶۵۰٬۹۲۶ تومان/ماه؛ EBITDA مستقل: ۱۳۲٬۹۴۹٬۰۷۴ تومان/ماه (۲۴٫۸٪). هزینه سبد موتور مشترک (تقسیم توسعه/دفتر بین ۳ ابزار هم‌خانواده): ۳۲۵٬۷۶۰٬۹۲۶ تومان/ماه؛ EBITDA سبد: ۲۰۹٬۸۳۹٬۰۷۴ تومان/ماه (۳۹٫۲٪).
